conversions-api-event-match-quality-spad.title: Event Match Quality drop in Conversations API — diagnostics and corrective steps
conversions-api-event-match-quality-spad.description: A diagnostic guide for situations where the Event Match Quality (EMQ) indicator falls after the implementation of the Conversions API. Includes specific hypotheses, comparative tests, corrective steps and validation of pixel and server data.
conversions-api-event-match-quality-spad.intro: This document describes a specific diagnostic path when in Event Manager Meta you observe the downgrading of Event Match Quality (EMQ) after switching some traffic to Conversions API (CAPI) or after changes in implementation. EMQ depends on the quality and completeness of user identification data (e.g. email, phone, client ip address, fbp, fbc) and how these fields are to be hashed and transmitted. The quality decline is usually due to one or a combination: missing/incompatible identification field, wrong hashing (PHP/JS vs SHA256 raw bytes), non-compliance time stamp (differences >24h), duplication of events without proper deduplication (pixel + CAPI without event id) or filters and privacy rules in the advertising panel that cut or map fields. Below you will find an orderly differential diagnosis with step-by-step tests, specific commands in Meta logs and tools, and ways of verifying effect after corrections. We do not assume the cause — every point must be checked and eliminated sequentially.

sections.title: How to Recognize Cause
paragraphs: Compare Pixel and CAPI paydays: check that EMQ compliant fields are present in server requests. Usually missing email hash, phone hash, client ip address or user agent. If the fields are sent from the client via the server, note which ones come from the cookie and which from the payment form.

Check the hashing process: Meta expects SHA256 in hex format for personal IDentifiers. Typical errors: double hashing, base64 instead of hex, hashing with extra salt or wrong character encoding (UTF-8 vs Latin-1). Log in examples of inputs and compare with sha256 online.

Identify problems with time stamp and event id: if event id or event time vary between Pixel and CAPI, the deduplication will not work and Meta may treat events as separate, which affects EMQ. Also check transmission delays (>24h) and buffering, which reduce the accuracy of the match.

sections.title: Step by step solution
paragraphs: 1. Pull out 50 random events from the Event Manager from the problem period; download the example of Payload Pixel (from the browser) and the corresponding payload CAPI (from the server) and save both in the JSON file for comparisons.

2 . For each identification field compare the values: are the email/phone/fbp/fbc/client ip address present in Pixel also in CAPI? If not, open the server code and check whether middleware passes the headers and body requests from the client.

3 . Implement the hashing test: take the original data (e.g. raw email), count SHA256 in hex on the server and compare to the value sent to Meta; if different, repair the hash function and ensure uniform UTF-8 encoding.

4 . Verify event id and event time: Force the sending of an identical event id from Pixel and CAPI in the test example; if pixel does not generate event id, generate a compatible identifier at the client and send it to both sources.
5 . Check delays: Measure the time between the event in the browser and the CAPI request; if >5–10s check queues, batching and retry; if >24h, check Joby cron and ETL, because such delays reduce EMQ.
6 . Browse the privacy configurations and field mapping in Event Manager: make sure that the fields are not mapped to custom labels or filtered by privacy rules that could cut the email/phone.
7 . Enter one amendment at a time (hashing or sending event id) and observe EMQ changes within 24–72 hours; document each defloy and implementation time.

sections.title: How to see if the problem is gone
paragraphs: Test 1: Send 20 controlled test events with unique event id and complete hashed IDs; in Event Manager check that at least 80% has 'High' or 'Good' EMQ within 24–48 hours.

Test 2: Compare the matches indicator between Pixel and CAPI for the same event id; expect the number of properly matched matches to increase after the hashing/accession amendment by a minimum of 30% from baseline.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not simultaneously implement many changes (hashing, event id and delays). This makes it impossible to indicate which amendment has improved EMQ; introduce incremental changes.
Do not assume that the lack of email means a server problem — check the consent policy and frontend management, because the user can block the transfer of data.
Do not log full PIIs into production logs. Log only shortcuts/test identifiers and use masking to avoid breaking privacy rules.

cors-access-control-allow-origin-brak.title: CORS: No Access-Control-Allow-Origin — How to Fix Fetch?
cors-access-control-allow-origin-brak.description: Blocked by CORS policy, Access-Control-Allow-Origin missing and OPTIONS errors. Diagnostics and correct API configuration.
cors-access-control-allow-origin-brak.intro: CORS error means that the browser did not allow the script to read API responses from another origin. The repair is usually performed on the API, not by bypassing the frontend.

sections.title: 1. Find exact request
paragraphs: In DevTools, open Network, play a bug, and find a fetch request. Save frontend address (Origin), API URL, method and status. Take a look at Console: Failed to fetch itself does not say which header is missing.
See if OPTIONS appears before the correct query. This is a preflight in which the browser asks API for permitted methods and headers. Unsupported OPTIONS can block normal POST.

sections.title: 2 . Improve API policy
paragraphs: If you control the API, set Access-Control-Allow-Origin to a specific trusted origin and handle the methods and OPTIONS request correctly. For cookies and credentials, do not use the star as a permitted origin. When the answer depends on Origin, use Vary: Origin.
Make sure the CORS headers are also present in error responses if the browser is to read them. The API can return 401 or 500 and at the same time have an incorrect CORS policy.

sections.title: 3 . What to do
paragraphs: Do not disable browser security and do not use unknown public proxy to transfer customer data. mode no-cors does not solve the need to read the answer: returns an opaque response.
If the external API does not allow calls from your original, verify its official SDK backend or proxy server endpoint, including authentication and limit requests.

crm-admin-role-possible-bypass-endpoint.title: Potential bypassing endpoints in CRM — diagnostics and repair
crm-admin-role-possible-bypass-endpoint.description: Analysis of cases where endpoints or API functions allow users to escalate the role of administrator in CRM. Includes differential diagnostics, specific corrective steps, verification tests and typical errors to avoid.
crm-admin-role-possible-bypass-endpoint.intro: This document describes possible paths to circumvent the role of administrator in CRM systems using Postgres + RLS (row-level security) and external authentication mechanism (e.g. Supabase/Auth). Do not treat the title as proof of cause — the case needs a close review. I focus on technical mechanisms: incorrect RLS policies, incorrectly written SQL functions with SECURITY DEFINITION, acceptance of role with JWT token without validation and excessive public key permissions. The document presents a specific differential diagnosis with a breakdown by reason, detailed corrective steps, post-amendment tests and warnings that were most frequently made. Each step is described to give a specific command to execute on the server or in the RLS policy repository and functions.

sections.title: How to Recognize Cause
paragraphs: RLS policies exist, but refer to the role from the field jwt.claims.role without additional validation or use only current setting('jwt.claims.role', true) which allows manipulation if JWT is not credible Signed or proxies replace the headers. Check if the policy uses auth.uid() (reliable identification) or checks the row owner id.

SQL functions or procedures performed with SECURITY DEFINER permissions can perform operations as user owner of the function (often superuser or admin). If endpoint calls this function without additional input controls, this may allow the rating to be escalated. Review the function definitions and EXECUTE permissions.

Public or service keys (anon/public) used without restriction allow the client to call endpoints that bypass RLS by calling on the server side or expose RPC. Check which keys have SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/EXECUTE and whether there are network restrictions and a row-level interception policy.

sections.title: Step by step solution
paragraphs: 1. Collect a list of all RLS policies on affected tables: SELECT polycine, permissive, roles, cmd, qual, with check FROM pg polities WHERE tablename = 'name tablename'; compare qual and with check fields with expected reference conditions to auth.uid() or owner id.

2 . Check JWT: Verify the signature of the tokens used by the application (alg, kid) and compare claims.role with the actual user id. Use the opensl or jwt.io tool (locally) to decode and check the signature and expiration; reject trusts based on proxy headers.

3 . Review all functions/procedures from SECURITY DEFINITION: SELECT n.nspname, p.proname, p.provolate, p.prosecdef FROM pg proc p JOIN pg namespace n ON p.pronamespace=n.oid WHERE p.prosecdef=true; For each function limit EXECUTE permissions and add validation caller IS ROLE('Expected') or additional input checks.

4 . Restore RLS policies where they have been temporarily disabled, and replace terms based on auth.uid() and with check checking ownership id = auth.uid(). Remove policies that allow public/anon to write/execute without conditions.

5 . Close public key access: remove unnecessary public API-keys, limit their permissions and introduce domain/client IP restrictions. Generate new app/service keys after policy and rotation has been specified.
6 . Add audit login: enter the trigger AFTER INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE, which saves actor id (auth.uid()), source (api/function) and pre/after value to play escalations. Go to a separate, protected table.

7 . Run a code review of server and client endpoints: make sure that no endpoint sets the role in the token on the client side and that backend validates roles based on JWT signature and checks permissions before calling SQL function.

sections.title: How to see if the problem is gone
paragraphs: Try to trigger a susceptible endpoint with a token in which you will convert claim roles to 'admin' locally (but without a valid signature) — the request must be rejected by verification of the JWT signature. Verify response 401/403 instead of 200.

Create an integration test that performs operations requiring admin privileges using a lower clearance account; the operation should return the RLS/permission denied error. Repeat the test after turning off the public/anon keys and after turning the keys.

Try calling the SECURITY DEFINITION function with controlled parameters in the test environment; make sure that the function rejects requests when caller is not the owner/expected service and does not reveal admin data.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not disable Row-Level Security on production as a ‘fast’ fix. Disabling RLS removes the control layer and hides the problem only temporarily; instead, the policy improvements would force auth.uid() and with check.

Do not trust the role sent from the client without checking the JWT signature and key privileges. Accepting the role from the header or body field allows for simple escalation of permissions by any client.

Do not leave SQL function with SECURITY DEFINITION without EXECUTE input control and limitations: this is a typical escalation mechanism. Instead, give minimum permissions and validate caller id and arguments.

crm-duplikaty-leadow-webhook.title: CRM creates two leades from one form — how to fix it?
crm-duplikaty-leadow-webhook.description: Webhook can be delivered more than once. Also a rerun after timeout can create a second record, even though the first request saved the data. Pow support
crm-duplikaty-leadow-webhook.intro: Webhook can be delivered more than once. Also a rerun after timeout can create a second record, even though the first request saved the data. Repeat handling should be part of integration.

sections.title: Step by step
paragraphs: 1. Check the event identifier of the supplier and the number of requests in logs. The same email address does not always mean the same lead; the customer can ask for two different offers.
2 . Select a stable source identifier and add a limitation of uniqueness in the database, e.g. a pair of supplier plus form or event identifier, depending on its semantics.
3 . The check in the code “if there exists” and then a separate INSERT can lose at two parallel demands. Use transaction or save based on uniqueness limitation.
4 . A repeated correct event should be answered according to the supplier's protocol. Do not re-sign welcome and assignment.
5 . Test the parallel delivery of the same payoad and two different events of the same person. Logs should allow to find the result without storing unnecessary customer data.

sections.title: How to check whether the amendment works
paragraphs: Repeating a test webhook does not create a new lead or additional notifications. Two really separate queries still need to be handled. The merger rule is a separate business decision.

crm-eksport-leadow-zgody-i-uprawnienia.title: Export lead from CRM: how to avoid missing and leaking data?
crm-eksport-leadow-zgody-i-uprawnienia.description: Secure CSV/XLSX exports from CRM including permissions, filters, coding and data protection.
crm-eksport-leadow-zgody-i-uprawnienia.intro: The export of the file covers only the visible record page or allows you to download the data of the entire company through a simple account.

sections.title: Why is this happening?
paragraphs: Export is often built on the data currently loaded into React instead of an authorized server query.

sections.title: Step by step solution
paragraphs: 1. Specify whether export is to include an active filter or all valid records.
2 . Verify the role and range of records on the server side at each export request.
3 . Page data downloads or generate a file stream to not cut results.
4 . Remove fields not required for export and neutralize formulas in CSV values starting with special characters.
5 . Test the number of lines, encode Polish characters and no other people's data in the file.

sections.title: How do I check the score?
paragraphs: The number of records in export corresponds to the declared range, and the test role will not download data outside of its permissions.
Do not place complete exports in public picket or application logs.

crm-filtry-ukrywaja-leady.title: Leady disappeared from CRM after changing filters — what to check?
crm-filtry-ukrywaja-leady.description: Invisible contacts after filtering status, region, date or queue? Diagnostics of conditions in the interface and API.
crm-filtry-ukrywaja-leady.intro: CRM seems empty after switching the view, even though the database still contains contacts.

sections.title: Why is this happening?
paragraphs: Filters can be connected to an AND operator, and the lack of default value can act as an active filter. The previous filter can remain invisible when changing the bookmark.

sections.title: Step by step solution
paragraphs: 1. Display active filters in UI and clear them button. Note the difference in the number of records before and after cleaning.
2 . Check that the empty date field is interpreted as no limit, not as a specific day or NULL.
3 . Verify historical statuses, letter values and status names migrations.
4 . Check how to connect filters in the query; use tests on status combinations, maintainer and region.
5 . Add an empty list state describing active limitations instead of a message suggesting data loss.

sections.title: How do I check the score?
paragraphs: After the filters have been cleared, the list shows a set of records available to the account and the reuse of the filters gives a predictable result.
Do not delete data or reset the database when the problem is only about the view layer.

crm-google-drive-zalaczniki-token-wygasl.title: Google Drive at CRM stopped working: expired or undone token
crm-google-drive-zalaczniki-token-wygasl.description: Google Drive attachments do not open in CRM. What to check with invalid grant, retracted tokens and OAuth.
crm-google-drive-zalaczniki-token-wygasl.intro: After months of operation, the integration of the Disk does not download or save files, although before everything worked.

sections.title: Why is this happening?
paragraphs: Refreshing the token may not work, the user may have revoked the consent, the OAuth client may have changed the configuration or the token has been cancelled.

sections.title: Step by step solution
paragraphs: 1. Read the exact API response and distinguish 401, 403, invalid grant and no access to a specific folder.
2 . Check OAuth client configuration and consent ranges without revealing client secret.
3 . Determine whether the refresh token exists on the server side and whether the renewal mechanism works.
4 . When the permission is revoked, reauthorize the account and verify the owner of the resource.
5 . Add a visible integration alert and a safe queue of reruns instead of silently omitting files.

sections.title: How do I check the score?
paragraphs: The test document goes to the correct folder and can be opened from a valid CRM account.
Do not store OAuth tokens in frontend code or public NEXT PUBLIC variables.

crm-heic-nie-wyswietla-zdjec.title: HEIC photos from iPhone do not appear in CRM
crm-heic-nie-wyswietla-zdjec.description: Why do HEIC files work on iPhone but not in every browser? Preview, conversion and Mime.
crm-heic-nie-wyswietla-zdjec.intro: The user adds a photo from the phone and sees the attachment, but the preview is empty.

sections.title: Why is this happening?

sections.title: Step by step solution
paragraphs: 1. Check Content-Type header and actual format based on file content.
2 . Separate the original storage from generating the thumbnail to preview.
3 . For browsers without support, convert the file to JPEG or WebP on the trusted service side or on upload.
4 . Limit maximum file size, remove unnecessary location metadata and handle conversion errors.
5 . Test the preview on iOS Safari, Android Chrome and desktop and let me download the original.

sections.title: How do I check the score?
paragraphs: After upload the user sees the thumbnail and the attachment retains the correct type; the error does not result in losing the file.
Do not treat the file extension itself as a reliable security validation.

crm-kolejka-zadan-spoznia-sie.title: Callback queue shows overdue tasks incorrectly
crm-kolejka-zadan-spoznia-sie.description: The callback line has the wrong order or skips the deadlines? Time zones, statuses and sorting.
crm-kolejka-zadan-spoznia-sie.intro: The task scheduled for today is due tomorrow or disappears after a change of date, and the list of backlogs is inconsistent.

sections.title: Why is this happening?
paragraphs: Mixing UTC time and local time, lack of unambiguous ending status or sorting of dates saved as text cause wrong queues.

sections.title: Step by step solution
paragraphs: 1. Save the term as a time value with a clear time zone and display it in the employee zone.
2 . Distinguish scheduled, overdue, executed and cancelled tasks.
3 . Compare the date filter on the server with local formatting in the browser, especially when changing time.
4 . Set a stable sorting after the deadline and ID, not after the string displayed to the user.
5 . Test the dates before midnight, after midnight and during summer time changes.

sections.title: How do I check the score?
paragraphs: The test term appears at the right time on different devices and does not disappear after refresh.
Do not arbitrarily add one or two hours to the date to mask the time zone error.

crm-lead-niewidoczny-po-usunieciu-blokad.title: The trader can't see the lead after removing the lock — RLS diagnostics and permissions
crm-lead-niewidoczny-po-usunieciu-blokad.description: After removing the lead lock still invisible to the trader. The most common causes: RLS policies (USING/WIGHT CHECK), inappropriate claims JWT/role, no GRANT SELECT or frontend filter. Specific tests and corrective steps.
crm-lead-niewidoczny-po-usunieciu-blokad.intro: Problem: After removing the blocked field or status flag in CRM, the trader still does not see the record. This is a typical symptom of the Row-Level Security layer, incorrect permissions or discrepancies between the user token and the policy condition. Instead of just unlocking the record, you need to check the RLS policies in the database, assigning the record owner, mapping claims in the JWT token used by the application and whether there are additional filters on the API/ORM side. The following text leads through differential analysis, specific diagnostic steps and tests in the Supabase/Postgres environment and a list of typical traps to check.

sections.title: How to Recognize Cause
paragraphs: Check that the RLS lead table is enabled (row security = on). If RLS disabled, the problem can lie on the application side or cache. If enabled, the next suspects are SELECT policy: the USING condition determines whether the line is visible and WITH CHECK decides on INSERT/UPDATE. Often the condition refers to claims jwt (auth.uid, roles) and changing the blocked flag does not affect the expr.

Examine token trading session and claims values (sub, roles, user id). A popular error is the mismatch of the owner's fields in the table (owner id) and claimu in the token (auth.uid or sub). Another common case is an outdated token after changing roles: JWT may still have an old role, so the row only meets USING for a new role.

Finally, check whether the intermediate layer API (REST, GraphQL, ORM) does not use additional filters (e.g. where: {signed to: currentUser }) or whether the client does not cache the results. Also transactions or no commit after a status change may make the change not visible for another connection.

sections.title: Step by step solution
paragraphs: 1. Confirm that RLS is enabled: in psql run SELECT remotesecurity FROM pg class WHERE relname='leads'; if true, continue; if false, check GRANT permissions and application logic.

2 . Log in as a merchant in the context of the database (simulate JWT/SET ROLE). In Supabase, use policy test tool or in psql: SET LOCAL role = 'anon' is not enough – instead, run a query with the appropriate jwt claims or use RLS-tables test hardness. Read current setting('jwt.claims') if used.

3 . Read RLS policies: SELECT pol.polname, pol.polpermissive, pg get expr(pol.polqual, pol.polrelid) AS using, pg get expr(pol.polwithcheck, pol.polrelid) AS withcheck FROM pg policy pol JOIN pg class c ON polrelid=c.oid WHERE c.relname='leads'; Analyze USING and WITH CHECK expressions with respect to blocked field and owner id.

4 . Compare Owner id/assigned to in line with values in token: SELECT id, owner id, assigned to, blocked FROM leads WHERE id = <ilead>; then verify jwt.claims.sub and /or roles in token. If the values don't match, or the politics refer to another field, that's the reason.

5 . Check if the Token trader has current roles: in Subabase -> Authentication -> See JWT or syslogs. If the role has been changed recently, force a refresh of the token (re-login). Test: Make a request with a new token and compare the response.

6 . Test queries without RLS: temporarily disable RLS for this table or perform the query as superuser: SET ROLE postgres; SELECT ... FROM leads WHERE id=...; if the record is visible, cause is RLS policy; if still invisible, check application filtering or record status.

7 . Check the application layer: in backend logs identify SQL queries generated by ORM (e.g. Prisma, Hasura); make sure there is no extra WHE (assigned to = null) or pagination, and that there is no wrong projection that hides records.

sections.title: How to see if the problem is gone
paragraphs: Test 1: Manual simulation — sign in as a trader, refresh the token, run SELECT id FROM leads WHERE id=< problem> in the context of this token (or use a supabase policy simulator). The result should change from empty to one line; if not, check the USING expression.

Test 2: superuser bypass — perform SELECT as superuser (SET ROLE postgres) to confirm that the record exists and the field blocked set correctly. If the superuser sees the record, the error concerns RLS/policy/claims; if he can't see, the data or transaction side issue.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not assume that the blocked field photo removes other policy conditions — USING policy can check assigned to or related status; changing one field does not guarantee visibility.
Don’t just test with the admin account — the superuser always sees the record, it’s a false sense of solution. Test with real JWT trader or policy simulator.
Don’t forget about caches and tokens — no JWT refresh after changing roles or caching frontend answers can mask the repair effect.

crm-licznik-leadow-nie-zgadza-sie-z-list.title: CRM shows 180 lead, but there is less on the list — how to fix it?
crm-licznik-leadow-nie-zgadza-sie-z-list.description: The CRM contact counter disagrees with the list? Check filters, pagination, RLS permissions and counting queries.
crm-licznik-leadow-nie-zgadza-sie-z-list.intro: The panel shows 180 contacts, but the trader sees only part. Such a problem arose in the analysis of the B-CRM operation. The counter itself does not prove that all records are available to the logged person.

sections.title: Why is this happening?
paragraphs: The counter can come from a different query than the list: include the archive, do not use filters, use a different range of RLS, or count all records despite pagination. First figure out exactly what the number represents.

sections.title: Step by step solution
paragraphs: 1. Save the role, user login ID, active tab and filters. Compare the same conditions in the counter and leaves.
2 . Disable search, status filter, hiding locked and archive. See if the list recovers the missing positions.
3 . Examine pagination: Does the interface only download the first 50 or 100 records and the numerator shows all? Check the following pages and limit the API response.
4 . Compare the request count with the list request, including the conditions for assigning the trader and RLS policy. Do not circumvent RLS key service roles in your browser.
5 . Add integration test: a merchant, manager and administrator account sees the right records and a consistent counter at the same filter.

sections.title: How do I check the score?
paragraphs: After passing all pages, the sum of visible records for a particular filter agrees with the numerator. Separately verify the total number in the database, because it may have a different range.
Do not correct the problem by replacing the counter with the first page length. It hides the difference instead of fixing the visibility rules.

crm-na-zamowienie-czy-gotowy.title: CRM on request or ready system — what to choose?
crm-na-zamowienie-czy-gotowy.description: When you need a ready-to-use CRM, when it is worth building your own and how to check your costs, permissions and data migration.
crm-na-zamowienie-czy-gotowy.intro: Ready CRM is a good start when a company needs a standard contact list, sales stages and reminders. A custom system is worth considering when specific processes, roles or integrations are difficult to map in available tools. The fact that the sheet has become uncomfortable does not mean the need to build your own application.

sections.title: First describe the process, then select the tool
paragraphs: Write the path of one question: where does it come from, who receives it, when it changes its status and who it is passed on to? Save what data are needed at each stage and which information should only be available to selected persons.

Indicate three problems that the system is going to solve. These may be lost phones, lack of a history of findings or manually transcribing data to offers. Such a list gives tool assessment criteria better than the number of functions on the manufacturer's website.

sections.title: When to choose a ready-made CRM?
paragraphs: When the process is typical, a quick start is important, and integrations are already available. Check the trial version on a few examples. Count the cost for the actual number of users and make sure that the necessary automation does not require a more expensive plan.

Check the export of data and attachments, backups, permissions and contract termination conditions. When assessing the price, take into account the implementation and time of the team, not only the monthly subscription.

sections.title: When is your own system justified?
paragraphs: When many departments handle the same case, you need unusual rights or the process involves sales, funding and implementation. Your own application allows you to build views and transitions tailored to this work, but requires a budget for maintenance, updates and development.

Cooperation with the Re-energy System included website, advertising and CRM. I share B-CRM separately as a demonstration of work with roles and stages of service. It's a demo to know the possibilities — customer data and access are not part of it.

sections.title: What should be in the first version?
paragraphs: Usually it is worth starting with a list of cases, assigning a maintainer, status, history of changes and permissions. Only after the complete process by users develop reports and automation. The scope of the first version depends on which tasks actually block the team.

Before importing, order duplicates and agree on the meaning of fields. First check migration on the sample, save a copy of the source and specify how to return to the previous process. The permissions must operate on the server side, not just hide the buttons on the screen.

sections.title: How to prepare a CRM interview?
paragraphs: Prepare the number of users, roles list, operating stages, current tools and required integrations. Show an anonymous case example instead of sending real customer data. Specify the information to be exported and who is responsible for maintenance.
Write to kacper@bernecki.dev, what you do by hand today and where you waste the most time. We can start with one process and then expand the application.

crm-odblokowany-lead-nadal-niewidoczny.title: I unlock the lead at CRM, but the trader can't see it.
crm-odblokowany-lead-nadal-niewidoczny.description: What to check when after removing the lead lock does not return to the merchant list: status, assignment, RLS and refresh.
crm-odblokowany-lead-nadal-niewidoczny.intro: The administrator unlocks the contact, and the dealer does not appear in the panel. A similar symptom was reported in B-CRM for queue and contact block.

sections.title: Why is this happening?
paragraphs: Unlocking is changing one flag. The contact may have a different assignment, hidden status, be outside the page window or the list may use an old cache.

sections.title: Step by step solution
paragraphs: 1. Check the database record after removing the lock: record ID, lock flag, status and current maintainer.
2 . Compare the trader list request with the administrator request. Establish which WHERE terms exclude the record.
3 . Check SELECT RLS policy for the target user. The UPDATE itself made by the administrator does not mean that the trader can now perform SELECT.
4 . Refresh the data from the server after mutation or cancel the query cache. Also test the full reloading of the page.
5 . Add flow test: locking, unlocking, reassigning, commercial entry and visibility in the right queue.

sections.title: How do I check the score?
paragraphs: The trader sees the unlocked lead without manual mixing with filters, and another trader without permission does not see it.
Do not extend RLS policies to all records just to make a given lead appear.

crm-paginacja-pokazuje-tylko-pierwsze-le.title: CRM shows only the first 100 leads — Supabase Pagination
crm-paginacja-pokazuje-tylko-pierwsze-le.description: Why don't some of the records reach React? Response limits Supabase, range, sorting and consistent counter.
crm-paginacja-pokazuje-tylko-pierwsze-le.intro: There are a lot of contacts in the database, but after changing or searching in CRM you can only see the first batch.

sections.title: Why is this happening?
paragraphs: Frontend can download a single data range and filter only locally, and the user thinks he is searching the entire database.

sections.title: Step by step solution
paragraphs: 1. Compare count in the database with the number of records actually returned by the query.
2 . Enter a public page on the server side with range or limit and offset, depending on the API used.
3 . Add stable sorting with second key, e.g. date and ID, so records with identical dates do not jump between pages.
4 . Search for text and filters before pagination on the query side, not up to 100 already downloaded lines.
5 . Support next pages, empty score, network error, and reset page number after changing the filter.

sections.title: How do I check the score?
paragraphs: The last test set record is available and the search finds it without having to scroll all pages.
Check the default limits and configuration of a particular project in the Subbase panel. Do not assume that every installation has an identical limit.

crm-phone-e164-invalid-country-code.title: CRM: phone number from Poland does not work when calling back automatically
crm-phone-e164-invalid-country-code.description: The number is recorded in the database, but telephone integration rejects the format without country code.
crm-phone-e164-invalid-country-code.intro: The number is recorded in the database, but telephone integration rejects the format without country code. The cause needs to be checked in the real environment.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check the normalization of the number and see if the +48 sign has not been added twice.
Compare record ID, current filters, roles and database query result with panel view.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Store the number in the agreed E.164 format and keep the original diagnostic record.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: Integration correctly dials a number from Poland and does not accidentally change foreign numbers.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Run tests on anonymized data and control server side permissions, not just on the interface.

crm-powtorne-przypisanie-tworzy-duplikat.title: Reassigning a lead creates a duplicate — how do I find an error?
crm-powtorne-przypisanie-tworzy-duplikat.description: Instead of updating the CRM maintainer, it creates a second record. How to separate INSERT and UPDATE and allocation history.
crm-powtorne-przypisanie-tworzy-duplikat.intro: After the customer is transferred between traders, two similar positions or two telephone tasks are created.

sections.title: Why is this happening?
paragraphs: An interface or automatic can create a new lead when changing the maintainer, instead of updating the existing record and adding the history event.

sections.title: Step by step solution
paragraphs: 1. Compare the IDs of the two positions. If different, check the data path.
2 . When changing the maintainer, perform UPDATE the existing lead, and save the history in a separate event table.
3 . Block multiple sending of the same mutation at two clicks and resume requests.
4 . Add a transfer integration test between three employees.
5 . Control deduplication with webhooks regardless of the manual allocation mechanism.

sections.title: How do I check the score?
paragraphs: The record retains the same ID, and the story shows previous maintainers without a second copy of the client.
Do not automatically delete one of the two entries without checking his comments and contact history.

crm-przypisanie-leadow-nie-aktualizuje-l.title: I assigned the lead to the employee, but he can't see them — 5 checks
crm-przypisanie-leadow-nie-aktualizuje-l.description: How to diagnose misalignment of lead in CRM and dispersal between the administrator panel and the trader.
crm-przypisanie-leadow-nie-aktualizuje-l.intro: After manually assigning a group of leads, the employee counter grows, but there are no new contacts on his list.

sections.title: Why is this happening?
paragraphs: Errors can be in mapping IDs, the difference between ownership id and assignee id or an unrefreshed query. The name displayed in the interface is not a stable identifier.

sections.title: Step by step solution
paragraphs: 1. Check the owner id and assignee id database on one specific lead. Compare them to the employee account ID.
2 . Determine whether the allocation is recorded in the correct field used by the trader list.
3 . Test one lead, then the party. Collect the number of successful and unsuccessful updates for mass operations.
4 . Verify access conditions and filter for hiding archival or locked records.
5 . When assigned, force refresh of the list and counter and show the administrator the actual result of the operation.

sections.title: How do I check the score?
paragraphs: The test lead appears on the appropriate page of the assigned employee; after changing the maintainer it disappears from the previous list if this is the permission model.
Do not assign by user name: two people may have the same name or change their name.

crm-pwa-powiadomienia-nie-przychodza.title: PWA notifications do not come on the phone — CRM and Web Push
crm-pwa-powiadomienia-nie-przychodza.description: No push in the PWA app? Check permissions, service worker, subscription token and iOS behavior.
crm-pwa-powiadomienia-nie-przychodza.intro: CRM works in the browser, but the trader does not receive notifications of new tasks or calls back.

sections.title: Why is this happening?
paragraphs: Web Push requires browser support, consent, correct subscription and delivery of messages through the server. On iOS, the way PWA is started and installed is important.

sections.title: Step by step solution
paragraphs: 1. Check the device, system, browser and whether the application has been added to the initial screen when required.
2 . Confirm site notifications and system permissions.
3 . Verify the active employee service registration and the correctness of the subscription endpoint.
4 . On the server side, check the push service response, VAPID errors, and delete outdated subscriptions.
5 . Send one test notification on a closed and open application, measuring not only the upload, but the actual delivery.

sections.title: How do I check the score?
paragraphs: A test notification comes on the target device; when you click, it opens the right record according to permissions.
Do not send sensitive customer data to the lock screen in the notification content.

crm-rezygnacja-archiwum-czy-usuwanie.title: Client cancellation in CRM: archive or delete record?
crm-rezygnacja-archiwum-czy-usuwanie.description: How to preserve the history of contracts and lead after resignation, while not showing them in active sales.
crm-rezygnacja-archiwum-czy-usuwanie.intro: Resignations mix with active contracts or disappear without the possibility of later explaining history.

sections.title: Why is this happening?
paragraphs: Removing the record and setting the archival status means completely different. The archive must also take into account retention and the scope of the powers.

sections.title: Step by step solution
paragraphs: 1. Define a separate status or archived at instead of physically erasing records in normal workflow.
2 . Separate the active list from the archive in queries, but retain audit privileges.
3 . Save who, when and why changed status, according to the principle of data minimisation.
4 . Test the meters: active cases should not include the archive, if this is how you describe them.
5 . Define retention and deletion procedure when there is no basis for further processing.

sections.title: How do I check the score?
paragraphs: The resignation is not visible in the current line of the trader, but the authorized administrator can find its story.
The archive does not mean the right to retain personal data without time.

crm-termin-montazu-nie-widoczny.title: The timing of the assembly is in CRM, but the trader can't see it
crm-termin-montazu-nie-widoczny.description: How to separate contract rights, schedule and assembly fields without hiding the necessary dates.
crm-termin-montazu-nie-widoczny.intro: The administrator sets the deadline, but the person leading the client does not see the current date.

sections.title: Why is this happening?
paragraphs: The rules for hiding fields are often too broad: the entire implementation panel hidden from the trader also hides the information he needs.

sections.title: Step by step solution
paragraphs: 1. List which fields are purely administrative and which traders should have read only.
2 . Check if the date comes from the same record or link that updates the administrator.
3 . Separate the date reading from the editing option; hiding the button cannot be the only recording lock.
4 . Verify SELECT and UPDATE rights on the server and the range of data returned in the API.
5 . Test the date change, cancel and notify the seller of the update.

sections.title: How do I check the score?
paragraphs: The trader sees the current date without access to hidden administrative checkboxes and without the possibility of unauthorized editing.
Do not copy the term to the second manually updated field, because there will quickly be discrepancies.

domena-email-spf-dkim-dmarc-problemy.title: SPF, DKIM, DMARC: domain sends emails, but recipients have spam
domena-email-spf-dkim-dmarc-problemy.description: How to check SPF, DKIM and DMARC records when messages from their own domain do not reach or reach spam.
domena-email-spf-dkim-dmarc-problemy.intro: The messages come out of the company domain, but the recipients do not get them or see warnings about the sender.

sections.title: Why is there a problem?
paragraphs: Invalid domain authentication and failure of From to server configuration undermine the reliability of delivery.

sections.title: Diagnostics and solutions
paragraphs: 1. Set up all legal suppliers sending from the domain: mail, forms, newsletter and CRM.
2 . Check if there is one correct SPF record and DKIM keys compatible with suppliers.
3 . Configure DMARC in stages, starting with the observation of the reports if the organization is not yet fully controlled.
4 . Send the test to several boxes and watch the SPF, DKIM and DMARC score in the headers.
5 . Repair incompatible shipping sources and monitor reports before tightening the DMARC policy.

sections.title: How to check and avoid what?
paragraphs: Authorised messages pass authentication checks and reach recipients without new errors.
Do not add several SPF records for one domain name; this is a common cause of the SPF error.

facebook-ads-jak-obliczyc-sredni-cpl-kam.title: How do I calculate the average CPL of Meta Ads 10 campaign without error?
facebook-ads-jak-obliczyc-sredni-cpl-kam.description: Average cost of lead calculated by weighted method. Why a simple CPL average from the campaign can mislead.
facebook-ads-jak-obliczyc-sredni-cpl-kam.intro: The report includes several campaigns with different budgets and lead numbers; the average of their CPL yields a confusing result.

sections.title: The Most Important Cause
paragraphs: The cost of contact is the product of total expenditure and total number of results. A small campaign with two leads shouldn't weigh as much as a big 200.

sections.title: Practical procedure
paragraphs: 1. For the compared period, collect expenses and the number of leads of each campaign.
2 . Check if the result in all campaigns means the same type of contact.
3 . Include expenses and separate lead numbers.
4 . Divide total expenditure by total number of lead; do not average unit CPLs.
5 . In addition, count the cost of qualified lead and customer if you have reliable CRM data.

sections.title: How do I confirm the result?
paragraphs: The combined CPL agrees with the sum ratio and the scope and definition of the result are public.
If the campaign has zero lead, do not try to count its individual CPL by dividing by zero.

facebook-lead-ads-integracja-z-crm.title: Facebook Lead Ads and CRM — How Can You Don't Lose Advertising Contacts?
facebook-lead-ads-integracja-z-crm.description: Transmission of Meta Lead Ads forms to CRM: allowances, duplicates, statuses, contact time and permission control. Practical guide for companies.
facebook-lead-ads-integracja-z-crm.intro: After sending the advertising form, the work is just beginning. The contact should be in the place where the trader sees him, calls and records the result. Manual copying leads from Meta to sheet makes it difficult to control and increases the risk of omissions.

sections.title: What should happen after sending the form?
paragraphs: The system should accept data from the form, save the source of the notification, date and properly create contact. If the message fails, you need a clear alert and the possibility of reopening the operation. Automation cannot mean a silent loss of lead.
It is important to specify immediately the person responsible for the contact, the queue of new cases and the way in which the deadline for calling back is to be determined.

sections.title: How does assigning lead to traders work?
paragraphs: The company can distribute contacts by location, type of product, on-call or manual decision of the manager. It is important that the rules are written, and the change of attribution does not remove contact and comment history.
The trader should see his tasks and behind affairs, and the supervisor should see the collective state of the queue. Access to customer data is limited to roles that really need it.

sections.title: Duplicates, incorrect numbers and data quality
paragraphs: The same person may send the form several times or be interested in various services. Without deduplication rules, CRM can create several unrelated entries. Connecting contacts requires caution: the same number does not always mean the same person.
Good forms should not collect excess data. It is also necessary to specify retention, the legal basis for processing and how the requests of data subjects are handled.

sections.title: How to measure efficiency on the sales side?
paragraphs: Combine results with Meta with number of contact attempts, received calls, offers and signed contracts. The cost of the form itself will not show whether the campaign contributes to the sale.
Even a simple report with first contact times and reasons for rejection of the lead helps distinguish between the problem of advertising and the problem of handling queries.

sections.title: When to build your own integration?
paragraphs: Ready integration can be sufficient when the process is simple. Your own application may make sense with many roles, custom assignments, automation, contracts and implementation control.
An example of a system developed for the commercial process is B-CRM. It is worth starting with a map of data flow and test on fictitious contacts before connecting production forms.

favicon-stara-ikona-google-safari.title: I changed favicon, but Google and Safari show the old icon
favicon-stara-ikona-google-safari.description: Why does favicon not update in Google cards, bookmarks and results? Cache, format and icon addresses.
favicon-stara-ikona-google-safari.intro: After changing the logotype, the page still displays the previous symbol in the search results or tabs.

sections.title: Where's the problem coming from?
paragraphs: Browsers and search engines cache icons independently of HTML. Additionally, the site can still enter the old favicon address in metadata.

sections.title: What to do step by step?
paragraphs: 1. Open HTML source and check rel=icon, apple-touch-icon and manifesto.
2 . Check if the indicated files actually contain a new character and return code 200.
3 . Change the version of the icon address or filename if the resource was long cached.
4 . Check locally in private and on another device.
5 . For Google, verify the favicon requirements and give the robot time to download again.

sections.title: Correction test and important trap

formularz-meta-ads-czy-landing-page.title: Meta Lead Ads Form or Landing Page — What Better for the Company?
formularz-meta-ads-czy-landing-page.description: Comparison of Facebook and Instagram Ads forms with Landing page: contact cost, quality of applications, analyst, speed and CRM integration.
formularz-meta-ads-czy-landing-page.intro: The advertising form makes it easy to quickly send a query without leaving Facebook or Instagram. Landing page gives more room to explain the offer and show the execution. The choice depends on the purpose and the sales process.

sections.title: When should I start with the Meta form?
paragraphs: If the offer is simple and the recipient understands what the notification is, the native form may limit the number of steps. This is especially useful for services whose first stage is telephone call.
However, do not assume that a lower cost of the form means a better business result. Part of the inquiries may be accidental or do not correspond to the terms of the tender.

sections.title: When does the landing page have the advantage?
paragraphs: With complex and expensive products, the customer may need a comparison of variants, implementation pictures, answers to questions and principles of cooperation. A separate page also allows to present organic content and supports SEO.
Landing requires efficient operation on phones, clear CTA and check the correctness of the form. Inconsistency in advertising and pages can significantly reduce the number of queries.

sections.title: How can we compare both ways honestly?
paragraphs: Compare not only CPL, but also the percentage of correct contacts, the number of real conversations and the value of transactions. Different target groups or advertising content may impair the comparison.
It is worth adopting the definition of qualified contact in advance and establishing a uniform way of continuing to operate both sources in CRM.

sections.title: The technical basis of the campaign
paragraphs: For Meta form, take care of legal information about personal data and secure downloading of applications. For landing page add correct metadata, basic analysis and proper consent management.
Before taking off, test the sending of a test report and whether it reaches the right person. Even the best-designed campaign won't help if the lead goes missing.

sections.title: What do I suggest to companies?
paragraphs: Instead of taking one method as mandatory, I choose a solution for industry, budget and commercial needs. It often makes sense to test the native form and the well prepared page in parallel.
We can start by analyzing the offer and the current source of queries and then determine how to measure the quality of the lead.

sections.title: Why is there a problem?
paragraphs: The error can lie in validation, endpoint, ENV, email provider or UI itself, which displays success without recording confirmation.

sections.title: Diagnostics and solutions
paragraphs: 1. In DevTools Network, check if a request is sent and what HTTP code returns after clicking.
2 . Compare browser validation with server validation; don't just trust required in HTML.
3 . Check the runtime logs endpoint, execution time and reply of the mail provider or CRM.
4 . Separate the success of saving the application from the success of sending the email and add the re-support.
5 . Run a test with fictitious data from your phone and desktop; also check spam protection.

sections.title: How to check and avoid what?
paragraphs: The test report is saved or delivered in the target system, and the user receives a message consistent with the actual result.
Toast 'sent' before receiving server response gives a false sense of success.

formularz-strony-wiadomosci-spam.title: Messages from the page form go to spam
formularz-strony-wiadomosci-spam.description: The message “sent” on the page can only mean accepting the request by the server. Delivering to the box requires separate checking of the supplier's logs after
formularz-strony-wiadomosci-spam.intro: The message “sent” on the page can only mean accepting the request by the server. The delivery to the mailbox requires a separate check of the email provider's logs and domain configuration.

sections.title: Step by step
paragraphs: 1. Send a test with a unique subject and check the endpoint response. Then find the message ID from the supplier. Do not diagnose based solely on button animation.
2 . In From, use the verified domain you control. Address of the person filling out the form put in Reply-To; impersonating its domain can cause rejection.
3 . Check SPF and DKIM according to the instructions of the mail provider. Do not create several independent SPF records under the same name. Check DNS changes with TTL.
4 . Rate DMARC's compatibility with the sender domain and open the full headers of the message delivered. Do not tighten up domain policy without checking all mailing services.
5 . Test various inboxes, including spam and company quarantine. The form should keep the data in error and show an alternative way of contact.

sections.title: How to check whether the amendment works
paragraphs: Confirm delivery status with the supplier and the presence of messages in the mailbox. Authentication configuration helps, but does not guarantee the root folder in each service. Secure the form with limits and protection against automatic dispatch.
