github-merge-conflict-rownolegla-praca-n.title: GitHub: merge conflict when two people change the same page
github-merge-conflict-rownolegla-praca-n.description: Two parallel commites changed the same file? How to keep both amendments, solve conflict and not overwrite the work of the other person.
github-merge-conflict-rownolegla-praca-n.intro: The merge conflict does not mean a damaged repository. Git cannot choose between two changes of the same passage. The biggest risk is to replace the entire file with one version, which makes the work of the other person disappear.

sections.title: How to Recognize Cause
paragraphs: Open pull request and check the list of conflict files. Determine which branch is the target and whether someone added another commits to it during your work. Save the last commit identifier before taking action.

Compare both files and the history of changes, not just the CONFLICT message. The conflict may affect several lines, but different sessions can also update dependent files at the same time, such as articles directory and site map.

sections.title: Step by step solution
paragraphs: 1. Create a separate branch based on the current main. Don't do a push force on the main and delete other people's commites.
2 . Get the latest target branch changes. Open conflicting files and view both variants between HEAD tags, = = = == and the name of the second branch.

3 . Merge only those fragments that are really meant to coexist. For example, keep a new list of guidebooks, and search and pagination match to this list instead of restoring the old file in its entirety.
4 . Remove conflict tags, run lint, control types and tests. Also check the actual subpages, because the correct syntactically merge can still lose the function.
5 . Do commit solutions, update pull request and only after positive tests connect it to main. Before merging, check again that the branch has not been changed again.

sections.title: How to see if the problem is gone
paragraphs: The history of the project must contain both intended functionalities; the <<<<<<< or >>>>> tag cannot remain in the code. The repository scan should detect a zero number of such fragments.
Run the application and check the scenarios from both changes, e.g. a set of guides and search operation. The status itself 'mergeable' does not prove the correct behavior of the page.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not use automatic 'accept incoming' for the entire file if it contains independent fixes. You can remove content that cannot be reproduced from the current view.

google-business-weryfikacja-wideo-brak-f.title: Google wants to verify my video card, and I don't have a movie — what to do?
google-business-weryfikacja-wideo-brak-f.description: Verification of the Company Profile in Google via video. How to check available methods and required evidence.
google-business-weryfikacja-wideo-brak-f.intro: The panel requests a video recording, but the owner of the company does not have a recording or can not easily present the headquarters.

sections.title: The Most Important Cause
paragraphs: Google displays available verification methods depending on the profile. It is not always possible to switch them to another variant.

sections.title: Practical procedure
paragraphs: 1. Check the exact verification manual displayed in the panel, not the general list in the guide.
2 . Determine what real elements of the activity can be shown: equipment, marking or working tools, as instructed.
3 . Check that the panel offers an alternative method; do not assume that it is available to any company.
4 . If the recording is impossible, report the problem through the official support channel.
5 . Do not change your address or company category fictitiously just to force a different type of verification.

sections.title: How do I confirm the result?
paragraphs: The verification is carried out by a Google approved method, with real materials and correct company data.
A replacement verification cannot be guaranteed without video; the decision depends on Google.

google-business-wizytowka-bez-adresu-wer.title: Google without an address: how to verify a service company?
google-business-wizytowka-bez-adresu-wer.description: Google Company Profile without public office. Area of operation, hidden address and possible verification methods.
google-business-wizytowka-bez-adresu-wer.intro: The company serves customers at their premises, does not run a place accessible to visitors and does not want to enter an address in a business card.

sections.title: The Most Important Cause
paragraphs: Google distinguishes companies from locations for customers and companies operating in a specific area. The verification methods depend on the profile and are selected by the platform.

sections.title: Practical procedure
paragraphs: 1. Check the eligibility rules of the service company and whether the business meets the profile conditions.
2 . Set the type of activity and the area of service according to the actual activity.
3 . If you do not accept customers at the address, configure to hide the address according to Google rules.
4 . Select one of the verification methods available in the panel.
5 . When the verification is stuck, use official help and prepare real supporting material.

sections.title: How do I confirm the result?
paragraphs: The profile reflects real customer service rules and does not present a fictional premises.
Do not use virtual office or false address to circumvent verification requirements.

google-drive-integracja-cofniete-uprawni.title: Google Drive: integration worked, but the user revoked access
google-drive-integracja-cofniete-uprawni.description: How to safely rebuild the CRM connection to Disk after the permission has been revoked or folder permissions changed.
google-drive-integracja-cofniete-uprawni.intro: There are folders and document names in CRM, but opening or saving them suddenly stopped working.

sections.title: Why is there a problem?
paragraphs: The authorization can expire, the owner can change the permissions of the folder or the Workspace administrator limit the application.

sections.title: Diagnostics and solutions
paragraphs: 1. Separate the account authorization error from the permission error of a specific folder.
2 . Check on which account the integration works and on which account the folder is located.
3 . Confirm OAuth approval range and current Workspace rules, if applicable.
4 . After reauthorization, test the reading and recording separately.
5 . Add recording of the status of the connection and a visible message of need for re-approval.

sections.title: How to check and avoid what?
paragraphs: The new file is saved and opened and the user sees a readable message on the next withdrawal of the consent.
Do not give integration more powers than needed only to avoid error.

google-drive-oauth-invalid-grant-crm.title: Google Drive OAuth: invalid grant while refreshing token
google-drive-oauth-invalid-grant-crm.description: Invalid grant in Google Drive Integration. Causes: revoked consent, customer configuration and fresh token.
google-drive-oauth-invalid-grant-crm.intro: Trying to refresh access to Google Drive ends with invalid grant, and attachments in CRM are not synced.

sections.title: Why is there a problem?
paragraphs: Fresh token may be invalid after the consent has been revoked, the authorisation conditions changed or the OAuth application configuration problem.

sections.title: Diagnostics and solutions
paragraphs: 1. Check the error code and the time of the last successful sync without revealing secrets.
2 . Verify OAuth client, ranges and redirect URI for the right environment.
3 . Check that the application stores the correct refresh token on the server.
4 . When required, execute the user's consent again and test new access to the folder.
5 . Add the integration failure alert and the possibility of safe rewriting.

sections.title: How to check and avoid what?
paragraphs: OAuth gets access according to consent, the document is stored in the correct folder, and another attempt to renew the cannon.
Do not solve an error by entering a fresh token into a frontend file or sending it in logs.

google-search-console-nieprawidlowy-adre.title: Google Search Console: Invalid site map address — check what?
google-search-console-nieprawidlowy-adre.description: Search Console rejects sitemap.xml with an incorrect address message? Check service type, map path and XML availability.
google-search-console-nieprawidlowy-adre.intro: The message “The incorrect address of the site map” may appear already when you try to add a map in Google Search Console. On the authentic screenshot from the panel you can see the listed sitemap.xml and a warning requiring the correct path. The image itself confirms the message, but does not determine the cause. Start with the type of service in Search Console and whether the map is publicly available at the address assigned to the appropriate site.

sections.title: How to Recognize Cause
paragraphs: Check the exact service address in the Search Console property selector. Domain-type service includes protocols and subdomains other than a URL prefix service. Notice if the field of adding the map has already displayed a fragment of the base address.

Open full map address in the new window, for example https://your-domaina.pl/sitemap.xml. Check if the browser shows XML maps and the server returns HTTP 200, not 404, redirect to the login screen or HTML page with an error.

Compare the domain and map protocol with the actual site domain. Check the web variant, possible HTTP→HTTPs redirects and whether the site is under a different prefix than currently selected in Search Console.

sections.title: Step by step solution
paragraphs: 1. Enter Google Search Console and select the correct service from the list on the left. Open the Indexing section → Site Maps. Do not try to report a map for another domain or accidental version of the site.

2 . In the Add Map box see if the interface shows a part of the address. If so, specify the remaining correct path, such as sitemap.xml. If full URL is expected, enter the actual HTTPS address of the map. Don't duplicate the domain fragment.

3 . Verify the presence of file or route /sitemap.xml on the server. In Next.js App Router, the map can be generated by app/sitemap.ts; after changing the code, make sure the production defloyment includes a new route.

4 . Check that the map content is a valid XML with an address or canonical address of the actual subpages. The map must not only indicate non-existent addresses or the preview environment instead of production.

5 . If a map is available, but the form still rejects the value, switch to the right service, verify its type and try the correct full address or path corresponding to the field. Separate the validation problem of the form from the robot download error.

6 . After you have added the map correctly, go to the table of uploaded site maps, open its details and check the download status. Use the URL Inspection separately for one subpage to verify its indexing.

sections.title: How to see if the problem is gone
paragraphs: The form field accepts the correct path, the map goes to the list of maps sent, and its full address can be opened without logging in. This confirms the acceptance of the application, not the indexation of all parties.

After the next reading of Search Console, it should not show the map itself download error. If the status is still incorrect, check the detailed report and the server response, and do not assume that the problem concerns the content of the entire site.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not confuse the warning about the invalid address entered in the form with the later status “Unable to download”. It's two different stages of diagnostics.
Do not send multiple copies of the same map with random prefixes and do not promise immediate indexation after accepting the file.

google-sitemap-zgloszona-a-strony-brak.title: Sitemap sent to Google, but the pages are still not in the results
google-sitemap-zgloszona-a-strony-brak.description: Google Search Console adopted sitemap.xml, but the domain does not appear in the search engine. What's next?
google-sitemap-zgloszona-a-strony-brak.intro: Search Console shows a successful map message, but after entering a new page name it is difficult to find the result. This situation was analysed on company websites.

sections.title: The Most Important Cause
paragraphs: The site map indicates to the robot addresses, but is not a promise to index them. Google analyses the availability, duplication, quality and importance of content.

sections.title: Practical procedure
paragraphs: 1. In Search Console check the URL inspection for a specific address, not just the status of sitemap.
2 . Verify whether the page returns 200, is public and has no noindex.
3 . Check the canonical, redirect and link to the subpage from the existing navigation.
4 . Compare content with other subpages and remove unnecessary copies of text.
5 . After repairing, ask for a recheck and watch the indexing report instead of sending the same map multiple times.

sections.title: How do I confirm the result?
paragraphs: The address is available for the robot and has correct technical signals; the final decision about indexing belongs to the search engine.
Do not promise yourself or your client to immediately appear in the results just because the map has been accepted.

google-strona-nie-jest-zaindeksowana.title: The site works, but Google does not index it — check order
google-strona-nie-jest-zaindeksowana.description: Working domain and site map do not guarantee presence in the results. First check availability and technical signals, then quality and content connections.
google-strona-nie-jest-zaindeksowana.intro: Working domain and site map do not guarantee presence in the results. First check availability and technical signals, then quality and content connections.

sections.title: Step by step
paragraphs: 1. In Google Search Console, use the URL inspection for the exact protocol address and domain version. Read the reason for the exclusion and the given canonical address.
2 . Check HTTP status and redirection. The target page should operate without logging in. A server error, redirect loop or preview protection can block a robot.
3 . Read robots.txt, meta robots and the X-Robots-Tag header. Download lock and noindex command are different mechanisms. Just adding URL to sitemap does not remove any of them.
4 . Check the canonical and internal links. If several versions show the same content, Google can choose another. An important subpage should be accessible by a simple link from the site.

5 . After repair, ask to be rechecked at Search Console. With the status “detected” or “scanned but not indexed” evaluate the original value of the page and avoid making multiple copies of the text into a phrase variety.

sections.title: How to check whether the amendment works
paragraphs: Inspection should confirm availability and appropriate indexing signals. There is no term guaranteeing indexation or position. Reports update late; frequent re-renewal of the report will not replace the repair of the cause.

google-wybral-inny-adres-kanoniczny.title: Google chose a different canonical than I indicated — how to fix it?
google-wybral-inny-adres-kanoniczny.description: Duplicate URL and other canonical in Search Console. How to unify redirects, sitemap and link.
google-wybral-inny-adres-kanoniczny.intro: In Google Search Console, the Google-elected canonical address is different from that set on the page.

sections.title: The Most Important Cause
paragraphs: Canonical is a clue, and Google can choose another version when it sees conflicting signals between links, redirects and content.

sections.title: Practical procedure
paragraphs: 1. Compare both addresses and see if they show the same material.
2 . Verify relation=canonical in HTML of both pages and HTTP responses.
3 . Unify internal links, sitemap, hreflang and redirect to one version.
4 . Distinguish the actual duplicate from the pages that should have a separate valuable content.
5 . Recheck the data after recrawl and avoid massive changes without determining the cause.

sections.title: How do I confirm the result?
paragraphs: All important signals indicate the desired address, and unnecessary variants are not promoted by links.
Canonical is not a hard command for Google and does not replace a permanent redirection when the address is to be withdrawn.

google-wykryto-ale-nie-zindeksowano.title: Google: Discovered, but not indexed — Why No Crawl?
google-wykryto-ale-nie-zindeksowano.description: Discovered - currently not indexed at Search Console. How to check links, sitemap and server availability.
google-wykryto-ale-nie-zindeksowano.intro: Google knows the address of the new article, but the report shows no download.

sections.title: The Most Important Cause
paragraphs: The robot can postpone visiting the address, especially when the site has a lot of similar pages, poor link or periodic server problems.

sections.title: Practical procedure
paragraphs: 1. Check the correct URL, especially after domain changes and redirects.
2 . Rate server responses and site availability for unregistered users.
3 . Add natural links to categories and related articles.
4 . Only include canonical, valuable URLs in the sitemap.
5 . Wait for another download attempt and follow the logs and Search Console report.

sections.title: How do I confirm the result?
paragraphs: The robot has an accessible path to the address and the server does not block the download. There is no guaranteed crawl term.
Do not report the same address repeatedly as the sole SEO strategy.

google-zeskanowano-ale-nie-zindeksowano.title: Google: Scanned but not indexed — What can I improve?
google-zeskanowano-ale-nie-zindeksowano.description: Crawled - currently not indexed. How to recognize a problem of content, duplication or low value of the subpage.
google-zeskanowano-ale-nie-zindeksowano.intro: Google downloaded the subpage, but did not add it to the index.

sections.title: The Most Important Cause
paragraphs: The correct HTTP code itself does not guarantee that the search engine considers the site to be worth indexing. Repeatable or too poor content is a common problem.

sections.title: Practical procedure
paragraphs: 1. Open the URL Inspection and check the canonical version and the date of the last crawl.
2 . Compare the page with other articles: does it solve a separate problem and give concrete steps?
3 . Add your own examples, diagnostics, dumps or test result where they really exist.
4 . Strengthen internal linking with thematically close articles.
5 . After a significant update, ask for re-checking and monitor status without setting artificial dates.

sections.title: How do I confirm the result?
paragraphs: The site has unique, useful content and correct indexing signals, although Google's decision may still be negative.
Do not produce a few almost identical pages for one query to force presence in the index.

icloud-custom-domain-nie-ma-hasla.title: E -The email in iCloud's own domain does not have a separate password — how do I add it to Mac?
icloud-custom-domain-nie-ma-hasla.description: Custom iCloud+ address without new login and password. How an Apple account works and an app password for mail.
icloud-custom-domain-nie-ma-hasla.intro: The created address @twojadomena.pl acts as an alias iCloud, but when adding it to the email client there is a question about login and password.

sections.title: Why is there a problem?
paragraphs: Your own email address in iCloud Mail does not need to create a separate login account. The reception takes place in an existing Apple account; for some IMAP customers an application password is needed.

sections.title: Diagnostics and solutions
paragraphs: 1. On Mac, log in to Apple's proper account and turn on iCloud Post.
2 . Check that the domain address is added to your own domain settings and that it is displayed in the sender options.
3 . If you are using an external IMAP client, check Apple's official configuration and request an application password.
4 . Do not try to use the domain address as a completely new Apple account without need.
5 . Send a test message from the selected alias and check the answer.

sections.title: How to check and avoid what?
paragraphs: The mail is visible in the Mail app on Mac, and the new message can be sent from the appropriate domain address.
Do not reveal your password to Apple ID in an unknown client; use the official authentication method.

icloud-hide-my-email-nie-przekazuje.title: Hide my email address Apple does not send a message — what to check?
icloud-hide-my-email-nie-przekazuje.description: Alias Hide My Email does not transmit to Gmail or iCloud? Check your account, address and alias status.
icloud-hide-my-email-nie-przekazuje.intro: There are many random Apple addresses on the phone, but correspondence on some of them does not go to the expected box.

sections.title: Why is there a problem?
paragraphs: Hide My Email addresses may have different status and destination address. Interfaces on iPhone and iCloud can display different collections depending on the alias source.

sections.title: Diagnostics and solutions
paragraphs: 1. Find the exact alias used to register the service and see if it remains active.
2 . Verify the Apple account where the alias was created and the receiving address in the transfer settings.
3 . Search all folders, including spam, for sender and alias ID.
4 . Send a harmless test from the outer box and see if it will be passed.
5 . For important services, consider changing the contact address in the supplier's account to a permanently available address.

sections.title: How to check and avoid what?
paragraphs: A test for the right alias comes to the indicated box; verification messages also work for critical accounts.
Do not disable the alias used by logging in or retrieving your account until you change your address with your supplier.

icloud-wlasna-domena-maile-nie-dochodza.title: iCloud Mail: messages to address in your own domain do not arrive
icloud-wlasna-domena-maile-nie-dochodza.description: You have an e-mail @yourjadomena.pl in iCloud+, but nothing comes? Check MX, DKIM, alias, and transfer.
icloud-wlasna-domena-maile-nie-dochodza.intro: The address in the domain is added to iCloud+, but messages from external broadcasters do not appear in the mailbox. Such a problem occurred during the mail configuration at Bernecki.dev.

sections.title: Why is there a problem?
paragraphs: Just adding a domain to an Apple account does not end DNS configuration and specific addresses. MX errors, old hosting conflict or no active address block reception.

sections.title: Diagnostics and solutions
paragraphs: 1. Open iCloud+ and check if the domain and specific email address have active status.
2 . Verify current MX records and required TXT/CNAME records provided by Apple for the domain.
3 . Check that the domain does not use other nameser than the panel where you edit records.
4 . Send the test from an independent supplier and then check the unwanted folder and behavior of all devices.
5 . If the message reflects, read the SMTP code from the failure report. Do not make public the full headers with private data.

sections.title: How to check and avoid what?
paragraphs: Test messages from various external domains add to the right box and can be answered as your own address.
Do not delete DNS records blindly; MX and DKIM must correspond exactly to the service used for mail.

ile-kosztuje-lead-z-facebook-ads.title: How much does a Facebook Ads lead cost? CPL and true evaluation of advertising
ile-kosztuje-lead-z-facebook-ads.description: How to calculate the cost of lead with Meta Ads, what is different from CPL from CAC and why a cheap form does not always bring the customer. Example of RES campaign.
ile-kosztuje-lead-z-facebook-ads.intro: Cost of lead (CPL) is expenditure on campaigns divided by the number of contacts obtained. It's important, but not the only number. On the basis of the Meta Ads discharges available in one of the RES projects, 2 331 contacts and the average CPL can be demonstrated about PLN 29.79 in selected campaigns. This does not mean that this is exactly how much it costs to lead in every industry.

sections.title: CPL, the cost of qualified lead and CAC are different things
paragraphs: The CPL tells you how much it cost to generate a form or another defined contact. It doesn't confirm that a man has a real budget, picks up a phone or buys a service. For the calculation of a qualified lead, criteria must be agreed, e.g. correct number, interest in a specific offer and area of service.

CAC is the cost of obtaining the actual customer. It requires data from the entire process, not just from Meta Ads panel. To calculate it, you also need to know the number of contracts signed and the set range of sales and advertising costs.

sections.title: How do you calculate the average cost of contact without being told?
paragraphs: The expenditure of the same campaign shall be cumulated and divided by the sum of the contacts obtained. This is a weighted average of the number of results, not a simple average of the costs of individual campaigns. Thanks to this, a small campaign with several leads does not distort the image of a large campaign.

In the available discharges, the selected 17 lead campaigns had a total of 2,331 contacts and around PLN 69,4 thousand expenditure. This gives about PLN 29.79 per contact. The amounts displayed in thousands were rounded; discharges do not specify the date range, so they should not be attributed to a specific year.

sections.title: Why does contact cost depend on the industry?
paragraphs: The CPL is affected by the attractiveness of the offer, the degree of competition, the season, the area, the quality of the creation, the question of the form and the method of optimization. A service requiring a large investment may generate fewer forms but require better qualifications.
There is no one credible CPL rate for all Facebook or Instagram. In comparison, campaigns with a similar objective and definition of the result should be compiled.

sections.title: What to check when Meta shows cheap leady and sales stand?
paragraphs: Start with the percentage of calls received, contact speed, number updates and user expectations compliance with the offer. Then compare the advertising content with the questions of the form and the script of the first conversation.

If advertising works, but traders do not contact lead on time, the mere increase in the budget will probably not solve the problem. It is worth combining the forms with CRM and regularly analyze the service stages.

sections.title: See case study and prepare your own measurement
paragraphs: An example of Re-Energy System shows the importance of networking for RES industry. Data of 2 331 contacts and average cost of 29.79 zł come from selected campaigns at droplets provided by the owner; they are not information about the number of customers or the turnover attributed to advertising.

Before launching your own campaign, set the target, the area of service, the number of people in contact with lead, the method of assigning the source and the definition of qualified contact. For more information, see the case study Re-Energy System at the portfolio website.

ile-kosztuje-strona-internetowa.title: How much does a website cost for a small company?
ile-kosztuje-strona-internetowa.description: This affects the valuation of the party, how to compare offers and which maintenance costs to consider before the project begins.
ile-kosztuje-strona-internetowa.intro: The price of the site depends on what to do, who prepares the materials and what systems to connect. To compare two valuations, first compare the range. One page with offer and contact is a different order than a service with calculator, several languages and a panel for editing.

sections.title: What changes the valuation the most?
paragraphs: The number of subpages is just the beginning. Individual graphic design, preparation of texts and photographs, language versions, forms and integrations are important. The sending form requires less work than the form that records the request in the CRM, assigns the maintainer and sends a confirmation.

It is also worth describing the service of the website after publication. If you want to change your offer and add executions yourself, include the editing panel and instructions. If the content changes rarely, a simpler page can suffice.

sections.title: Three ranges to distinguish
paragraphs: Landing page focuses on one offer and one share: a query, a reservation or a purchase. Checks as a campaign page or first presentation of a new service.

The company website organizes several services, contractor information, realizations and contact. It gives space for separate answers to customer questions and expansion of content in the search engine.

The service with business features includes, for example, a calculator, bookings, user accounts or integration with CRM. In this variant you also have to value logic, safety and error handling. In my portfolio, StarCars shows a service page with a calculator and Motomizer shows a product presentation.

sections.title: How do you compare the offers of contractors?
paragraphs: Ask for design, implementation, content, mobile tests, amendments and publications. Find out who creates domain accounts and hosting, who has access to them and what you receive when you complete your cooperation. Ask if the price includes analytics configuration and basic indexing preparation.

The budget includes domain renewal, hosting and possibly paid tools. Advertising, regular content management and further development usually require a separate scope. The low start price does not yet say how much it will cost to maintain the whole.

sections.title: How to reduce costs without compromising the most important functions?
paragraphs: Start with one well described offer, visible contact and necessary forms. Collect logos, photos, service descriptions and implementation examples before you start designing. Set separately the functions necessary for take-off and those that can wait.
Do not give up tests on your phone or check the way of the request from the form to the recipient. Even a small page should allow the customer to find an offer and contact you effectively.

sections.title: What do you want me to send to the valuation?
paragraphs: Describe the industry, main offer, customers, planned subpages and functions. Join the current website if you have it, and two examples of the stylistics you like. Write what materials are ready, what date and indicative budget you have.

I value the determined range individually. This information allows you to propose a sensible first version and indicate what can be implemented later. Write to kacper@bernecki.dev with the theme “Party Valuation”.

mail-dkim-signature-fail.title: DKIM fail after changing the message delivery system
mail-dkim-signature-fail.description: The messages come out, but the recipient at Authentication-Results shows dkim=fail.
mail-dkim-signature-fail.intro: The messages come out, but the recipient at Authentication-Results shows dkim=fail. The signature may be verified with a key other than that published in the DNS or the content has been changed after signature.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Check the domain d= and selector s= from the header of the DKIM-Signature test message.
Compare the DNS selector record with the key configured with the shipping provider.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Publish the exact DKIM record indicated by the active supplier and test after propagation. Compare the shipping result from the same sender to two independent recipients to rule out the local filter problem.
2 . Disable unnecessary content modifications after signature or configure signing at the final transport stage.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: The new email shows dkim=pass and is signed by the expected domain. Also check that the signature includes the expected broadcast domain and is not replaced by the intermediary signature.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not copy someone else's private key to DNS public record.

mail-dmarc-alignment-fail.title: DMARC fail despite SPF pass and DKIM pass
mail-dmarc-alignment-fail.description: The headers show the SPF/DKIM credited, but the DMARC still does not pass.
mail-dmarc-alignment-fail.intro: The headers show the SPF/DKIM credited, but the DMARC still does not pass. DMARC requires domain compatibility in From with domain used by SPF or DKIM; the pass results themselves are not sufficient.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Check From address, Return-Path domain and signature d= for DKIM.
Read the  dmarc domain record and adkim/aspf settings, distinguishing compatibility relaxed from strict.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Configure the supplier so that at least one authentication mechanism is consistent with From domain. If the supplier sends through a technical domain, configure your own signature domain according to From address.
2 . Monitor DMARC reports before tightening your policy so as not to block legal broadcasters.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: The test message shows dmarc=pass and compatibility with the actual broadcast domain.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not set p=reject immediately if you do not have a full list of mailing systems.

mail-icloud-custom-domain-missing-addres.title: iCloud Mail: The own domain is connected, but the address does not receive
mail-icloud-custom-domain-missing-addres.description: The domain appears in iCloud+ settings, but the letters to the new address reflect or do not come.
mail-icloud-custom-domain-missing-addres.intro: The domain appears in iCloud+ settings, but the letters to the new address reflect or do not come. Uplinking the domain and creating a specific mail address are separate steps of configuration.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Check that the selected address exists at the appropriate Apple ID or family group.
Compare the required DNS iCloud records with the public domain zone and the actual inbox.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Create the required address in custom domain configuration and allow to propagate specified records.
2 . Test receipt and shipping from Apple Mail and then from an independent sender.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: The new address mail reaches the intended mailbox and can be sent a reply.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not assume that your own domain in iCloud automatically creates any number of logins and passwords.

mail-icloud-hide-my-email-forwarding.title: iCloud Hide My Email: hidden address does not send messages
mail-icloud-hide-my-email-forwarding.description: Alias exists in the settings, but the message does not reach the main box.
mail-icloud-hide-my-email-forwarding.intro: Alias exists in the settings, but the message does not reach the main box. Alias Hide My Email has its own transfer configuration, independent of the address from its own domain.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Check the status of the specific alias and the destination of the transfer address in the iCloud settings.
Send the test from an independent box and verify spam and mail filters.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Correct the assignment of the redirected recipient and make sure that the alias has not been deactivated. In the first test send a message about a unique subject and without attachments to recognize it in filters.
2 . For important correspondence, consider the direct address of your own domain if it does not require anonymity.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: The test email is transmitted to the correct mailbox without manually logging into an alias.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not treat Hide My Email as a regular IMAP account with a separate password.

mail-mx-record-points-old-host.title: Domain: incoming mail goes to the old supplier after migration
mail-mx-record-points-old-host.description: After the host is changed, the messages still hit the old server or return with a delivery error.
mail-mx-record-points-old-host.intro: After the host is changed, the messages still hit the old server or return with a delivery error. Public MX records can indicate the previous mail system regardless of the page domain setting.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Check the authoritative DNS zone and MX records with priorities for the right domain.
Compare them with the documentation of the new mail provider and check the record propagation time.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Set only the appropriate MX according to the supplier's instructions, keeping the SPF, DKIM and DMARC records needed.
2 . Do not remove old boxes or direct new messages into a vacuum until you have performed migration tests.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: The new box receives messages from two independent domains, and the answers return correctly.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not confuse MX records with A records for the website; they support different services.

mail-spf-permerror-multiple-records.title: SPF PermError: domain has two v=spf1 records
mail-spf-permerror-multiple-records.description: Some of the recipients reject the messages, although the DNS apparently contain correct SPF entries.
mail-spf-permerror-multiple-records.intro: Some of the recipients reject the messages, although the DNS apparently contain correct SPF entries. The publication of more than one SPF record for the same domain name causes a policy error.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Complete the TXT query for the domain and count the separate values starting with v=spf1.
Check the required include mechanisms for all services actually sending messages.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Combine to one correct SPF record with the required include and conscious final policy. Also check that the external provider has not added the second TXT automatically during the configuration of the new integration.
2 . Test the syntax and number of DNS cancellations and check the SPF score in the message test header.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: The recipient reports SPF pass for the permitted sender and does not report PermError.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not add a separate SPF record for each next supplier. Two TXT entries v=spf1 on the same name do not automatically merge into one policy.

2 . Add expiration monitoring and handle safe re-authorization on refusal.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: The call works with the new token, and after the expiry the system reports the controlled need for reconnection.

sections.title: What to do

meta-ads-reklama-aktywna-zero-wyswietlen.title: Meta Ads: active advertising, but has zero views
meta-ads-reklama-aktywna-zero-wyswietlen.description: The status is active, and the advertising doesn't reach people. What to check: schedule, budget, group, payments and status.
meta-ads-reklama-aktywna-zero-wyswietlen.intro: The panel shows green status active, but views statistics do not grow.

sections.title: The Most Important Cause
paragraphs: Delivery conditions may block emissions despite technical status. The reason is a schedule, limit, settlement or inadequate group configuration.

sections.title: Practical procedure
paragraphs: 1. Check campaign levels, a set of ads and advertising itself; statuses may vary.
2 . Verify start date, schedule and expenditure limits.
3 . Check your accounts and possible account restrictions.
4 . Rate the size of the audience, locations and too narrow exclusions.
5 . Compare the reporting period with the actual emissions time and the delay in statistics.

sections.title: How do I confirm the result?
paragraphs: Advertising starts generating actual displays after removing a fixed lock, without accidentally increasing costs.
Do not raise your budget in the dark if the problem is lack of permission or blocking your account.

meta-ads-reklama-odrzucona-co-robic.title: Meta Ads rejected the commercial — where to check the reason?
meta-ads-reklama-odrzucona-co-robic.description: Advertising rejected at Meta. How to check the rules, improve content and lodge an appeal without breaking the rules again.
meta-ads-reklama-odrzucona-co-robic.intro: The advertisement was working or was just created, but the panel shows rejection and the campaign does not move.

sections.title: The Most Important Cause
paragraphs: Meta may detect a breach of rules in text, graphics, offer or target page. The automatic decision may need to be verified.

sections.title: Practical procedure
paragraphs: 1. Read the exact rejection message and the related rule in the account quality panel.
2 . Check text, creation, form and landing page for this rule.
3 . Improve the real cause instead of mass duplicate advertising.
4 . If you think the decision is wrong, use the available verification procedure.
5 . After approval, check the delivery and compatibility of the final advertisement with the target page.

sections.title: How do I confirm the result?
paragraphs: Advertising has a correct status according to the rules of the platform and is provided or has a clearly indicated subsequent action.
Do not try to circumvent the rules by hiding content from the control system.

meta-ads-utm-nie-zapisuje-sie-crm.title: UTM from Meta ads does not register in CRM — where did the customer come from?
meta-ads-utm-nie-zapisuje-sie-crm.description: How to capture parameters utm source, utm campaign and click ID on the form and save the lead source.
meta-ads-utm-nie-zapisuje-sie-crm.intro: CRM has new applications, but the campaign source field is empty or for all entries has the same value.

sections.title: The Most Important Cause
paragraphs: URL parameters may disappear during navigation, the form does not save them or webhook only transmits contact details.

sections.title: Practical procedure
paragraphs: 1. Check if the target advertising URL actually contains the correct UTM parameters.
2 . Open the landing page with parameters and follow the entire path of the form by checking their maintenance.
3 . Add fields hidden or secure session status for attribution data, respecting the applicable privacy rules.
4 . Upload parameters to the server along with the form and save them at the record without overwriting the story.
5 . Compare Meta, analytics and CRM data on an artificial report with one test identifier.

sections.title: How do I confirm the result?
paragraphs: The test lead retains correct source and campaign, and the lack of UTM does not lead to a fake campaign.
UTM describes the source of the entry, but is not in itself proof that the advertising has led to the sale.

meta-ads-wydatki-rosna-brak-sprzedazy.title: Meta Ads spends a budget, but no customers — what to analyze?
meta-ads-wydatki-rosna-brak-sprzedazy.description: How to separate the problem of advertising from the problem of form, lead handling and sales.
meta-ads-wydatki-rosna-brak-sprzedazy.intro: The budget is issued as planned, but the company does not record signed contracts or valuable talks.

sections.title: The Most Important Cause
paragraphs: Movement and forms are stages of a funnel. The problem may occur in the quality of the offer, targeting, form, response time or closing of the sale.

sections.title: Practical procedure
paragraphs: 1. Check campaign details from the display by clicking on the form.
2 . Check whether the form actually goes to CRM and to the responsible person.
3 . Count contact, conversation, offers and contracts during the same period.
4 . Compare creations and groups based on qualified results, not only the number of clicks.
5 . Make one significant change at a time and save the hypothesis before the test.

sections.title: How do I confirm the result?
paragraphs: You know the stage where you lose potential customers and have a measure of improvement for a particular change.
Don't increase your campaign budget until you know if the current leads are properly handled.

meta-adset-no-delivery-learning-limited.title: Meta Ads: a set of ads has Learning Limited and is hardly displayed
meta-adset-no-delivery-learning-limited.description: A set of ads spends little money and shows a limited learning stage despite correct creation.
meta-adset-no-delivery-learning-limited.intro: A set of ads spends little money and shows a limited learning stage despite correct creation. The cause may be a small number of optimization events or too fragmented structure of advertising sets.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error

sections.title: What to do step by step

2 . Test changes individually and evaluate results in the longer range instead of daily reset learning.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: The campaign delivers advertising more stable and has a measurable conversion volume corresponding to the goal.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not guarantee to leave Learning Limited by increasing expenditure.

meta-capi-test-event-code-no-events.description: Query to Conversations API returns HTTP 200, but the sent event does not appear on the Test Events page.

2 . After confirmation of delivery, remove the test code from normal calls and leave production validation and safe status login.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: The appropriate test event appears in the selected data source and the production calls do not use the random test code.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not identify the presence of the event in Test Events with the correct distribution of the campaign or log in the client identification data in the console.

meta-duplikaty-pixel-conversions-api.title: Pixel and Conversations API count the same conversion twice
meta-duplikaty-pixel-conversions-api.description: The viewer and server can report the same event. Without a common identifier Meta can treat them as two different results. Do not turn off immediately
meta-duplikaty-pixel-conversions-api.intro: The viewer and server can report the same event. Without a common identifier Meta can treat them as two different results. Do not immediately disable the entire server measurement.

sections.title: Step by step
paragraphs: 1. In Event Manager, open event testing and perform one controlled action. Save its name and identifiers on the browser and server side.
2 . For the same event, both channels should transmit a compatible event name and event id. ID create once for a specific action, not separately in each channel.
3 . Check that the purchase is not sent simultaneously by the store plugin, GTM and its own code. Make a list of all the places that trigger the event.
4 . Refresh the confirmation page and return to it from history. The display itself should not generate a new transaction. On the system side, use a permanent order identifier and repeat service.
5 . Verify value and currency and your consent to the appropriate processing. Do not send unnecessary personal data for testing.

sections.title: How to check whether the amendment works
paragraphs: One controlled action should be identified as one event after a deduction. The mere disappearance of the warning does not prove that the sales value is correct; compare the result with the order in the system.

meta-graph-api-rate-limit-613.title: Meta Graph API: code 613 with too many requests

meta-graph-api-rate-limit-613.intro: The integration of advertising reading suddenly receives a 613 error or an answer indicating the limitation of the API. The application exceeded the permitted number of calls at a specified time or for a given resource.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Save request frequency, data range and limit response without registering private data.
Check that many slots have not returned the same resources at the same time.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Enter a queue with speed control, data cache, and delay when repeating requests according to the supplier's message.
2 . Collect larger ranges of data in a paged way and avoid repeatedly downloading unchanged statistics.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: When the load is lowered, correct requests pass, and delays do not block the entire CRM.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not repeat every 429 or 613 in a tight loop immediately. Each subsequent request also uses the available limit and can extend the limitation period.

meta-lead-ads-access-token-expired.title: Meta Lead Ads: expired access token and leady do not go to CRM
meta-lead-ads-access-token-expired.description: Meta's active integration suddenly stopped receiving contacts? Token, permission and webhook diagnostics.
meta-lead-ads-access-token-expired.intro: The forms continue to collect queries, but the automatic upload to CRM has stopped working.

sections.title: Why is there a problem?
paragraphs: Token user or pages may expire, be revoked or lose the required permission after changing the account.

sections.title: Diagnostics and solutions
paragraphs: 1. Compare the number of new forms in Meta with the number of webhook events accepted in CRM.
2 . Read Graph API response code and error ID without copying token to logs.
3 . Check the current integration permissions and assign a page to the application.
4 . Reauthorize according to Meta's required flow.
5 . Add error monitoring and recovery procedure from the authorised source.

sections.title: How to check and avoid what?
paragraphs: The test lead appears once in CRM, and monitoring reports bugs of subsequent attempts.
Do not paste Meta access token into a public repository or a support application.

meta-lead-ads-formularz-jest-crm-pusty.title: Meta shows lead, but there is no lead in CRM — step by step integration
meta-lead-ads-formularz-jest-crm-pusty.description: How to check missing contact between Facebook form, webhook and CRM database.
meta-lead-ads-formularz-jest-crm-pusty.intro: There's a new report in the Advertising Manager, but the trader can't see him in line.

sections.title: Why is there a problem?
paragraphs: Error can occur on downloading details, data transformation, recording to the database or in the visibility of the record after assignment.

sections.title: Diagnostics and solutions
paragraphs: 1. Save form identifier and leadgen id without distributing customer data.
2 . Check the log for webhook event reception and API response when downloading data.
3 . Verify the form field mapping to fields in the database, including phone numbers and optional responses.
4 . Check transaction record, deduplication and assignment to the trader.
5 . Finally test the list and counter under the trader's account and alert for each failed stage.

sections.title: How to check and avoid what?
paragraphs: The control form reaches the correct data, and the reproduction of the same event does not create a duplicate.
Do not assume that the HTTP 200 webhook itself means the correct record of the lead in the database.

meta-lead-ads-nie-moge-pobrac-kontaktow.title: Meta Lead Ads: I cannot download contacts from the form
meta-lead-ads-nie-moge-pobrac-kontaktow.description: Advertising shows results, but the contact list is empty or export unavailable. First, distinguish the lack of permission, the wrong form and the lack of results
meta-lead-ads-nie-moge-pobrac-kontaktow.intro: Advertising shows results, but the contact list is empty or export unavailable. First distinguish the lack of permission, the wrong form and the lack of results in the selected period.

sections.title: Step by step
paragraphs: 1. In Business Suite, open instant forms or contact center tools. Select the page from which the advertisement was actually issued and the appropriate form.

2 . Check the dates. The number of campaign results over the whole period does not mean new contacts today. Contacts are not stored indefinitely; check the current availability period with Meta and export data regularly.

3 . The administrator should check access to potential customers in the company's settings and assign a person or integration. Access to advertising does not always include downloading data from forms.
4 . Test the Lead Ads Testing Tool form in Meta development documentation. Use test data and see if a new entry appears in the target system.
5 . If the export works and CRM receives nothing, diagnose integration: page, form, validity of permissions and log responses. Do not manually prescribe real customer data for a public bug report.

sections.title: How to check whether the amendment works
paragraphs: Compare one test contact in Meta and CRM, along with the time of creation. Active exports do not yet confirm the functioning webhook. Save also the lead collection procedure in case of integration failure.

meta-leadads-access-no-download.title: Meta Lead Ads: form has leady, but cannot be downloaded
meta-leadads-access-no-download.description: The panel shows contacts from the form, but downloading CSV or access in CRM ends with refusal.
meta-leadads-access-no-download.intro: The panel shows contacts from the form, but downloading CSV or access in CRM ends with refusal. Access to the site and access to lead are separate allowances managed in the Meta ecosystem.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Check whether the account has the right role for the website and whether the company manager has assigned access to potential customers.
Compare the privileges of the CSV downloader and the user system used by API integration.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Grant the minimum required privileges in the relevant business portfolio and refresh the integration authorisation.
2 . Test the download of the fresh form and separate test flow to CRM with appropriate permissions.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: The authorised employee collects the applications and the person without access still has no visibility of the lead data.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not send the full administrator of the entire Business Manager just because there is no one report.

meta-leadform-privacy-policy-missing.title: Meta Lead Ads: Unable to publish a form without privacy policy
meta-leadform-privacy-policy-missing.description: Instant Form stops publication and asks for the correct link to the privacy rules.
meta-leadform-privacy-policy-missing.intro: Instant Form stops publication and asks for the correct link to the privacy rules. The cause needs to be checked in the real environment.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check that the policy URL opens publicly after HTTPS and corresponds to the actual data process.
Compare the status at the account, campaign, kit and advertising level; differentiate clicks from the acquired customers.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Insert a running link and information about the data controller and the use of the form according to the activity.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: The form shall be published with the policy available without fictional information.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Measure the results in the same period and according to the same conversion definition. Protect lead contact details and follow the rules of the platform.

meta-leadform-quality-vs-volume.title: Meta Lead Ads: Cheap forms without receiving customers
meta-leadform-quality-vs-volume.description: The panel reports a lot of lead, but CRM has a lot of wrong numbers and random reports.
meta-leadform-quality-vs-volume.intro: The panel reports a lot of lead, but CRM has a lot of wrong numbers and random reports. The cause needs to be checked in the real environment.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Compare CPL with the percentage of calls received and the number of qualified customers.
Compare the status at the account, campaign, kit and advertising level; differentiate clicks from the acquired customers.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Add the necessary qualifying questions and test the variant of the form with higher intent.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: The share of empty reports falls without losing valuable contacts.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Measure the results in the same period and according to the same conversion definition. Protect lead contact details and follow the rules of the platform.

meta-leady-duplikaty-po-retry-webhook.title: Meta sent webhook again and CRM has a double lead
meta-leady-duplikaty-po-retry-webhook.description: Idempotence of Meta webhooks and safe reopening demands not to create customer doubles.
meta-leady-duplikaty-po-retry-webhook.intro: The same contact appears twice after the problem with merging or resuming integration.

sections.title: Why is there a problem?
paragraphs: Webhook providers can re-deliver the event. If integration treats each POST as a new lead, copies will be created.

sections.title: Diagnostics and solutions
paragraphs: 1. Identify the stable ID of the supplier's event and keep it in the database.
2 . Add UNIQUE limitation to the event identifier to the appropriate extent.
3 . Return a safe result when the event occurs again without doing second assignments or notifications.
4 . Test two parallel POSTs with identical payoad.
5 . Separate the idempotence of delivering from business combining separate queries of the same person.

sections.title: How to check and avoid what?
paragraphs: A repeated webhook does not increase the number of leads or the number of notifications sent.
Do not delete repetitions only after the phone number: the user could really send two different forms.

meta-leady-tanie-ale-nie-jakosciowe.title: Cheap Leads from Meta Ads do not answer their phone — how to improve quality?
meta-leady-tanie-ale-nie-jakosciowe.description: When the CPL drops, but the number of customers does not increase. How to analyze forms, reaction time and qualification.
meta-leady-tanie-ale-nie-jakosciowe.intro: The campaign generates many cheap queries, and traders report lack of contact or lack of interest.

sections.title: The Most Important Cause
paragraphs: Algorithm can optimize easy completion of the form, unsigned contract. The timing of the reaction and compliance of the promise with the offer are important.

sections.title: Practical procedure
paragraphs: 1. Specify the definition of qualified contact and the reason for rejection of lead.
2 . Check the time from sending the form to the first attempt to connect.
3 . Compare the content of advertising, form and actual offer provided by the trader.
4 . Test the additional qualifying question, but monitor the impact on the number and quality of applications.
5 . Rate campaign on CRM data: connections, offers, contracts, not CPL itself.

sections.title: How do I confirm the result?
paragraphs: The changes improve the measurable share of qualified calls or sales at an acceptable cost.
A more expensive CPL does not automatically mean better lead; compare the whole funnel.

meta-nie-widze-strony-w-menadzerze-rekla.title: I don't see the website in Meta Advertising Manager — where to check access?
meta-nie-widze-strony-w-menadzerze-rekla.description: You can publish on the fanpage, but do not choose it as the identity of the advertisement. Access to the website, corporate portfolio and advertising account are separate permissions
meta-nie-widze-strony-w-menadzerze-rekla.intro: You can publish on the fanpage, but do not choose it as the identity of the advertisement. Access to the website, company portfolio and advertising account are separate permissions. Just logging into the right profile is not enough.

sections.title: Step by step
paragraphs: 1. Open Meta Business Suite and check the name of your selected corporate portfolio. If you support several companies, a switch in the upper left area may indicate a different portfolio than the one to which the page belongs.
2 . Enter Settings → Persons and company resources. Names and layout of bookmarks may vary between accounts. Find your profile and check your assigned resources: website and advertising account.

3 . Ask the administrator to assign permissions to the required advertising tasks. Don't transfer the password to a private profile. A co-worker or partner should have their own access to specific resources.
4 . Check that the invitation has been accepted on the right profile. Simply send the invitation by the owner does not finish the configuration.

5 . Reopen the Advertising Manager, select the correct account and check the identity section at the advertising level. If the site is still invisible, save the account and page identifiers and the error message before contacting the help.

sections.title: How to check whether the amendment works
paragraphs: The success is the ability to choose the right page in the sketch of the advertisement. Don't publish a budget test campaign just to check access. If the resource is limited, check the account status separately; adding more people does not remove the limit.

meta-pixel-capi-brak-zdarzen.title: Meta Pixel and Conversations API: Why no events in Manager?
meta-pixel-capi-brak-zdarzen.description: Pixel and CAPI don't record conversions? How to check configuration, consent, event test and event ID.
meta-pixel-capi-brak-zdarzen.intro: Users send forms, but Event Manager does not show the expected conversion.

sections.title: The Most Important Cause
paragraphs: The script may not have been loaded, the data set identifier is incorrect, it is blocked by consent or the server event does not reach the API.

sections.title: Practical procedure
paragraphs: 1. Check that the event should be sent after the user's consent and that the correct consent status is preserved.
2 . Verify the data identifier and run the code in the appropriate environment.
3 . Test one controlled conversion in Test Events.
4 . For CAPI check API response, event name, event time and possible event id.
5 . Distinguish the lack of registration of the event from the delay of its presentation in the reports.

sections.title: How do I confirm the result?
paragraphs: The control event is visible in the tests and the processing range corresponds to the actual agreement.
Do not send personal data events without adequate legal basis and compliance with the rules of the platform.

meta-pixel-domain-not-verified.title: Pixel Meta: domain unverified for event configuration
meta-pixel-domain-not-verified.description: The panel requires confirmation of the site's ownership before the selected domain operation.
meta-pixel-domain-not-verified.intro: The panel requires confirmation of the site's ownership before the selected domain operation. The cause needs to be checked in the real environment.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check domain name in business portfolio and available DNS/HTML verification methods.
Compare the status at the account, campaign, kit and advertising level; differentiate clicks from the acquired customers.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Add the actual record in the authoritative DNS zone or indicated meta tag on the right page.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: The domain is verified in the correct account and the events can be properly configured.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Measure the results in the same period and according to the same conversion definition. Protect lead contact details and follow the rules of the platform.

meta-pixel-pageview-duplicate.title: Meta Pixel: PageView counts twice on one page
meta-pixel-pageview-duplicate.description: One address opening gives two independent PageView events in Events Manager.
meta-pixel-pageview-duplicate.intro: One address opening gives two independent PageView events in Events Manager. The cause needs to be checked in the real environment.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check that pixel is simultaneously in the page code and via Google Tag Manager or plugin.
Compare the status at the account, campaign, kit and advertising level; differentiate clicks from the acquired customers.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Leave one path of initialization and manage events consciously when changing the SPA route.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: One entry test causes one intended PageView registration.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Measure the results in the same period and according to the same conversion definition. Protect lead contact details and follow the rules of the platform.

meta-reklama-aktywna-nie-wydaje-budzetu.title: Meta advertising is active, but does not spend the budget
meta-reklama-aktywna-nie-wydaje-budzetu.description: Green campaign status does not guarantee the issue of every advertisement. A set of advertisements or advertising itself may be in verification, have a future schedule or limit
meta-reklama-aktywna-nie-wydaje-budzetu.intro: Green campaign status does not guarantee the issue of every advertisement. A set of advertisements or the advertising itself may be in verification, have a future schedule or limit billing.

sections.title: Step by step
paragraphs: 1. Check the campaign, set and advertising. Add the delivery column and develop the message at the lowest level. Save the exact content instead of using the activity switch itself.
2 . Verify the start, end and time zone of the account. Make sure the report covers the current day; reporting data may appear late.
3 . Open the accounts and check the rejected payment, balance, account spending limit and messages requiring action. Do not add any more blind payment methods.
4 . Check account limitations and status of advertising verification. When rejecting, read the stated principle, correct the actual reason or use the available appeal.

5 . Only when the account and advertising are ready to issue, assess the scope of the group, exclusion and restrictive cost control. Change one important parameter at a time and save the moment of change.

sections.title: How to check whether the amendment works
paragraphs: Displays and expenses should appear in the report in the correct period of dates. Do not promise emissions in a specified number of minutes; it depends on verification and auction. If the problem persists, the notification to the assistance should include an advertising identifier, status and start time.

meta-reklama-edycja-tekstu-brak-efektu.title: I changed the text in Meta's commercial, but I don't see why.
meta-reklama-edycja-tekstu-brak-efektu.description: The changed header or creation is not displayed as in the editor. Previews, dynamic creation and acceptance process.
meta-reklama-edycja-tekstu-brak-efektu.intro: After editing the copy, the user still sees an old version of the advertisement or another variant of the text.

sections.title: The Most Important Cause
paragraphs: Some formats use creation variants and display optimization, and changes can wait for approval. The preview does not always return all the places of issue.

sections.title: Practical procedure
paragraphs: 1. Check if the change has been published, not saved as a draft.
2 . Read the advertising status after editing and the time of the last publication.
3 . Check if text variants or dynamic creation options are used.
4 . Compare previews for different placesmen and devices.
5 . If the result is still inconsistent, note down the advertising identifier and check the available information with Meta help.

sections.title: How do I confirm the result?
paragraphs: The published configuration corresponds to the planned text, and the differences resulting from the placements are consciously accepted.
Do not correct the text repeatedly every few minutes before the platform completes the publication and verification process.

meta-webhook-test-only-real-leads.title: Meta Lead Ads: Test leads come, but the real ones don't go to CRM
meta-webhook-test-only-real-leads.description: The integration test button works, but the advertisements are not stored in the system.
meta-webhook-test-only-real-leads.intro: The integration test button works, but the advertisements are not stored in the system. The test path can bypass some of the actual permission configuration and subscription of the site.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Check the site subscription to leadgen and the status of the actual webhook on the target endpoint.
Compare tokens, page and form IDs and permission to download contact data.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Configure the subscription of the right page, valid token and application permissions for actual events.
2 . Add a long queue and retra after HTTP error, and save each lead idempotently after its ID.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: The test and the actual report go a full path from Meta to CRM, without a double record.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not consider one test webhook as proof of the correctness of production integration.

meta-webhook-verify-token-error.title: Meta Lead Ads webhook: Callback URL verification does not pass
meta-webhook-verify-token-error.description: Verification of webhook Meta ends in error. How to handle hub.challenge, verify token and HTTPS.
meta-webhook-verify-token-error.intro: Meta does not accept callback URL even though endpoint opens in the browser.

sections.title: Why is there a problem?
paragraphs: Webhook verification requires response to GET request with challenge parameters. The usual endpoint POST is not enough.

sections.title: Diagnostics and solutions
paragraphs: 1. Check if the URL is public under HTTPS and does not require login or Preview protection.
2 . Verify GET query support with hub.mode, hub.verify token and hub.chalenge parameters.
3 . Compare token on the server side with the token specified in Meta configuration.
4 . Return the required challenge only after correct token verification.
5 . Separately implement POST support, signature validation and safe lead processing.

sections.title: How to check and avoid what?
paragraphs: Callback URL verification passes, and the test POST event goes to the controlled log without sensitive data.
Do not log full tokens and do not treat the public challenge as an authorization of all POST requests.

mobile-horizontal-scroll-css.title: A horizontal scroll bar appears on your phone — how do you find the culprit?
mobile-horizontal-scroll-css.description: CSS overflow-x on mobile, rigid widths, 100vw and animations. See what pushes the page out of the screen.
mobile-horizontal-scroll-css.intro: The page can be moved to the sides, and the menu, text or graphics go beyond the width of the phone.

sections.title: Where's the problem coming from?
paragraphs: The reason often is an element with widget:100vw inside the container, stiff width, long URL or transformation.

sections.title: What to do step by step?
paragraphs: 1. In DevTools, compare document width with viewport width and find the widest element.
2 . Check flex and grid: child items may require min-with:0 and long text wrapping.
3 . Replace unnecessary 100vw to 100% where the element should be in the parent.
4 . Check the animated elements extending beyond the screen.
5 . Repair the overflow source and test 320, 375, 390 and 430 px.

sections.title: Correction test and important trap
paragraphs: There is no horizontal scrolling on normal use and important content and controls remain available.
Global overflow-x:hidden can hide an error and cut menus and buttons.

mobile-menu-biale-tlo-zmiana-stylu.title: The mobile menu has a white background despite the dark side — how do you find style?
mobile-menu-biale-tlo-zmiana-stylu.description: The navigation bar doesn't match the dark theme? CSS helmet, browser styles, select and backdrop.
mobile-menu-biale-tlo-zmiana-stylu.intro: The whole page is dark, but the header or drop-down menu on the phone still has a white beam.

sections.title: Where's the problem coming from?
paragraphs: The mobile variant may have a separate class, default element background or CSS rule of higher specificity.

sections.title: What to do step by step?
paragraphs: 1. Open the inspector on mobile width and check the computed background-color element and parent.
2 . Find a rule that wins in the CSS cascade, also in media questions.
3 . Make sure the background menu and drop-down panel uses the same system design tokens.
4 . Check the contrast of logos, icons, links and states of focus and hover.
5 . Test the closed, developed, scrolled menu and the bright system screen.

sections.title: Correction test and important trap
paragraphs: The header is consistent with the identification of the page and the navigational elements remain legible and accessible.
Do not add many more rules !important if the problem comes from one old style.

mobile-tekst-nachodzi-na-twarz-zdjecie.title: The text comes to your face on your phone — how do you design a hero?
mobile-tekst-nachodzi-na-twarz-zdjecie.description: The photo of the person and the inscriptions in the hero overlap. CSS solutions for desktop and mobile without editing the photo.
mobile-tekst-nachodzi-na-twarz-zdjecie.intro: Desktop looks good, but after lowering the screen, the header lands on the face or disappears outside the frame.

sections.title: Where's the problem coming from?
paragraphs: The pixel-based position of text and one photo for many proportions create a collision with a narrower screen.

sections.title: What to do step by step?
paragraphs: 1. Select the area of the image that cannot be obscured, and check the frame with several ratios.
2 . Apply another composition on small screens: text next to or under the picture instead of on it.
3 . If you use a cap, set a responsive max-with, spacing, and a safe area for your face.
4 . At object-fit:cover control object-position and natural proportions.
5 . Test 320–430 px, rotation and larger text settings.

sections.title: Correction test and important trap
paragraphs: The face and all the headlines are visible, nothing overlaps, and the photo remains unchanged.
Moving the absolute top by several pixels can work on one phone model, but not on others.

mobile-viewport-przeskakuje-przewijanie.title: Phone page jumps when scrolling — CSS causes
mobile-viewport-przeskakuje-przewijanie.description: A mobile viewport jumps when scrolling, animations, or an extended Safari bar. How to diagnose 100vh and layout shifts.
mobile-viewport-przeskakuje-przewijanie.intro: On iPhone, the background or sections of the page jump while desktop looks normal. Such a problem arose when developing a portfolio.

sections.title: Where's the problem coming from?
paragraphs: 100vh does not always behave like the height of the visible area when the browser bar appears. Additionally, dimensionless images and animations can cause CLS.

sections.title: What to do step by step?
paragraphs: 1. Play a problem on the real phone and tell the difference in the height of the viewport from moving items.
2 . Check the elements with height:100vh and consider 100svh or 100dvh according to the project needs.
3 . Book a size for photos, fonts, and cards so loading does not move the text.
4 . Reduce transformation animations and fixtures that affect the feeling of motion.
5 . Test Safari, Chrome, screen rotation, screen keyboard and scrolling in both directions.

sections.title: Correction test and important trap
paragraphs: The sections remain stable and the elements do not block the contents after the browser bar has been drawn.
Do not add another random min-weight without finding an item that actually changes size.

next-image-obraz-znika-po-resize.title: Next/Image: image disappears or unscales when window is changed
next-image-obraz-znika-po-resize.description: Next/image errors and responsive photos: fill, sizes, parent positioning and container height.
next-image-obraz-znika-po-resize.intro: The picture disappears in the part of breakpoints or looks like an empty rectangle after changing orientation.

sections.title: Where's the problem coming from?
paragraphs: The image of the fill requires a size and a properly positioned parent. Invalid sizes also lead to an inoptimal download.

sections.title: What to do step by step?
paragraphs: 1. Check the size of the parent and computed height where the image disappears.
2 . For fill set the parent position and actual height or aspect-ratio.
3 . Check with-index, overflow and visibility at breakpoints.
4 . Set sizes according to the actual image width in the project.
5 . Test the slow network, forward and backward navigation and screen rotation.

sections.title: Correction test and important trap
paragraphs: The image remains visible in all target layouts without rapidly jumping content.
Do not fix this only by adding a high fixed height to all screens.

nextjs-await-params-next15.title: Next.js 15: reading params.slug without await generates an error
nextjs-await-params-next15.description: After the Next.js update, the dynamic route begins to report that the params should be read asynchronously.
nextjs-await-params-next15.intro: After the Next.js update, the dynamic route begins to report that the params should be read asynchronously. In the newer App Router params are transmitted as a Promise value in the respective page functions.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Check Next.js version and all params read places in page, layout and generateMetadata.
Compare the Props type with the actual framework function contract instead of adding any projection.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Define params: Promise<{slug:string > and read const {slug}=await params in the proper asynchronous function.
2 . For many segments, correct all use sites; prepare a test to open a specific dynamic address.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: Typecheck and build pass, and entering the address /guides/example opens the correct data without warning.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not copy signatures from the documentation of the older main version without checking the version of the project.

nextjs-basepath-static-assets-404.title: Next.js: After setting basePath resources  next return 404
nextjs-basepath-static-assets-404.description: The application in the subdirectory /panel opens HTML, but styles and JavaScript are loaded from invalid paths.
nextjs-basepath-static-assets-404.intro: The application in the subdirectory /panel opens HTML, but styles and JavaScript are loaded from invalid paths. BasePath and assetPrefix configuration may not match reverse proxy or target subdirectory.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
