paragraphs: Find missing resources in the Network  next and save their full URLs. Compare basePath in next.config with proxy rules and the actual path under which the project is served.
Compare the message from the console with the result of the production compilation and the condition after the page has been refreshed.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Unify basePath with proxy and correct the reference to public resources that are not automatically prefixed. Rebuild the project after changing basePath, as the setting is built into the client code during build.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: HTML, CSS and JS load from the same prefix on production.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Do not try to repair each resource by a separate redirect when the entire prefix is bad.

nextjs-bledne-importy-client-server-comp.title: Next.js: diagnostics of invalid imports between Client and Server Components
nextjs-bledne-importy-client-server-comp.description: Specific list of causes and tests for import problems Client and Server Components at Next.js — how to identify incompatible imports, sources of errors and corrective steps leading to consistent build and correct behaviour in dev/prod.
nextjs-bledne-importy-client-server-comp.intro: In Next.js from component separation to server and client (RSC/CSR) incorrect or mixed imports are a common cause of errors when building applications and when launching in the production environment. This document describes the differential diagnostics, specific tests and sequence of steps to find and repair situations when a component marked as server imports a module using the state or effects of the browser, or when client component depends on code requiring node-only API. I focus on the real conditions that cause: "use client must be the first direct" compilation errors, execution time errors with hydration or unexpected behavior in production (e.g. different data rendered in dev and prod). I do not assume that the cause is a single file — I will show typical source variants, specific commands and test conditions. The proposed steps are executable in Next.js repository (versions 13+ from RSC) and do not require external tools outside the node, e.g./yarn and Next.js commands. I do not create fictitious patches or promise a solution in one step — I indicate repetitive tests and conditions that clearly identify the source of the import conflict and their repair.

sections.title: How to Recognize Cause
paragraphs: Symptoms 1: compilation error during build or in dev console: "'use client' must be the first directive" or stacktrake indicating cyclic import. This message appears when the client file does not have 'use client' on the first line or the imported dependency is server-only. Check the first 3 lines of each component to confirm no additional comments before 'use client'.

Symptoms 2: runtime hydration mismatch, no useEffect effects or window is not defined in production. This suggests that the server component imports a module trying to use the browser API. Check the imports from libraries using DOM (e.g. UI/icon libraries) and perform a tree-shaking/webpack relationship analysis.

Symptoms 3: various dev vs production behavior: works locally, but build on Vercel/CI returns an error. This often results from differences in Node versions, different compiler flags or from the fact that the dev server is more tolerant. Make sure you have the Node version and run next build from --profile or --debug.

sections.title: Step by step solution
paragraphs: 1. Step 1 — Locate: Start next build and copy full stacktrake. If a message about 'use client' or 'window is not defined' appears, note the file indicated in the path. Use grep (e.g. rg "use client") on /app and /components directory to find all client components.

2 . Step 2 — Verification of direct imports: for the selected file open each import and check whether the imported path contains 'use client' or uses React hooks/effects. If the import is directly to the library, check the documentation for server rendering.

3 . Step 3 — Dependency tree analysis: run e.g. ls <packaget> or package graph display tool (e.g. example-why) to find indirect dependencies that can enter the browser code into the server component. Identify the modules that export DOM-dependent code.

4 . Step 4 — Isolation: temporarily replace suspect import stub (a simple component without effects) and repeat next build. If build passes, you know the problem comes from this dependency. Restore the original and continue to isolate at a further level of dependence.

5 . Step 5 — Repair: If this server component import client-only code, move import to client component or wrap the module with dynamic import from {sssr: false } for a part requiring a browser. Alternatively mark the 'use client' client file and make sure it is only used in a place that accepts client components.

6 . Step 6 — check configuration: compare Node version and next.config.js settings (Experimental appDir, transpilePackages, etc.) between local environment and CI. Enter changes to standardize the environment and repeat next build.

sections.title: How to see if the problem is gone
paragraphs: Test 1 — build: run clean build (rm -rf .next &&egm run build) and check for no compilation errors. The reason is to confirm that no server component import client-only dependencies. Note the time of compilation and the lack of new Warnings.
Test 2 — locally run production: run NODE ENV=production egm start and visit the path that previously caused the error. Check the browser console for hydration mismatch and no window is not defined.
Test 3 — Dependency control: run nm ls < suspect-package> and confirm that it does not occur in the server component import path. If present, repeat insulation and repair for intermediate modules.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not mark the 'use client' file as a default solution without checking the impact: excess client components loses RSC benefit and can hide the actual server dependency.
Don't just rely on dev server: dev can mask errors by refreshing and tolerating imports; always test clean build and start in production mode.
Avoid introducing global polyfills for window/DOM in the server; this hides the problem and can lead to unstable behaviour in the production environment.

nextjs-cache-pokazuje-stare-dane.title: Next.js shows old data despite updating in the database — cache
nextjs-cache-pokazuje-stare-dane.description: Old content in Next.js App Router? How to distinguish cache, static rendering and API problem.
nextjs-cache-pokazuje-stare-dane.intro: After saving changes to the panel, the user refreshes the page and still sees the old value.

sections.title: Where's the problem coming from?
paragraphs: The result can come from server cache, browser cache, static build or unfreshed React.

sections.title: What to do step by step?
paragraphs: 1. Open a direct API and check if it returns new data.
2 . Distinguish cache query, route and browser; set the place where the change disappears.
3 . Check revalidate settings or a clear refresh mechanism after mutation.
4 . For critical data, define a freshness strategy and possibly force dynamic download.
5 . Test after changing data without rebooting the server and from another device.

sections.title: Correction test and important trap
paragraphs: After the update, the change appears in time consistent with the adopted strategy, not only after the new deploy.
Setting a no-store anywhere can make performance worse without need. Identify the right range.

nextjs-cookies-readonly-server.title: Next.js: cookies().set does not work in Server Component
nextjs-cookies-readonly-server.description: Trying to set cookies directly when rendering the page returns the cookie limitation error.
nextjs-cookies-readonly-server.intro: Trying to set cookies directly when rendering the page returns the cookie limitation error. Reading and writing cookies have different rules; writing is allowed only in the appropriate context of the server response.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Check whether setter is called in page.tsx, Route Handler or Server Action.
Verify whether the cookie mutation occurs before sending the HTTP response.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Transfer cookie writing to Server Action or Route Handler and leave the component to read the data.
2 . For the session, check the HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite attributes and path; run the test after clean login.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: After a mutant request, the response contains the correct Set-Cookie header, and the new session is read correctly.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not save session secrets by the available JavaScript code to the client if they require HttpOnly protection.

nextjs-csp-inline-script-block.title: Next.js: Content Security Policy blocks application scripts
nextjs-csp-inline-script-block.description: The browser shows Refused to execute inline script and part of the interaction does not work after sharpening CSP.
nextjs-csp-inline-script-block.intro: The browser shows Refused to execute inline script and part of the interaction does not work after sharpening CSP. Next.js may need a proper nonce or hash configuration for scripts depending on the rendering method.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check the Content-Security-Policy header and accurate message with the name of the blocked directive. Determine whether the problem concerns your own script, framework or external analytical integration.
Compare the message from the console with the result of the production compilation and the condition after the page has been refreshed.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Configure nonce or hash according to Next.js rendering model and transfer it to the necessary scripts. Eliminate unnecessary inline scripts and limit trusted sources while maintaining tests on static and dynamic pages.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: Interactions work, and CSP continues to block deliberately unauthorized scripts and unnecessary domains.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Do not set unsafe-inline globally just to remove console messages.

nextjs-css-global-import-location.title: Next.js: global CSS import in wrong component
nextjs-css-global-import-location.description: After adding a new sheet, there is an error regarding the location of the global CSS or the order of styles.
nextjs-css-global-import-location.intro: After adding a new sheet, there is an error regarding the location of the global CSS or the order of styles. The rules for importing global styles depend on Pages Router, App Router and Bundler configuration.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check if the project uses app or pages directory and in which component global import appears. Identify the conflict of two global sheets and the order of their charging after navigation.
Compare the message from the console with the result of the production compilation and the condition after the page has been refreshed.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Move global styles to the right entry point framework or use CSS Modules for single components. If the conflict is due to the order of styles, simplify the dependency and set a coherent import point for the entire site.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: Build and navigation between subpages do not report CSS error, and appearance does not depend on entry order.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Don't turn all styles into !important, because it hides the conflict instead of solving it.

nextjs-dynamic-route-404-po-build.title: Next.js: dynamic subpage works in dev, but production returns 404
nextjs-dynamic-route-404-po-build.description: Route [slug] in Next.js does not work after build? Check genericStaticParams, dynamicParams and the source of service.
nextjs-dynamic-route-404-po-build.intro: Locally, the guide or implementation opens, but after publication the selected service returns 404.

sections.title: Where's the problem coming from?
paragraphs: With static generation, some of the addresses may not have gone to genericStaticParams, while dynamicParams=false blocks unknown paths.

sections.title: What to do step by step?
paragraphs: 1. Determine whether the route uses generationStaticParams and dynamicParams=false.
2 . Compare the desired service with the list returned during the production build.
3 . Check case normalization, Polish characters and final slashes.
4 . Make sure the guide data is available during compilation, not only in the browser.
5 . Start build and local production start, then visit some random service.

sections.title: Correction test and important trap
paragraphs: Each address from the list of contents and sitemap returns 200 after the production build.
Do not set the dynamicParams=true without thinking about generating and handling wrong addresses.

nextjs-dynamicparams-false-404-new-artic.title: Next.js: new article 404 by dynamicParams = false
nextjs-dynamicparams-false-404-new-artic.description: After adding the article to the data /guides/new returns 404, although older service works.
nextjs-dynamicparams-false-404-new-artic.intro: After adding the article to the data /guides/new returns 404, although older service works. The dynamicParams=false option limits the support of segments to the values given by generationStaticParams at build.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Read the dynamicParams value in the route file and the service list returned by generationStaticParams. Compare SHA of the production defloyment with the addition of the article and determine whether the new slug was in the build.
Compare the message from the console with the result of the production compilation and the condition after the page has been refreshed.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: For a site that publishes new services without full rebuild, set consciously dynamicParams=true and proper cache. If you are using fully static exports, generate all the necessary parameters when building and start a new defloyment after publication.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: The new article returns 200 under its own URL, and the unknown slug continues to return the real 404.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Do not direct all unknown service to one replacement article with code 200.

nextjs-env-client-undefined.title: Next.js: process.env runs on the server but undefined in the browser
nextjs-env-client-undefined.description: The API variable exists while rendering the server, and in Client Component reads undefined.
nextjs-env-client-undefined.intro: The API variable exists while rendering the server, and in Client Component reads undefined. Next.js does not provide normal server-only variables to the browser code; public must be clearly marked.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Check whether the reading is in the use client file and whether the name starts with NEXT PUBLUC .
Verify the target build environment and whether the new value has been included in the new deployment.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Do not move a secret key to your client; if necessary, read it in Route Handler and return only the required result.
2 . For the open interface configuration set NEXT PUBLUC  before build and rebuild the application.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: The public value is available in the new Bundle, and the secret key does not appear in the JavaScript code downloaded by the browser.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not add NEXT PUBLAC  prefix to private keys; this means revealing them.

nextjs-error-event-handlers-server.title: Next.js: Event handlers cannot be passed to Client Component props
nextjs-error-event-handlers-server.description: An error appears when rendering onClick from Server Component to the client component.
nextjs-error-event-handlers-server.intro: An error appears when rendering onClick from Server Component to the client component. Browser event handling functions must exist in client context; no callback can be serialized across the server-client boundary.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Find a component with the passed onClick, onChange or function in the props object.
Check the location of the use client directive and whether the imported component is actually a customer boundary.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Move an interactive button and handler to a small Client Component while retaining the data download on the server side.
2 . Transfer to the customer only serialized data and identifiers necessary for the event.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: Build ends without serialization error, and clicking continues to trigger the expected action.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not add the use client to the entire layout just because one button has onClick.

nextjs-form-server-action-origin-mismatc.title: Next.js Server Action: Invalid Server Actions request original mismatch
nextjs-form-server-action-origin-mismatc.description: Writing through the form does not work only behind reverse proxy or custom domain and a message about origin mismatch appears.
nextjs-form-server-action-origin-mismatc.intro: Writing through the form does not work only behind reverse proxy or custom domain and a message about origin mismatch appears. Server Actions verify the origin of the request, and proxy can transmit Host and X-Forwarded-Host incompatible with Origin.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check the headers Origin, Host and X-Forwarded-Host for problematic POST in a safe environment. Compare proxy configuration and list of actual trusted form domains.
Compare the message from the console with the result of the production compilation and the condition after the page has been refreshed.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Improve the transfer of headers in proxy and configure allowed origin only for actual host applications. Verify CSRF and the HTTPS connection, leaving a refusal for requests from untrusted domains.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: The correct production domain form records the data and the alien origin is still blocked.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Do not set wildcard for each domain just to remove the error.

nextjs-generate-metadata-duplicate-title.title: Next.js: two titles and an erroneous canonical after migration to Metadata API
nextjs-generate-metadata-duplicate-title.description: HTML contains a double title or canonical, because part of metadata generates App Router, and part of the old Head component.
nextjs-generate-metadata-duplicate-title.intro: HTML contains a double title or canonical, because part of metadata generates App Router, and part of the old Head component. Inconclusive metadata can come from the parallel use of new and old head management.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: In HTML page check the number of title items, canonical link and metadata description.
View layout.tsx, page.tsx, generateMetadata and any manual header tags in components.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Move metadata to one Metadata API based source and provide metadataBase for relative addresses.
2 . Unify the inheritance of metadata between layout and page, openly defining the title of the subpage and canonical.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: There is one correct title in HTML and canonical indicating the proper production URL.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not set every subpage of the canonical home page, making it difficult to index specific content.

nextjs-headers-dynamic-rendering-build.title: Next.js: read headers() blocks static prerendering
nextjs-headers-dynamic-rendering-build.description: The page was previously statically generated, and after adding headers() it switches to dynamic mode or build reports a warning.
nextjs-headers-dynamic-rendering-build.intro: The page was previously statically generated, and after adding headers() it switches to dynamic mode or build reports a warning. Reading headers depends on a specific request and can prevent the whole route from being executed as a permanent HTML at build.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check where you call headers() and whether the component is used by all subpages in the layout. Verify whether the required information actually depends on the request, or whether it is a constant configuration of the application.
Compare the message from the console with the result of the production compilation and the condition after the page has been refreshed.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Move header-dependent logic to a clear dynamic route or a smaller separated fragment. For public content, use a fixed configuration when the header is not required for rendering.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: The routes have intended rendering mode, and build does not accidentally change it by a common layout.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Do not try to read private user headers in statically generated HTML.

nextjs-hydration-failed-data-strefa-czas.title: Next.js — 'Hydration failed' due to differences in date and time zone
nextjs-hydration-failed-data-strefa-czas.description: Description of the diagnosis and repair of the Hydration failed error in Next.js, when different representations of the date/time zone between the server and the client cause a discrepancy of the DOM tree and the hydratation errors.
nextjs-hydration-failed-data-strefa-czas.intro: Hydration failed in Next.js often means that the HTML generated on the server side (SSR) differs from the one React tries to initiate in the browser. One of the common but subtle reasons is different representations of the date or time zone: the server can render Date/Intl in the UTC zone or based on the server environment, and the client can render Date/Intl in the user zone. When components in SSR render contain textual date values (e.g. toLocaleString(), toISOString(), format from Intl.DateTimeFormat) the resulting HTML may contain a different string than the client side, leading to an error hydratation. The problem increases with dynamic, time-dependent elements:

sections.title: How to Recognize Cause
paragraphs: Check that the component renders Date/Intl directly during SSR. If you use new Date() or Date.now() in the component body, the value may vary between building (SSG) and demand or customer.

Compare text output: Return HTML from the server (View Source) and compare with DOM after loading. The difference in time recording (e.g. '2026-11-07T10:00:00Z' vs '2026-11-07 11:00:00') indicates a zone problem.
Check using Intl.DateTimeFormat or toLocaleString without open locale and options. The server (Node.js) and the browsers can use different locale or timeZone by default, causing different renderings.

sections.title: Step by step solution
paragraphs: 1. Locate date rendering components: Search the code for toLocaleString, toISOString, Intl.DateTimeFormat, new Date() in page files and SSR/SSG components.
2 . Replace direct date formatting with conditional declaration: render neutral placeholder during SSR and format the date on the client side in useEfect or after hydrating.

3 . If you need a permanent format, use the open format: new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US',{ timeZone: 'UTC', hour12: false }) or formatting on the backend to make both environments use the same timeZone and locale.
4 . For SSG/SSR consider serialization of values as a number (timestamp) instead of a string; the client can read timestamp and format locally without differences in the DOM structure.

5 . If you use next/image or meta tags containing dates, generate them to be deterministic — e.g. canonicalDate = new Date(date).toISOString() — and avoid itLocaleString in HTML generado on the server.

6 . Run build locally in production mode (next build && next start) with the same environmental variables as production to repeat server conditions and see if an error occurs outside the developmental HMR.

sections.title: How to see if the problem is gone
paragraphs: Test A: Open the page in the browser, save 'View Source' (HTML from the server) and compare with innerText doc.body after full loading; no discrepancy in the date places means correct hydration.
Test B: Change the timeZone in the formatter to another (e.g. 'UTC' vs 'Europe/Warsaw') and check if the hydratation is crashing again — if so, the cause was in a secret zone.
Test C: Enter the SSR placeholder (e.g. '—') and after hydrating in useEffect overwrite the formatted value; if the error disappears, the problem was in the SSR vs client rendering differences.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not use thisLocaleString() without open locale/timeZone in the SSR renderer — the effect depends on the environment and can cause hydration.
Avoid date formatting directly in JSX at SSR; instead, use serialization (timestamp) or clientocentric formatting after hydration.

nextjs-hydration-failed-jak-naprawic.title: Next.js: Hydration failed — How to find and fix a mistake?
nextjs-hydration-failed-jak-naprawic.description: Hydration failed, server rendered HTML didn't match the client. List of causes and step-by-step checking in Next.js and React.
nextjs-hydration-failed-jak-naprawic.intro: The Hydration failed message means that the HTML generated on the server differs from the first React rendering in the browser. Do not start by turning off SSR: Find an item that has a different value on the first render.

sections.title: 1. Find the first scattered item
paragraphs: Open the DevTools console and check the component tree fragment shown on error. Don't just focus on the top component: the first element with divergent content is important. If the problem is only in one browser, check the HTML-modifying extensions.

Verify HTML nesting. The p element must not contain another p or div, and the button should not contain the second button. The browser can automatically improve the invalid HTML and cause dispersal at the hydration.

sections.title: 2 . Check browser dependent data
paragraphs: The most common error: when rendering you use window, localStorage, random number or current time. The server and client can then return different content. In React the initial state should generate identical HTML; read local settings only in useEfect.

If the application renders the date, format it decisively: indicate locale and timeZone openly or show the value after installing the component. Different time zones on the server and phone side are common reasons.

sections.title: 3 . Fix cause, don't hide warning
paragraphs: After the amendment, run the production compilation and check the same subpage without cache and in private mode. suppressHydrationWarning apply only to individual content that must vary, e.g. time; is not a universal solution. Switching off SSR across the view often worsens performance and SEO.

If rendering differs solely because of a library dependent on DOM, separate it into a separate client component and then consider rendering without SSR. Keep valid text, headers and links on the server side.

nextjs-image-400-optimizer.title: Next.js Image returns 400 despite the correct image
nextjs-image-400-optimizer.description: The normal image URL works, but the / next/image request ends with HTTP 400.
nextjs-image-400-optimizer.intro: The normal image URL works, but the / next/image request ends with HTTP 400. The optimizer checks the source, URL parameters and allowed hosts, so the problem may be different from the lack of the file itself.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: In Network, view URL / next/image, url, w and q, as well as the full content of the error response.
Check the image.remotePatterns configuration and see if the remote server correctly returns Content-Type image.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Match allowed host, protocol and pathname only to trusted source; do not open all domains without need.
2 . If the source blocks an optimizer fetch, configure the correct file access or use unoptimized for the selected graphics.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: The graphics are loaded on the phone and desktop, and the optimizer request does not return 400.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not disable host protection on the entire site just to fix a single photo.

nextjs-image-fill-missing-sizes.title: Next.js Image fill without sizes fetches too large file
nextjs-image-fill-missing-sizes.description: On the phone, the graphics take a small portion of the screen, but the browser downloads a wide image for desktop.
nextjs-image-fill-missing-sizes.intro: On the phone, the graphics take a small portion of the screen, but the browser downloads a wide image for desktop. The Image component with fill without appropriate sizes can allow the viewer to choose an unoptimal image variant.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check the physical size of the visible image in the various breakpoints and its downloaded size on the Network. Read generated srcset and sizes and check the Largest Contentful Paint report for the site.
Compare the message from the console with the result of the production compilation and the condition after the page has been refreshed.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Add sizes describing the actual width of the container, e.g. 100vw on mobile and part of the width on desktop. With fill set the parent position: relative and known dimension or aspect-ratio so that the layout does not collapse.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: The browser selects an image variant matching the viewport without unnecessary transfer on the phone.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Do not set sizes="100vw" for a miniature covering 20% desktop width.

nextjs-image-unconfigured-host-remote-pa.title: Next.js Image: hostname is not configured under images — repair
nextjs-image-unconfigured-host-remote-pa.description: Next/image rejects a photo from an outside host? Configure remotePatterns without opening the optimizer to all domains.
nextjs-image-unconfigured-host-remote-pa.intro: Next/image component may refuse to display graphics from the external domain if the source does not match the allowed patterns. It's a separate problem since CSS clipping a photo or an inaccessible file.

sections.title: How to Recognize Cause
paragraphs: In the browser console or log Next.js read the exact hostname and URL of problematic graphics. Compare them with images.remotePatterns in next.config.ts or next.config.js. Note protocol, path and query parameters.
See if the original image opens directly. If the image server corresponds to 403 or requires a cookie, simply adding remotePatterns will not fix the external source authorisation.

sections.title: Step by step solution
paragraphs: 1. In next.config.ts add image.remotePatterns entry for a specific, trusted domain and the corresponding file path. Do not allow any host with too wide a wildcard.
2 . Make sure the hostname in the configuration corresponds exactly to the domain with src — including the subdomain. Check separately https and possible port number in the test environment.
3 . If the image has URL parameters, check the search properties match in the pattern. The empty value may exclude all addresses from the query string.
4 . After saving the configuration, restart the developer server or execute a new implementation. The next.config change does not have to apply immediately in the already running process.
5 . If the message is still present, check the endpoint / next/image response and HTTP code. Distinguish 400 due to pattern matching from source server error.

sections.title: How to see if the problem is gone
paragraphs: Graphics should load after hard page refresh, and Network should not show 400 responses to / next/image due to untrusted host.
Also check another external domain that is not trusted: should not accidentally access the image optimizer.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not automatically prescribe every URL from an error to a wide list of wildcards. remotePatterns performs the function of controlling permitted sources.

nextjs-link-href-undefined-runtime.title: Next.js Link: href is required when rendering the list
nextjs-link-href-undefined-runtime.description: The list of guides works for some of the records, but the render of one item with Link ends up with an error of missing href.
nextjs-link-href-undefined-runtime.intro: The list of guides works for some of the records, but the render of one item with Link ends up with an error of missing href. The data may have an empty service or the URL builder function received undefined from an optional field.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check the href values for each item before being transferred to Link component. Determine whether the data source contains work records without service that should not be published.
Compare the message from the console with the result of the production compilation and the condition after the page has been refreshed.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Validate service when importing content and generate Link only for existing, valid addresses. For missing data, show a non-critical condition and save a validation error in CI instead of creating /undefined.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: Each link is correct and leads to an existing address; the directory does not render random service.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Do not hide the enter error with the count="#" for each broken record.

nextjs-middleware-login-loop.title: Next.js Middleware creates a redirect loop on /login
nextjs-middleware-login-loop.description: The browser informs about too many redirections and the login route does not open.
nextjs-middleware-login-loop.intro: The browser informs about too many redirections and the login route does not open. Matcher or auth condition can also capture the login page or the resources needed to make the redirection.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Check the Network status sequence of 307 and Location addresses by saving the first URL and end URL.
Compare matchr with /login, /api/auth and resources  next; check if the session is actually read.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Disable the public log-in route from redirecting to it itself and separate rules for the guest and user logged in.
2 . Instead of comparing the presence of cookies itself, check the session on the site of the appropriate server, taking into account the expiration.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: From the incognito window the entrance to the protected route ends with one redirection, and the entry to the login works without a loop.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not set a matchr to control all static resources.

nextjs-next-redirect-caught-exception.title: Next.js: NEXT REDIRECT goes to catch and redirect is not working
nextjs-next-redirect-caught-exception.description: After calling redirect(), the user stays on the page, and NEXT REDIRECT appears in the log.
nextjs-next-redirect-caught-exception.intro: After calling redirect(), the user stays on the page, and NEXT REDIRECT appears in the log. The redirect function throws an internal navigation control exception; a wide tri/catch can swallow it.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Search for redirect() inside tri/catch blocks in Server Action and Server Component.
Check that the catch returns the message or the error object instead of allowing the redirection.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Execute the write operation in tri and redirect() only when the write has been completed.
2 . Separate validation and database errors from navigation change; use a controlled state value to return form errors.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: After the correct record, the correct redirection occurs and the write error continues to give clear information in the form.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not treat NEXT REDIRECT as a normal server error and do not return the code 500.

nextjs-nextfont-google-build-fetch-fail.title: Next.js next/font: Failed to fetch Google Fonts during build
nextjs-nextfont-google-build-fetch-fail.description: The implementation interrupts the compilation when downloading fonts by next/font/google.
nextjs-nextfont-google-build-fetch-fail.intro: The implementation interrupts the compilation when downloading fonts by next/font/google. The build process may not have access to the font server, and automatic fetch is not reliable in every environment.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check the specific font, its weight and network error logs from the build process. Compare whether the project is going through build in and without network access.
Compare the message from the console with the result of the production compilation and the condition after the page has been refreshed.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Verify font configuration and use the local files obtained by next/font/local if necessary. Make sure that selected scales and subsets actually exist and do not generate unnecessary requests.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: Build passes without uncontrolled resource download in runtime and the text is readable at Fallback.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Do not download random fonts from unknown pages or violate their license.

nextjs-notfound-caught-in-try.title: Next.js notFound() ends as a 500 error after an exception has been caught
nextjs-notfound-caught-in-try.description: The non-existent article should return 404, but the catch turns the internal notFound() into a simple application error.
nextjs-notfound-caught-in-try.intro: The non-existent article should return 404, but the catch turns the internal notFound() into a simple application error. The notFound function interrupts rendering with special exception to the framework, which can be misused.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Search for notFound() calls in tri/catch blocks and see what catch support does. In the test request, compare the HTTP status of the non-existent slug and the rendering method not-found.tsx.
Compare the message from the console with the result of the production compilation and the condition after the page has been refreshed.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Support base errors inside tri, and the condition of no record evaluate beyond catch and call notFound() there. Keep separate states: no entry, lack of permission and failure of the API should lead to different answers.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: The non-existent address returns 404 with the correct error page, and the database failure is not hidden as no entry.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Do not return 200 with the text itself “not found” because this creates Soft 404 in SEO.

nextjs-opengraph-image-runtime-error.title: Next.js opengraph-image generates 500 when sharing a link
nextjs-opengraph-image-runtime-error.description: The page opens normally, but endpoint /opengraph-image returns 500 and the thumbnail in the communicator does not work.
nextjs-opengraph-image-runtime-error.intro: The page opens normally, but endpoint /opengraph-image returns 500 and the thumbnail in the communicator does not work. The generation of OG graphics has separate environmental and font limitations and can follow instructions other than the main page.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Track the error log of the graphics route itself and check that the request does not involve a different runtime. Verify image size, supported formats and whether the font used is available in the implementation package.
Compare the message from the console with the result of the production compilation and the condition after the page has been refreshed.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Simplify the renderer and transfer the correct fonts or resources supported by ImageResponse, without appeals to the unavailable filesystem. Test the image directly under its URL, regardless of page rendering and Open Graph metadata.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: The image returns 200 with the correct media type, and the link preview shows the current graphics.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Do not assume that the correct og:image in HTML means the working endpoint of the thumbnail itself.

nextjs-opengraph-stara-miniaturka.title: Next.js: link thumbnail in Messenger or LinkedIn does not change
nextjs-opengraph-stara-miniaturka.description: You replaced Open Graph graphics, but the preview shows the old one. Check metadata, image address, and cache.
nextjs-opengraph-stara-miniaturka.intro: After changing the appearance of the page, the link still shows the old graphics or the old title.

sections.title: Where's the problem coming from?
paragraphs: Social platforms cache Open Graph data. In addition, Next.js can generate a different og:image than expected.

sections.title: What to do step by step?
paragraphs: 1. Open the HTML source of the production page and find og:image, og:title and canonical.
2 . Check if the image URL works publicly without authorization and returns the correct format.
3 . When the graphics have changed, use the new version identifier in the image address.
4 . Use the diagnostic tools of the platform to re-download the preview if available.
5 . Compare Messenger, LinkedIn and a simple browser because each platform has a separate cache.

sections.title: Correction test and important trap
paragraphs: New URL og:image returns a new image, and after the platform cache update they read the correct thumbnail.
Do not assume that refresh favicon will change the image of the shared link. It's separate metadata.

nextjs-output-export-dynamic-route-error.title: Next.js output export: dynamic route missing generationStaticParams
nextjs-output-export-dynamic-route-error.description: Output project: export is built until it passes through the dynamic route and reports missing generationStaticParams.
nextjs-output-export-dynamic-route-error.intro: Output project: export is built until it passes through the dynamic route and reports missing generationStaticParams. Static export cannot generate new pages on demand, so it needs a set of addresses known during the build.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check the output setting in next.config and a list of routes with segments in square brackets. Determine whether the data of all parties exists at the time of construction, or are taken upon request.
Compare the message from the console with the result of the production compilation and the condition after the page has been refreshed.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Add genericStaticParams returning a set of parameters when the set is known and finished. If the addresses are to be created dynamically, remove static export and use hosting supporting server rendering.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: After the build there is HTML for each intended service, and the new service requires the intended publication procedure.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Do not set dynamicParams=true as an alleged repair of static export restrictions.

nextjs-parallel-routes-default-404.title: Next.js parallel routes: After refresh the modal turns into 404
nextjs-parallel-routes-default-404.description: The navigation in the app opens modal, but a direct refresh of the current URL shows no matching of the parallel route.
nextjs-parallel-routes-default-404.intro: The navigation in the app opens modal, but a direct refresh of the current URL shows no matching of the parallel route. Parallel routes and intercepting routes may require default.tsx for slots that do not fit during full reload.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check the directory structure @slot, (.)segment and missing default.tsx files. Compare soft navigation with direct URL entry in the new window, especially for closed modals.
Compare the message from the console with the result of the production compilation and the condition after the page has been refreshed.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Add the provided default.tsx to parallel slots and provide a separate full page for direct navigation. Set the model closing semantics and browser history so Back does not lead to an empty view.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: Soft navigation shows modal, and reload gives a working page or conscious fallback, instead of an accidental 404.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Do not treat the intercepted route as the only page available under a given URL.

nextjs-revalidatepath-wrong-url.title: Next.js validatePath does not refresh a particular subpage
nextjs-revalidatepath-wrong-url.description: After performing the revalidatePath action, the user still sees a buffered version of the order details.
nextjs-revalidatepath-wrong-url.intro: After performing the revalidatePath action, the user still sees a buffered version of the order details. The path to be cancelled may not correspond to the actual route or dynamic reference.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check which path the user opens and what value you pass to the revalidatePath. For dynamic segments compare the full URL of a specific record with the /[id] pattern and type parameter.
Compare the message from the console with the result of the production compilation and the condition after the page has been refreshed.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Call revalidatePath with the actual path of a specific page or the correct pattern and type compatible with API. Separate the invalidation of the list from the subpage of details when both collect other data.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: After changing the record, both corresponding views show a new value in the scenario.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Do not cancel the entire service in response to changing a single entry if not needed.

nextjs-robots-noindex-vercel.title: Next.js on Vercel: Why does Google see noindex?
nextjs-robots-noindex-vercel.description: The browser opens the page, but the robot gets noindex. Check the robots, the headlines, and environmental protection.
nextjs-robots-noindex-vercel.intro: Search Console informs about noindex exclusion, even though the owner wants to show the site in the results.

sections.title: Where's the problem coming from?
paragraphs: Noindex can be saved in metadata robots, X-Robots-Tag header, middleware or only for preview addresses.

sections.title: What to do step by step?
paragraphs: 1. Open a production URL with your own domain and check meta robots in HTML.
2 . Verify reply headers, in particular X-Robots-Tag.
3 . Check the robots.ts file and possible middleware or CDN rules.
4 . Separate deliberate preview blocking from the production side.
5 . After the amendment, use the URL inspection in Search Console and observe indexing again.

sections.title: Correction test and important trap
paragraphs: The production site is public and does not emit unintended noindex; the preview address may remain protected.
The license at robots.txt hates meta noindex. These mechanisms have different roles.

nextjs-route-handler-body-used.title: Next.js Route Handler: Body is unusable at second read request.json()
nextjs-route-handler-body-used.description: Endpoint returns Body is unusable or stream already read when trying to reread POST data.
nextjs-route-handler-body-used.intro: Endpoint returns Body is unusable or stream already read when trying to reread POST data. Request body stream can only be consumed once unless it has been cloned before.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Check whether middleware, debug login or validation perform request.text() before request.json().
Save the order of operations on the Request object in one endpoint call.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Read request.json() exactly once and keep a sparred object for validation and business logic.
2 . If you need to preview raw content, use request.clone() with intent before consumption and limit the size of payload.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: Endpoint takes the correct JSON, and malformed JSON returns controlled 400 instead of an exception.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not save all raw content of requests with customer data to public logs.

nextjs-route-handler-get-caching-stale.title: Next.js Route Handler GET returns old JSON after upgrade
nextjs-route-handler-get-caching-stale.description: After changing the configuration endpoint /api/config shows the previous values, although the database has new data.
nextjs-route-handler-get-caching-stale.intro: After changing the configuration endpoint /api/config shows the previous values, although the database has new data. Cache and the way routers are rendered depend on the Next.js version and the explicit revalidate or fetch settings.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check the framework version and endpoint response on the Network with the appropriate cache headers. Compare data read directly in the database and result of the same request without CDN or browser cache.
Compare the message from the console with the result of the production compilation and the condition after the page has been refreshed.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: For fresh data, configure the appropriate cache-control or dynamic behavior and clearly label the operation as dynamic. For data that can be cached, set the foreseeable refresh time and controlled cancellation cache.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: After changing the record, the API returns a new value in the required time, and the necessary cache remains effective.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Do not copy cache configuration between different versions of Next.js without checking its meaning.

nextjs-route-handler-options-405.title: Next.js API endpoint returns 405 for OPTIONS method
nextjs-route-handler-options-405.description: The app tries to send a request from another domain, but endpoint corresponds to Method Not Allowed during preflight.
nextjs-route-handler-options-405.intro: The app tries to send a request from another domain, but endpoint corresponds to Method Not Allowed during preflight. The route may not provide the expected methods or the OPTIONS response does not contain the required CORS headers.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check OPTIONS request at DevTools and list of exported GET/POST/OPTIONS handlers in route.ts file. Compare the required methods, headers and origin with endpoint configuration and reverse proxy.
Compare the message from the console with the result of the production compilation and the condition after the page has been refreshed.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Implement OPTIONS with the corresponding Access-Control-Allow-* headers for exactly allowed domains. Keep real POST authorization and return controlled 405 for deliberately unsupported methods.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: Preflight passes, and trusted origin can send the right POST, while maintaining a refusal for unauthorised customers.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Do not confuse CORS with user authorisation; the compatible domain itself does not give access to data.

nextjs-router-refresh-not-updating-data.title: Next.js router.refresh() does not refresh data from the list
nextjs-router-refresh-not-updating-data.description: After saving the router.refresh record, it does not show a new value despite the completed POST.
nextjs-router-refresh-not-updating-data.intro: After saving the router.refresh record, it does not show a new value despite the completed POST. Fresh renews route rendering, but internal data sources can still return a cache of old response.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: See if the mutation has been successful and if there has actually been a change in the database. Verify cache fetch settings, revalidate and Client Component response to new server props.
Compare the message from the console with the result of the production compilation and the condition after the page has been refreshed.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Cancel the proper cache by revalidatePath or revalidateTag mechanisms in trusted server action. Make sure your client does not overwrite current props with an old local state or response to earlier fetch.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: After saving the change appears in UI without full reboot of the application and without turning off all cache.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Do not treat router.refresh as a substitute for correct cancellation of application data.

nextjs-server-action-body-size.title: Next.js Server Action rejects larger form or attachment
nextjs-server-action-body-size.description: A small form works and sending more fields or a file ends in a request size limit error.
nextjs-server-action-body-size.intro: A small form works and sending more fields or a file ends in a request size limit error. Server Actions have settings limiting the size of the data transmitted and are not automatically the best way to large files.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Check the actual body size on the Network and the error content on the server.
Determine if there is a file, base64 or repeated large JSON instead of the fields themselves.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Move a large upload to a properly secured storage or separate endpoint; in Server Action, transfer the file identifier.
2 . If this is a justified small increase in data, configure the appropriate limit after risk assessment and add size validation.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: The correct size form passes and exceeding the limit gives a readable message instead of an error of 500.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not raise the limit to any value globally, because it increases the cost and the surface of the attack.

nextjs-server-only-module-client.title: Next.js: server-only module accidentally imported in Client Component
nextjs-server-only-module-client.description: Build detects unauthorised import of server-only module into the component from use client.
nextjs-server-only-module-client.intro: Build detects unauthorised import of server-only module into the component from use client. The module can read secrets or Node APIs and must not be placed in the browser Bundle.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Identify the import chain leading from Client Component to the server file. See if the function in the module takes token, connects to the base or uses process.env without NEXT PUBLUC .
Compare the message from the console with the result of the production compilation and the condition after the page has been refreshed.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Transfer sensitive logic to Server Component, Server Action or Route Handler, and transfer only the permitted data to the customer. Mark confidential modules with server-only import and separate types from runtime function so random import does not return.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: The compilation passes and the secret key does not appear in the Bundle downloaded by the browser.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Do not replace server-only by NEXT PUBLIC  when using private token.

nextjs-sitemap-nie-pokazuje-nowych-url.title: New article does not go to sitemap.xml in Next.js
nextjs-sitemap-nie-pokazuje-nowych-url.description: How to find an error in generating sitemap Next.js and make sure that new addresses are visible to robots.
nextjs-sitemap-nie-pokazuje-nowych-url.intro: The new guide works, but after entering sitemap.xml his address is missing.

sections.title: Where's the problem coming from?
paragraphs: The list of service in sitemap may be static or may not use the same source as routing. The map could have been generated from an old set.

sections.title: What to do step by step?
paragraphs: 1. Open public /sitemap.xml and search for exact service.
2 . Check the implementation of src/app/sitemap.ts and import data from which subpages are created.
3 . Compare all service with genericStaticParams with address in sitemap.
4 . Verify whether the new version of the code has actually been implemented into production.
5 . Test each sitemap entry with HTTP response, without redirecting to an unavailable version.

sections.title: Correction test and important trap
paragraphs: The new guide is in sitemap and returns 200 after opening under the correct domain.
The mere presence of the URL in the site map does not guarantee Google indexation.

nextjs-sitemap-preview-domain.title: Next.js sitemap contains preview addresses instead of production domain
nextjs-sitemap-preview-domain.description: Sitemap XML works, but its loc elements indicate the temporary domain of deploya Vercel.
nextjs-sitemap-preview-domain.intro: Sitemap XML works, but its loc elements indicate the temporary domain of deploya Vercel. Addresses in sitemap were built from an unstable variable VERCEL URL instead of from the public canonical domain.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Open a production sitemap and check the prefix of several random loc items. Compare the address design in app/sitemap.ts with the canonical domain set in metadataBase.
Compare the message from the console with the result of the production compilation and the condition after the page has been refreshed.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Use the open canonical production domain in the map generator and build the absolute URL of all important sites. Separate the preview environment map from production if you publish previews indexed only for your own needs.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: Sitemap contains the addresses of the appropriate HTTPS host, and their canonical indicates the same host.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Do not enter in the sitemap every short-term preview domain, because this makes it difficult to consolidate the URL.

nextjs-suspense-searchparams-static-404.title: Next.js: useSearchParams corrupts static 404 error page
nextjs-suspense-searchparams-static-404.description: During the next build there is a message about the missing Suspense border on / not-found, although the home page works.
nextjs-suspense-searchparams-static-404.intro: During the next build there is a message about the missing Suspense border on / not-found, although the home page works. Hook reading a query string can be rendered by a common layout, even if it is not in the error page file itself.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: View layout.tsx and all shared header or menu items using useSearchParams.
Start the production build and read the full track to find the component that shuts down static rendering.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Separate the client component with the hook and surround it with Suspense as close to where to use, leaving the rest of the page rendered on the server.
2 . If the page is really to be dynamic, choose consciously dynamic rendering instead of artificially shutting down build rules.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: The Build ends without an error / not-found, and support 404 and search in the menu work after overload.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not remove the entire routing mechanism or hide the problem by turning off the lynting.

nextjs-trailing-slash-redirect-loop.title: Next.js: traileringSlash creates redirections between /offer and /offer/
nextjs-trailing-slash-redirect-loop.description: Request /offer passes through another 308 and returns to the previous address.
nextjs-trailing-slash-redirect-loop.intro: Request /offer passes through another 308 and returns to the previous address. Next.js and external reverse proxy can enforce conflicting Slash rules at the end of URL.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check the full Location response chain for both address variants. Compare the traileringSlash setting in next.config with CDN, host and proxy rules.
Compare the message from the console with the result of the production compilation and the condition after the page has been refreshed.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Select one strategy to trackSlash and remove the opposing rule in the second layer of routing. Update internal links, canonical and sitemap to one version of the address.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: Both variants end up on one target URL without a loop, and the page returns 200.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Do not try to silence the loop by ignoring the redirects in the crawler.

nextjs-window-not-defined-ssr.title: Next.js: window is not defined during SSR component
nextjs-window-not-defined-ssr.description: The application works on customer navigation, but the page refresh ends with a window is not defined error.
nextjs-window-not-defined-ssr.intro: The application works on customer navigation, but the page refresh ends with a window is not defined error. Window object does not exist in the server rendering environment; library import can perform the code immediately.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Check whether the window reads in the upper range of the module, while rendering or inside the library.
Locate the import after which the error begins, and check its SSR compatibility.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Move a code requiring a window to the useEffect run in the browser or to a component loaded exclusively on the client side.
2 . If the library does not support SSR, separate its integration from the rest of the page and add a safe replacement view.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: Direct opening and refresh of the page works without error; the browser function still works after hydration.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not use typeof window in random places if the import itself causes an exception earlier.

node-npm-ci-eresolve-lockfile-bledy-buil.title: nm does not work on CI: package-lock incompatible with package.json
node-npm-ci-eresolve-lockfile-bledy-buil.description: You end up with a bug in GitHub Actions or Vercel, and an example install locally? Check lockfile, Node version and dependency.
node-npm-ci-eresolve-lockfile-bledy-buil.intro: The e.g. command is intentionally more stringent than e.g. install. In the production pipeline requires consistent package.json and package-lock.json and does not repair them in flight. Therefore, the project may operate locally but not build in CI.

sections.title: How to Recognize Cause
paragraphs: Open the first e.g. error in CI logs and save its exact content. Distinguish no package in lockfile from peerDependenties conflict and from Node version error or e.g.
Compare package.json and package-lock.json in the commission selected for construction. Remember that local node modules may contain remnants of packages that are not in dependencies files.

sections.title: Step by step solution
paragraphs: 1. Start by making sure that you work on the right branch and have no unwritten changes. Check git status and differences in package.json and package-lock.json.

2 . Run egm install in a controlled environment with compatible Node version and egm to play the correct package-lock.json file. It does not automatically remove the cause of conflict of incompatible versions.
3 . Run a clean installation e.g., preferably in a separate working directory or after the safe removal of local dependencies. Do not perform destructive cleaning in a directory with unsaved code.

4 . If the problem concerns peer defaulters, identify specific packages and match their versions. Flag legacy-peer-deps can mask conflict and should be a conscious, coherent decision rather than a first response.
5 . Save and push the compatible lockfile together with package.json, then repeat CI. Check whether the pipeline uses the same main Node version as the local environment.

sections.title: How to see if the problem is gone
paragraphs: The course of e.g. should end without error, and after it should pass typecheck, tests and production build. The correct installation itself does not guarantee the correct application.
On a new branch or a clean clown run the same sequence of commands as CI to ensure that the result does not depend on the random content of node modules.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not add node modules to the repository and do not delete package-lock.json just to disable the conflict. You're going to lose the reproducibility of the installation.

og-image-link-pokazuje-stary-obraz.title: Link to page in the communicator shows an outdated image
og-image-link-pokazuje-stary-obraz.description: The difference between favicon, Open Graph and the image in the link card. How to improve the preview in social media.
og-image-link-pokazuje-stary-obraz.intro: You provide a link to your portfolio, and the miniature still shows an old project or bad frame.

sections.title: Where's the problem coming from?
paragraphs: The communicators read og:image tags and often store the previous response in the cache.

sections.title: What to do step by step?
paragraphs: 1. Check og:image directly in HTML of target URL.
2 . Verify the dimension, Mime type and file availability for an unincorporated robot.
3 . Match valid text and logo to the safe miniature area.
4 . When you changed the file, use the new unchanged image URL.
5 . Open the platform preview debugging tool if it supports redownload.

sections.title: Correction test and important trap
paragraphs: The source of the page gives the correct image that can be downloaded in public. After refreshing cache the preview should show it.
Changing the image on the home page does not in itself change og:image.

openrouter-api-401-unauthorized.title: Openrouter API returns 401 Unauthorized — what to check?
openrouter-api-401-unauthorized.description: Error 401 in AI assist on page. API key, Authorization header, design and configuration of the server.
openrouter-api-401-unauthorized.intro: Chat page shows an error instead of an answer, and endpoint Openrouter returns 401 Unauthorized.

sections.title: Why is there a problem?
paragraphs: Usually the problem concerns the key, the Authorization header format, the permissions or the wrong environment from which the key is read.

sections.title: Diagnostics and solutions
paragraphs: 1. Check the response status and request ID in the logs without printing the API key.
2 . Verify if the server code uses the corresponding environment variable.
3 . Make sure the header has the required Bearer format and does not contain random spaces.
4 . Check the key status and possible limitations in the supplier panel.
5 . After turning the key, perform a new deploy or reboot according to the platform and test on a short question.

sections.title: How to check and avoid what?
paragraphs: The server receives the correct response from the API and the key does not appear in HTML, console or repository.
Never send a secret key from a browser via NEXT PUBLAC or a client code.

openrouter-vercel-env-nie-czyta-klucza.title: Openrouter on Vercel: ENV variable is set, but API does not work
openrouter-vercel-env-nie-czyta-klucza.description: AI API error after defloy. Preview and Production Difference, variable name and need for new implementation.
openrouter-vercel-env-nie-czyta-klucza.intro: The AI assistant works on localhost, but after publication does not get answers and logs suggest no configuration.

sections.title: Why is there a problem?
paragraphs: The variable could be added only for the Preview environment, had a typo in the name or did not reach the already built version.

sections.title: Diagnostics and solutions
paragraphs: 1. Compare variable name in code with name in Vercel Environment Variables.
2 . Check Production, Preview and Development range.
3 . Do not display variable value in logs or debug endpoint.
4 . Make a new deploy after updating the configuration if required.
5 . Test endpoint server, support limit and user messages.

sections.title: How to check and avoid what?
paragraphs: Production responds to the test question and no key displays a controlled message without revealing a secret.
Do not skip the server by placing the Openrouter key in the frontend code.

phishing-domena-wymaga-pilnego-odnowieni.title: Mail: The domain requires urgent renewal — how do you recognize phishing?
phishing-domena-wymaga-pilnego-odnowieni.description: False invoices and threats to shut down the domain. How to check the sender, link and actual renewal date.
phishing-domena-wymaga-pilnego-odnowieni.intro: You receive an urgent domain shutdown message and a link to payment or login appears in the content.

sections.title: Why is there a problem?
paragraphs: Cheaters use time pressure and similar domains and company names. The displayed sender name does not confirm his identity.

sections.title: Diagnostics and solutions
paragraphs: 1. Do not click the link and do not download the attachment from the suspicious message.
2 . Open the recorder panel by entering the known address manually and check the actual domain term.
3 . Compare the sender's technical domain, Reply-To and the target link domain.
4 . If the message supposedly comes from a supplier, please contact him via official channel.
5 . Keep the original message with the headers as evidence, but delete or mask private data before sharing.

sections.title: How to check and avoid what?
paragraphs: The status of the domain and invoices confirms the recorder directly and the user does not enter the data on the website from the suspicious link.
The correct SPF or DKIM alone does not prove that the whole message is honest.

phishing-pismo-urzad-skarbowy-email.title: A false letter from the tax office in an e-mail — How Can I Check?
phishing-pismo-urzad-skarbowy-email.description: An urgent e-mail in the IRS may be an attempt to extort. Safe verification and preservation of evidence.
phishing-pismo-urzad-skarbowy-email.intro: E -mail fails the official notification and urges you to immediately click the attachment or link.

sections.title: Why is there a problem?
paragraphs: Attackers use known institution names to induce data or run a harmful file.

sections.title: Diagnostics and solutions
paragraphs: 1. Do not log in via link from unverified email.
2 . Enter the official tax administration portal yourself and check the notifications.
3 . Save a copy of the original .eml message if you collect evidence of the incident.
4 . Check the sender and the link domain; do not rely only on the name displayed in the From field.
5 . Report a suspicious message to the appropriate response team and secure your accounts if you click.

sections.title: How to check and avoid what?
paragraphs: Verification takes place through an official portal or independent contact channel, not through the content of a suspicious email.
Do not publish full email headers with private addresses, IDs and tokens.

pixel-dwukrotne-zliczanie-potwierdzenie.title: Pixel and Conversations API count the same transaction twice on the confirmation page
pixel-dwukrotne-zliczanie-potwierdzenie.description: Description of diagnosis, differentiation of causes and safe corrective steps when pixel and Conversations API register the same sales twice on the confirmation page. Includes verification tests and typical mistakes to avoid.
pixel-dwukrotne-zliczanie-potwierdzenie.intro: Problem: on the order confirmation / thank-you page, you see that the conversion is reported twice in Meta (Facebook/Meta Ads) tools. The most common cause is not the “bug” of the pixel itself or the API, but overlapping sources of events: the front-end Meta Pixel sends the event purchase and backend Conversations API sends the same event without correlation. The purpose of this instruction is to provide methodological differential diagnosis, a list of specific corrective steps, and tests that will confirm the removal of double counting. We do not assume the only reason — we will examine what usually occurs in SPA configurations, intermediate servers and integration of e-commerce.

sections.title: How to Recognize Cause
paragraphs: The most common scenario: on the confirmation page both the client (viewer) calls Meta Pixel (fbq('track','Purchase',...) and the server sends the Conversions API with the same transaction identifier. The absence of Meta-side deduplication (event id or deduplication parameters) causes duplication. Check if event id is generated and transmitted identically from front-end and backend.

Other possible causes: charging pixel script multiple times (e.g. SPA without routing control), retry logic on the server sending CAPI again at errors, or indirect integrations (e.g. tag manager or shop plugin) that send additional Purchase events. Identify the source of each event in Event Manager by 'Event source' and 'Event source detail'.

sections.title: Step by step solution
paragraphs: 1. Step 1 — Identify time and event identifier: in Meta Events Manager, select an example duplicated event and note down timestamp, event name, and event id (if available). Determine whether both entries have the same event id.

2 . Step 2 — View frontend: Open the confirmation page in development mode, monitor the console and Network. Check that fbq('track','Purchase') is called more than once and that event id is included as custom data.event id or event id parameter in request payoad.

3 . Step 3 — View backend/server: check server logs or the forwarding mechanism Conversations API. Find payload sent to /events from event name=Purchase field and see if the same event id or order id transaction identifier is sent. If there is no event id, enter a coherent event id.

4 . Step 4 — Deduplication implementation: if you want to use both sources, make sure the front-end generates a unique event id (UUID v4) and transmits it to the backend together with the order, and backend sends the same event id in the field 'event id' in Conversations API.

5 . Step 5 — Blocking duplicates on the client side: if you do not use CAPI or prefer to disable pixel, add a condition on the confirmation page that sends pixel only if the order was not previously registered in session (e.g. session flagStorage 'purchase sent').

6 . Step 6 — Check intermediate integrations: view Tag Manager configurations, shop plugins (Shopify/ WooCommerce), and middleware CDN to make sure no tool sends an additional Purchase. Disable the suspicious rules individually and watch the events.

7 . Step 7 — Test retry and idempotence: if backend retrys the shipment at errors, make sure the retry uses the same event id, rather than generating a new one. Otherwise Meta will treat retra as a new conversion.

sections.title: How to see if the problem is gone
paragraphs: Test 1 — Tracing: execute a test order with a unique event id, then in Events Manager check that only one Purchase event appears with this event id. Make sure time stampes the front and backend matches movement.

Test 2 — A/B: temporarily disable the return shipment (CAPI) and order: there should remain a single event with source 'Pixel'. Then turn off the pixel and turn on CAPI only — there should be one more event. This will confirm which source generates the duplicate.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Warning 1 — Do not rely solely on order id from the store system: Meta uses event id to deduplication; order id can be different format and does not guarantee deduplication if you do not map it to event id.
Warning 2 — Do not generate new event id at retry: if the retry creates a new event id, Meta will treat this as a separate conversion. Implement event id storage at order save level.
Warning 3 — Avoid removing pixel without a plan: a major pixel shutdown can stop other marketing events (ViewContent, AddToCart). Better deduplication than arbitraryly shutting down sources.

postgres-22001-string-too-long.title: PostgreSQL: 22001 value too long for type character variety
postgres-22001-string-too-long.description: Writing a longer description ends with a 22001 error instead of creating a record.
postgres-22001-string-too-long.intro: Writing a longer description ends with a 22001 error instead of creating a record. The varchar(n) column has a length limit which may be less than the actual content of the form.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Compare the length of the sent value with the column definition in the database scheme.
Check that the API does not add an additional prefix or JSON to the short text field.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. If the field stores a full description, consider the text type and validation of the business limit at application level.
2 . If the limit is intentional, show the character counter in the form and validate the length on the server side.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: Longer, acceptable text is saved, and the superlimit gets a clear validation message.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not cut customer data quietly without informing the user.

postgres-22p02-invalid-uuid.title: PostgreSQL: 22P02 invalid input syntax for type uuid
postgres-22p02-invalid-uuid.description: The API returns SQLSTATE 22P02 when the filter or INSERT has received text that is not a valid UUID.
postgres-22p02-invalid-uuid.intro: The API returns SQLSTATE 22P02 when the filter or INSERT has received text that is not a valid UUID. The uuid column requires the correct identifier format, and the frontend can send an empty string or undefined text.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Save the value type sent to the endpoint and check that the route parameter really contains ID.
Verify that the form does not replace the missing UUID with an empty string instead of null.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Add server side ID validation before calling the database and distinguish the lack of ID from the wrong format.
