2 . Do not use projecting all values into text; move the identifier from the corresponding record field.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: Invalid ID gives controlled 400 and the correct goes to the correct query.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not construct SQL filters by concatenationing an unverified parameter with URL.

postgres-23505-duplicate-key.title: PostgreSQL: 23505 duplicate key value Violates unique contrast
postgres-23505-duplicate-key.description: Data insertion or synchronization stops at SQLSTATE 23505.
postgres-23505-duplicate-key.intro: Data insertion or synchronization stops at SQLSTATE 23505. The UNIQUE or PRIMARY KEY index detected a repeated value which the data model considers to be unique.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Read the name of the breached contraint and columns specified in the error details.
See if it's a real duplicate, a webhook rerun, or a conflict of ID numbering.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. For idmpotent imports, use a public ON CONFLICT with a specific business key and proper update semantics.
2 . If the data should not be unique in this respect, redesign the index after checking the requirements instead of shutting down all restrictions.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: Reprocessing the same message does not duplicate and does not destroy previous data.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not use ON CONFLICT TO NOTTING for all errors without recording them.

postgres-40001-serialization-failure.title: PostgreSQL: 40001 could not serialize access due to conventional update
postgres-40001-serialization-failure.description: Two operations on the same data end in SQLSTATE 40001 error at a higher level of isolation.
postgres-40001-serialization-failure.intro: Two operations on the same data end in SQLSTATE 40001 error at a higher level of isolation. The transaction could not be safely approved in accordance with isolation requirements and must be repeated as a whole.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Check the isolation level and whether the recording occurs in several separate transactions instead of one.
Identify conflicts occurring while editing a particular contract.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Renew the complete transaction with a limited number of attempts and an increasing delay, maintaining the idempotence.
2 . Consider limiting transaction length and a coherent order of record modification.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: Two parallel operations end in correct result without double side effects.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Don't just repeat the last INSERT inside the damaged transaction.

postgres-40p01-deadlock-detected.title: PostgreSQL: 40P01 deadlock detected during simultaneous recording
postgres-40p01-deadlock-detected.description: During parallel recording of two records, one transaction ends with a deadlock detected error, although individual records work.
postgres-40p01-deadlock-detected.intro: During parallel recording of two records, one transaction ends with a deadlock detected error, although individual records work. Two transactions await each other's locks; PostgreSQL interrupts one to resolve the dependency cycle.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Check deadlock details in Postgres logs: PID transactions, accounts and statements awaiting lockout.
Compare UPDATE's order of two tables in competing operations and check the transaction length, especially with CRM calls.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Set a coherent order for downloading locks and modifying tables for all code paths of the same process.
2 . Shorten transactions and SQLSTATE 40P01 handle a limited retra of the entire transaction with an idmpotent recording of side effects.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: Parallel load tests end with correct results without losing updates and without double webhooks and repeat payments.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not just increase lock timeout as a solution, because this does not remove the cyclical relationship between the transactions.

postgres-42p01-relation-does-not-exist.title: PostgreSQL: 42P01 relation does not exist after migration
postgres-42p01-relation-does-not-exist.description: The application reports 42P01, although the table was created in a developer environment.
postgres-42p01-relation-does-not-exist.intro: The application reports 42P01, although the table was created in a developer environment. The database does not find a relation under given name or in active search path.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Check the production database identifier, used schematic and current search path session.
Compare completed migrations with files in the repository instead of creating a table manually without history.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Run missing, tested migrations on the right environment with backup.
2 . If the table exists in another scheme, use the correct selection scheme.Name and make sure the role has permission.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: The query to the target database works both locally and on production, and migrations have the same version.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not reset the production base in response to a lack of one relationship.

postgres-57014-statement-timeout.title: PostgreSQL: 57014 cancelling statement due to statement timeout
postgres-57014-statement-timeout.description: The query to the database is interrupted by code 57014, especially with a larger table.
postgres-57014-statement-timeout.intro: The query to the database is interrupted by code 57014, especially with a larger table. The database discontinued execution after exceeding the time limit or upon cancellation request.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: View the EXPLAIN ANALYZE plan in a safe environment and time of execution with production filters.
Check the column indexes used in WHERE, the order of the connectors and whether the application does not download the entire table unnecessarily.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Add an index matching the actual predicate or reduce the query range by pagination and column selection.
2 . Consider increasing the timeout only after measuring and excluding the performance problem.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: The query is executed within the required time and returns the same correct record count.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not set unlimited timeout for each endpoint in response to a single free report.

react-context-provider-recreates-value.title: React Context: all rows render after changing one field
react-context-provider-recreates-value.description: In CRM, changing a single item of the list re-renders a large number of independent components.
react-context-provider-recreates-value.intro: In CRM, changing a single item of the list re-renders a large number of independent components. The context value object can have a new identity on each provider render, even if logical data has not changed.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: In React DevTools Profiler find Context component.Provider and elements responsive to update. Check if value={{...}} and transmitted callbacks are created again in each render.
Compare the message from the console with the result of the production compilation and the condition after the page has been refreshed.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Divide contexts according to independent data types and stabilize the values and functions you really need. For large lists consider state selectors or separate store instead of one context containing all records.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: The profiler shows a smaller number of unnecessary renders while maintaining correct updates.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Do not memoize the entire application with accidental useMemo without measuring actual bottlenecks.

react-effect-fetch-stale-response.title: React: older fetch response overwrites newer search results
react-effect-fetch-stale-response.description: After quickly entering a new query, the list shows the answer for the previous text.
react-effect-fetch-stale-response.intro: After quickly entering a new query, the list shows the answer for the previous text. Asynchronous requests can end in a different order than they were sent.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Save the start and end order of requests for subsequent query values.
Check that the Cleanup effect function cancels or ignores the previous request.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Use the AbbotController and stop the previous fetch when changing the effect dependencies, or use the next request number.
2 . Update status only for the current query and handle the AbbotError separately from the actual API failure.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: After fast character typing, the result corresponds to the last query, regardless of the order of the server response.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not solve the debounce race itself — reduces the number of requests but does not guarantee order.

react-effect-interval-memory-leak.title: React: setInterval multiplies queries after switching bookmarks
react-effect-interval-memory-leak.description: Each reopening of the panel leads to another timer and an increasing number of API requests.
react-effect-interval-memory-leak.intro: Each reopening of the panel leads to another timer and an increasing number of API requests. The effect is created by the interval, but does not slow it down when the component is dependent or unmounted.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check the number of active timers in the component profile and whether the request frequency increases upon re-entry. See cleanup returned by useEffect and those values on which the frequency of query depends.
Compare the message from the console with the result of the production compilation and the condition after the page has been refreshed.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Return clearInterval(id) from the effect, and hold the polling if not needed when hiding the view. In addition to the interval, make sure that you cancel your pending requests so that the older answer does not update the outdated view.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: Upon multiple switching of the panel, one timer or none inactive is visible.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Do not create setInterval directly in the component body during each render.

react-error-boundary-async-rejection.title: React Error Boundary does not catch rejected Promise in click
react-error-boundary-async-rejection.description: After an error while saving the Error Boundary form, it does not display a fallback, and the console shows an unhandled booking.
react-error-boundary-async-rejection.intro: After an error while saving the Error Boundary form, it does not display a fallback, and the console shows an unhandled booking. React error limit refers to rendering and selected phases of components, not all of the errors in the dealers or async tasks.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check where the error occurs: render, event carrier, useEffect or Promise in API. Compare the behavior after the deliberate throw in the render to the error of the rejected fetch inside the onClick.
Compare the message from the console with the result of the production compilation and the condition after the page has been refreshed.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Use tri/catch, controlled error status and readable user message in the event handling. Use the Error Boundary for rendering failures, and transport and validation errors support in the form layer.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: The API error shows the message in the form, and the rendering error separate fallback, without a white screen.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Do not assume that one Error Boundary replaces all asynchronous exceptions.

react-form-button-default-submits.title: React: Clicking the second button accidentally sends the form
react-form-button-default-submits.description: The button opening the preview in the middle of the form calls a submit and saves incomplete data.
react-form-button-default-submits.intro: The button opening the preview in the middle of the form calls a submit and saves incomplete data. The button element without a specified type has the default semantics submit inside the form.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check the DOM structure, not just the JSX component, and determine which button triggers the submit event. Track event subject and number of action calls or handlers in DevTools.
Compare the message from the console with the result of the production compilation and the condition after the page has been refreshed.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Set the auxiliary button as type="button"; only the writing button leave type= "submit". Add validation on the server side and block duplicate entries if you click multiple times.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: Clicking the preview does not send the request, and the record only takes place on a conscious submit.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Do not remove Enter support from the form instead of setting the correct button type.

react-hooks-rendered-fewer.title: React: Rendered five hooks than expected after changing the condition
react-hooks-rendered-fewer.description: After hiding a fragment of the React form, it throws a smaller number of hooks.
react-hooks-rendered-fewer.intro: After hiding a fragment of the React form, it throws a smaller number of hooks. The component induces hooks in a different order between renders, often by return before useMemo or useEfect.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Locate all early return and if instructions before the last hack component.
Check that calling a hook occurs in the loop, condition or auxiliary function only sometimes activated.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Transfer all hooks to the highest component level and place the conditions inside their callbacks or after declarations.
2 . For a conditional section of the interface, separate component with your own invariable set of hooks.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: Changing the condition repeatedly does not generate errors and does not lose the status of the form.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not mute eslint-plugin-react-hooks, because it will remove the warning without repairing the malfunction.

react-input-controlled-uncontrolled.title: React: A component is changing an uncontrolled input to be controlled
react-input-controlled-uncontrolled.description: After downloading the data, the form logs a warning about changing uncontrolled input to controlled.
react-input-controlled-uncontrolled.intro: After downloading the data, the form logs a warning about changing uncontrolled input to controlled. In the first render value can be undefined, and after loading it becomes a string, which changes the way the field is managed.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Check the initial state of useState and the values transferred to value and checked.
Compare the render before the API response with the render after it is completed.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. The upload is a stable input value, e.g. an empty string for the text field, and use value={value ???? Where appropriate.
2 . For checkbox control boolean, and for uncontrollable form use conscious defaultValue instead of mixing approaches.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: The warning disappears after the first render and the entered data does not reset after the status update.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not patch the problem of assigning random text undefined to input.

react-key-duplicate-list.title: React: Encountered two children with the same key in the record list
react-key-duplicate-list.description: After updating or filtering the list items are wrong and the console warns about identical keys.
react-key-duplicate-list.intro: After updating or filtering the list items are wrong and the console warns about identical keys. React uses key to preserve the element identity; two records with the same key break this match.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Compare the IDs returned from the API and the values used as key when mapping the list.
Check that the same position is not added twice as a result of pagination or unidentifiable fetch.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Select a stable unique identifier from the data, and when it is missing, repair the data model or remove the actual duplicate.
2 . When paging, link results by ID, not by blindly pasting all responses.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: After filtering, sorting and updating, each item retains the correct identity and condition.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not use Math.random() or array index to a dynamic list that changes order.

react-maximum-update-depth.title: React: Maximum update depth enhanced at useEffect
react-maximum-update-depth.description: Once the CPU page is opened, the component renders itself in the loop and a maximum update depth error appears.
react-maximum-update-depth.intro: Once the CPU page is opened, the component renders itself in the loop and a maximum update depth error appears. The effect changes the state on which it depends, or each time it receives a new object of dependence.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Check the list of defendencies useEffect and any setState function called inside the effect.
With the help of the render counter, determine whether the default is a new object, array or callback in each render.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Remove the redundant condition if the value can be calculated during rendering; otherwise limit the update to the actual change.
2 . Stabilize the required references with useMemo or use callback only if it solves a specific cause.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: The number of renders stabilizes and the change of input data continues to update the view as expected.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not add empty [] without analysis, because you can freeze the needed syncs.

react-portal-modal-focus-lost.title: React: modal through portal loses focus keyboard
react-portal-modal-focus-lost.description: When the Tab dialog is opened, it goes to items under modal, and Escape does not close the window.
react-portal-modal-focus-lost.intro: When the Tab dialog is opened, it goes to items under modal, and Escape does not close the window. The transfer of a DOM through createPortal does not automatically provide a full mechanism for the availability of dialogue.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check the role of dialogue, aria-modal, label and focus order after opening. Check whether you can still activate the elements in the background by keyboard or if the focus disappears after closing.
Compare the message from the console with the result of the production compilation and the condition after the page has been refreshed.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Use native dialogue or library to provide focus trap, Escape support and proper focus return. Lock background interaction during modal dialogue, and when closed, set focus to the opening button.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: Navigation Tab remains in the open modal window, and Escape closes it and returns focus.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Do not treat high z-index alone as ensuring the availability of a modal interface.

react-ref-current-no-rerender.title: React: change ref.current does not update the counter on screen
react-ref-current-no-rerender.description: Click increases ref.current, but the interface still shows the previous number.
react-ref-current-no-rerender.intro: Click increases ref.current, but the interface still shows the previous number. Ref is used to store mutable values whose change does not trigger rendering React.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check that the counter is displayed directly from ref.current instead of from useState. Determine whether the value is to be displayed on the screen, or only remembered between the handler calls.
Compare the message from the console with the result of the production compilation and the condition after the page has been refreshed.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Move the value that affects UI to useState and use a function update based on the previous value. Leave the useRef for DOM handles and technical data whose update does not need to change the view.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: After clicking, the displayed value is updated according to the state and the ref is not used to render the counter.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Do not force a render by random extra setState if the data source should be the right state.

react-stale-state-handler.title: React: SetState does not increase the counter after a few quick clicks
react-stale-state-handler.description: Three clicks increases the counter only once, although the carrier has called setState multiple times.
react-stale-state-handler.intro: Three clicks increases the counter only once, although the carrier has called setState multiple times. All updates in the same package could read the same status value from the closing function.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Check that the handler saves setCount(count + 1) several times and compare the values used in each call.
Verify whether subsequent events actually cause the same carrier, or whether the problem lies in batching.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Apply the setCount(prev => prev + 1) function update when the new value depends on the previous one.
2 . Separate the calculation of the new condition from the side effects and avoid direct mutation of the useState object.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: Each scheduled increase is visible after the render and does not die when the handler is quickly executed.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not try to fix batching through setTimeout without understanding function updates.

react-state-direct-mutation-no-render.title: React does not render after changing the object in useState
react-state-direct-mutation-no-render.description: After adding the item to the array, the list remains unchanged, although the object in the console already has a new item.
react-state-direct-mutation-no-render.intro: After adding the item to the array, the list remains unchanged, although the object in the console already has a new item. The direct mutation of the array or object retains a reference, and React may skip the state update.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Find push, splice or assign methods to properties performed directly on the state variable. Check if setState gets the same reference as before instead of a new array or object.
Compare the message from the console with the result of the production compilation and the condition after the page has been refreshed.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Apply a non-mutative update, e.g. setItems(prev => [...prev, newItem]), keeping record identifiers. For nested data, copy all changes to the object levels or use the proven immutable update mechanism.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: After adding and removing the item, the view immediately updates and does not modify the historical version of the state.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Do not attempt to forceUpdate as a data mutation solution.

react-strictmode-effect-twice.title: React StrictMode launches effect twice in development
react-strictmode-effect-twice.description: When you open the form in a developer environment you see two identical logs and two queries with effect.
react-strictmode-effect-twice.intro: When you open the form in a developer environment you see two identical logs and two queries with effect. StrictMode mode intentionally launches an additional setup cycle and cleanup effect during development to detect wrong side effects.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Determine whether the problem occurs only in the development or also in the built production application. Check that useEfect has the correct cleanup function and that the code does not create a subscription without release.
Compare the message from the console with the result of the production compilation and the condition after the page has been refreshed.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Add cleanup canceling or closing the subscription, and save the storage operations with idempotence on the server side. If the effect initiates the resource, ensure its unambiguous opening and closing instead of artificial blocking of the second flag start.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: In production, the operation is planned, and in development, the additional test StrictMode leaves no double subscription.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Do not disable StrictMode just to hide the leak or an unidentifiable record.

react-usecallback-stale-permissions.title: React use callback remembers outdated user rights
react-usecallback-stale-permissions.description: After changing the role, the button continues to perform the action according to the previous role saved in callback.
react-usecallback-stale-permissions.intro: After changing the role, the button continues to perform the action according to the previous role saved in callback. Callback may close the old role value in close if it has not been declared in the depositors.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check whether the call is based on privileges in UI or in independent API validation. Review the use of callbacks table and determine when the current session object changes.
Compare the message from the console with the result of the production compilation and the condition after the page has been refreshed.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Consider the role you need to play in dependencies and enforce the current permissions on the server side for each operation. When changing the session, clear the user's cache data and cancel old queries and callbacks.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: The new role is reflected in the interface and the server rejects actions after receiving permissions.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Do not base security on hiding the React status button or memory.

react-usememo-stale-filter-results.title: React useMemo returns old results after filter change
react-usememo-stale-filter-results.description: Changing the selected category does not update the list until another field is changed.
react-usememo-stale-filter-results.intro: Changing the selected category does not update the list until another field is changed. The result of the memoir depends on the value omitted in the dependenties array, so React reuses the outdated calculation.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check all values read in callback useMemo, including parameters and auxiliary functions. Compare the content of the dependencies array with the values that actually affect the filter result.
Compare the message from the console with the result of the production compilation and the condition after the page has been refreshed.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Add all dependencies to useMemo or remove memoization if filtering is cheap and does not require optimization. In the case of data altered by mutation repair, also state updates so that dependency receives new references.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: After changing each filter, the list shows the expected set without refreshing the browser.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Don't ignore the exhaust-deps rules just because the current version looks faster.

reklama-lokalnej-firmy-strona-i-social-m.title: Local company advertising: website, social media and surveying
reklama-lokalnej-firmy-strona-i-social-m.description: How to prepare a local company for the campaign: offer, profile, target page, budget and customer queries handling.
reklama-lokalnej-firmy-strona-i-social-m.intro: Before launching the ad, determine the service you promote, who you show it to and what the person you want to do. For catering it can be a transition to the menu, for the living room booking, and for the service company a conversation about valuation. Each of these situations requires a different path from advertising to action.

sections.title: One campaign should have a clear purpose
paragraphs: Start with one offer and an area you can actually handle. Prepare the photos, offer terms, current times and method of contact. The user should find after clicking what he saw in the advertisement, without looking for the right service on the extended page.

Not every campaign requires a new site. If the current website has an appropriate offer and an efficient form, you just have to work it out. A separate landing page is useful when an offer, a group of recipients or a campaign goal differ from the rest of the service.

sections.title: Why combine social media with the site?
paragraphs: The profile helps show news, offers and daily work. The site orders permanent information: services, scope, realizations, questions and contact. Ensure that the names, contact details and hours are compatible in the channels used by customers.

My cooperation with Jalapeno Kebab in Germany includes advertising, marketing and social media. For StarCars, the range covers the site, advertising and marketing. These are two different contexts: local gastronomy and car import service, where the customer needs more information before contact.

sections.title: What materials to prepare?
paragraphs: Collect up-to-date product or implementation photos, a specific offer description, answers to the most common questions and rules for using the service. The customer's opinion should have his consent and maintain his actual sound. Photos and texts must be suitable for legal use in advertising.

A menu and easy order path are useful for catering. For services — scope of work, examples and a form collecting the information needed for the valuation. Limit the number of fields to those you really need before your first conversation.

sections.title: What do you measure instead of just liking?
paragraphs: Distinguish clicking the contact, sending a query and getting a client. Clicking the phone number does not confirm the call, and the sent form does not mean a valuable order yet. If possible, save the source of the query and its further result.

The cost of a valuable query is calculated by dividing campaign spending by the number of queries meeting the criteria set. When comparing channels, also consider the cost of handling and preparing materials. Configure analytical measurement with the required user permissions.

sections.title: Budget and contacts
paragraphs: Separate the budget paid advertising platform from the remuneration for the service, materials and website. Set the expenditure limit and the conditions for assessing the first results. If unmatched queries occur, check the offer, direct advertising and the form content before increasing the budget.

Also find out who answers your messages and calls back. Write to kacper@bernecki.dev, in which industry you operate, where you serve customers, what you want to promote and what channels you already have. On this basis, we will determine the scope of the action.

reklamy-oze-magazyny-energii.title: RES Advertising and Energy Magazines — How to Get Customers?
reklamy-oze-magazyny-energii.description: How to conduct Meta Ads campaigns for photovoltaics and energy storage: communications, contact qualification, salesmen's service and CPL measurement.
reklamy-oze-magazyny-energii.intro: In the RES industry, contact with a person interested in energy storage is only the beginning. It counts for consistency of the message, correct customer expectations, quick response and technical qualification of the query.

sections.title: One advertisement, one specific application
paragraphs: The energy storage can be presented in the context of autoconsumption, reserve supply or cooperation with existing PV installation. No savings or co-financing should be promised without checking individual conditions.

Before preparing the advertisement, decide who is the recipient: the owner of the new installation, the expansion person PV or the customer of the company. Each of these groups has different questions and technical requirements.

sections.title: Creation should lead to a precise form
paragraphs: The information on the offer should be consistent with what the trader can actually propose. Well selected questions help identify the location, status of the installation and main needs without creating an excessively long form.
It is worth testing several versions of the message, but compare not only the number of applications, but also the percentage of contacts useful for sales.

sections.title: Example from the Re-Energy System campaign
paragraphs: Owner of the Re-Energy System declares that advertising campaigns for about two years were the only source of obtaining company lead. In the available Meta Ads discharges from selected 17 lead campaigns you can see a total of 2,331 contacts, at an average cost of about PLN 29.79.

This is the result of selected campaigns, not the entire period of activity. We do not publish campaign names, areas or budgets of single advertisements. The dumps do not contain an unambiguous period of dates.

sections.title: In RES, efficient lead handling is necessary
paragraphs: With a large influx of calls, you need assignments, contact queues, callback dates and call history. Unserviced forms can impair the effectiveness of even a well-optimized campaign.
The CRM system should show what happened to the lead after the acquisition. Trader work and Meta Ads results are two elements of one process.

sections.title: How to evaluate the score without an artificial ROAS?
paragraphs: The turnover of the whole company and advertising expenses are not enough to calculate the revenue assigned to the campaigns. Data on closed contracts, distribution model and other sources of queries are needed.
Before the campaign is implemented, state what counts as lead, who qualifies it and how the sales result is reported. Full case study is available on the Re-Energy System website in the portfolio.

restauracja-reklama-kolejki-obsluga.description: A lot of interest can expose the limitations of kitchen, supplies and telephone. The relationship with Jalapeno has shown that popularity required an increase in
restauracja-reklama-kolejki-obsluga.intro: A lot of interest can expose the limitations of kitchen, supplies and telephone. The relationship with Jalapeno has shown that popularity required increased supplies and response to queues. It is worth preparing such a plan before increasing the budget.

sections.title: Step by step
paragraphs: 1. Write down the kitchen capacity during rush hours and real waiting time. Ask the service when supplies run out and which positions block the work most.
2 . Update execution time and availability messages. If the place temporarily suspends orders, the information should appear where the customers go, not just on the card at the box office.
3 . Customize your advertising schedule to service availability. You can reduce emissions in overloaded hours and develop business day communications if the company has a spare capacity.
4 . Establish responsibility for phone and messages. Calling advertising is not useful when no one can pick up. Consider a simple message about the current way of ordering.
5 . Compare advertising with operating local data: number of orders, sometimes waiting and returning customers. Interaction in Meta is not a receipt.

sections.title: How to check whether the amendment works
paragraphs: The success is stable handling of additional demand, not just high coverage. Jalapeno's history is a relationship with cooperation, without attributing any visit to a particular advertisement. The increase in the budget should take into account the possibility of housing.

supabase-bledny-klucz-obcy-blokuje-usuni.title: Invalid alien key blocks user removal in Supabase/Postgres — diagnostics and repair
supabase-bledny-klucz-obcy-blokuje-usuni.description: Description of the diagnosis and repair procedure when an attempt to remove the user ends with a reference error: how to find dependent tables, check constraints, RLS policies and triggers, and safely remove or migrate the data.
supabase-bledny-klucz-obcy-blokuje-usuni.intro: Typical symptom: DELETE FROM auth.users WHERE id = '...'; returns an error of the "update or delete on table \"users\" Violates foreign key contrast \"...\" and the operation failed. The reason is not usually a Supabase per se error, but reference restrictions in Postgres — no ON DELETE CASCADE, latent records in related tables, anonymous triggers, or RLS policies preventing visibility/removement of dependence. This document leads step by step: how to locate the contraint, make sure that the restriction is expected, evaluate safe solutions (cascade, soft deletion, data migration) and how to verify correctness repair without loss of data integrity.

sections.title: How to Recognize Cause
paragraphs: Check the DELETE error message: Postgres returns the constraint name and source table. If the message says e.g. "violates foreign key constraint \"fk orders user id\" on table \"orders\", this means that the order table has a user id column referring to users.id. The constraint name allows you to locate the problem site without searching the entire database.

If the message does not exist (e.g. removal from application level), use the query for system directories: join pg constraint, pg class and pg attribute or information schema.table constraints along with key column use to list all constraints indicating the auth.users scheme. This excludes omitted dependencies, including those created by migration tools.

sections.title: Step by step solution
paragraphs: 1. 1) Repeat the SQL Editor Supabase error: run DELETE and copy the full error message. Save the constraint name and target table. It's the only sure evidence that the restriction blocks the removal.

2 . 2) Locate constraint: start SELECT query with pg constraint/pg class, for example SELECT conname, conrelid::regclass AS table from, confrelid::regclass AS table to FROM pg constraint WHE confrelid = 'auth.users'::regclass OR conrelid = 'auth.users'::regclass; — you will find a dependent table and a name Constraint.

3 . 3) Check related records: for each table found run SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dependent table WHERE user id = '<user uuid>'; to assess the scale of late records and whether these are expected references or e.g. Test artifacts.

4 . 4) Check RLS and permissions: in the Supabase check that the row level security on the dependent tables does not hide records from taking DELETE or SELECT commands. Use pg policy and SHOW policies in SQL panel, remembering that lack of visibility can be confused with lack of reference.

5 . 5 ) Rate the solution: if the relationship should delete the descendants automatically — prepare the migration ALTER TABLE dependent table DROP CONSTRAINT conname; ALTER TABLE dependent table ADD CONSTRAINT conname FOREIGN KEY (user id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE; — test on a copy of the database. If child data must be preserved, plan to transfer user id to NULL/anon or create a substitute record.

6 . 6) Safe execution: make changes in transaction on the environment staging. Do a full backup (pg dump) and restore test before changing. In case of manual deletion, first remove records from dependent table in the same transaction or set user id = NULL where acceptable.

7 . 7) Update migrations: After confirmation of action in staging add operations to the migration system (e.g. migration files) and perform deploy along with a short maintenance window to avoid write/delete racing.

sections.title: How to see if the problem is gone
paragraphs: Test 1: Repeat DELETE on target user; no error and returned state 1 row affected is a proof of success. At the same time run SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dependent table WHERE user id = '<user uuid>', the result should be 0 or according to plan (e.g. NULLy).

Test 2: Test reference integrity: run SELECT conname, conrelid::regclass, confrelid::regclass FROM pg constraint WHERE contype='f' and make sure that the constraint has the expected definition (ON DELETE CASCADE or NO ACTION as decided). In addition, test the basic scenarios for creating a child record and removing your parent.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not remove contraint or perform ALTER TABLE without backup and testing — this can lead to data integrity loss or leave unwanted orphaned records.
Do not solve the problem only by removing the user from the application audit/logs; if the dependent records remain, this will cause inconsistencies in the reports and errors in the application.

supabase-limit-1000-recordow-odpowiedz.title: Why Subabase returns up to 1000 records — diagnostics and tests
supabase-limit-1000-recordow-odpowiedz.description: Analysis of the reasons for receiving up to 1000 records in the Supabase/PostgREST response. Includes differentiation of causes (customer, server, Range/LIMIT headers, middleware), specific test steps and ways to repair pagination.
supabase-limit-1000-recordow-odpowiedz.intro: Problem: the query to the Supabase (PostgREST) returns only to 1000 records, even when there are more records in the database. This is not a single reason: the limitation may result from PostgREST server settings, proxy configuration, default supabase-js client behavior, or the use of Range/Preference headers (e.g. max-rows). In practice, you need to check the source of the limitation step by step — from SQL and LIMIT queries, through the HTTP headers used by the library, to the Supabase/Edge instance setting. The following procedure gives a specific list of tests to perform, diagnostic variants (if LIMIT in the query, if PostgREST, if proxies) and proven corrective steps, including the use of key-by-key pagination, cursors or change server settings whenever possible.

sections.title: How to Recognize Cause
paragraphs: Client: check that the code has not been set explicitly .limit(1000) or the default limit. The subbase-js library allows you to connect .select() to .limit(); check the source query code and network logs in the browser/CLI if the LIMIT parameter is not included.

PostgREST/server: PostgREST can use performance limits based on server configuration (e.g. max-rows) or API Gateway proxy can cut answers. If the query directly to PostgREST (e.g. curl) also returns 1000 records, then the limit is on the server/configuration side.

sections.title: Step by step solution
paragraphs: 1. Query replication by curl: download REST endpoint URL (from dashboard or logs), perform curl -i 'https://.../rest/v1/tablename?select=*' with the same Authorization headers; if the answer has 1000 records, then server-side limitation.

2 . Check customer code: browse places with .select(), .range() and .limit() in the repository. Search for the phrase ".limit(" ".range(" "Preference:", make sure it does not interfere with helper pagination. Remove or modify and compare results.

3 . Range/Preference header test: send a curl request with and without the Prefer header: count=exact; then add Preference: params=single-object; compare — PostgREST changes behavior with specific preferences.

4 . Check server logs/API Gateway: if you have access to the Supabase dashboard or proxy layers, check request logs and possible response limits, timeouts or 413/206 multi-part statuses that may suggest cutting answers.

5 . Alternative key pagination: if the database is large, implement indexed column pagination (WHERE id > last id LIMIT 1000); this bypasses the global limit and gives some repetitive parts of the results.
6 . Test directly on DB (psql): if you have permissions, run SELECT COUNT(*) and SELECT * LIMIT 1500; if psql returns >1000, a problem in the HTTP/PostgREST layer, not in the database.

7 . Verify version and documentation: confirm PostgREST/Subbase version in the instance used and compare with documentation on default limits — if the limit results from the host instance configuration, report to support or apply pagination.

sections.title: How to see if the problem is gone
paragraphs: Test A — curl without modification: call endpoint REST with the same headers as the application; compare the number of records with SELECT COUNT(*) with psql. The difference indicates a layer cutting off the response.
Test B — key-by-key pagination: complete the WHE id series of queries > last id LIMIT 500 to run out; if collected records equal to number in COUNT, the solution works and bypasses the limit of 1000.
Test C — remove headers/limits in the client: modify the test code so that it does not use .limit/.range/.Pfer; if the response increases above 1000 at a direct curl, the client was the cause.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not assume that the limit of 1000 is an application error – first compare it with the direct SELECT in DB; moving immediately to changes in the code without curl/psql tests will cause unnecessary changes.
Do not increase LIMIT indefinitely in one production request; large one-time answers can cause timeouts and memory problems on the client/server side.
Do not skip server/API Gateway logs: the lack of their analysis is a common error, because that's where you usually see whether the answer has been cut, changed or pagmed by proxy.
