sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: With typical traffic, the number of connections remains stable and queries do not receive an overload error.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not solve the connection leak by just increasing the instance limit.

supabase-realtime-channel-duplicate-subs.title: Supabase Realtime: the same change appears several times in the table
supabase-realtime-channel-duplicate-subs.description: After entering the screen several times each INSERT adds a record several times.
supabase-realtime-channel-duplicate-subs.intro: After entering the screen several times each INSERT adds a record several times. The cause needs to be checked in the real environment.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check if useEfect creates new channels without removingChannel in cleanup.
Compare the result for the authorized and unauthorised user, project name and exact error code.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Subscribe to one channel for the active view and remove it when unmounting the component.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: One event gives one update of the list regardless of the number of previous entries.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Change permissions and scheme first on test data with backup. Do not put service role in your browser.

supabase-realtime-nie-odswieza-listy.title: Subabase Realtime does not update the list without refresh
supabase-realtime-nie-odswieza-listy.description: Database changes don't appear in React? Check table publication, subscription, filters and RLS.
supabase-realtime-nie-odswieza-listy.intro: The second user changes the status or assignment, but the open CRM card still displays the previous data.

sections.title: Why is this happening?
paragraphs: The application may not have an active Realtime subscription, subscribe to the wrong table or do not refresh the query after the event.

sections.title: Step by step solution
paragraphs: 1. Confirm that a direct re-select retrieves new data. This distinguishes the Realtime problem from the recording problem.
2 . Verify table publication configuration and event reception permissions.
3 . Save the status of the subscription connection and support the disconnect and reconnect.
4 . After an event, update your local status or resume your list request safely.
5 . Test the open two sessions, lose the network and change the role when you log back in.

sections.title: How do I check the score?
paragraphs: The change made in the first session is visible in the second without manual overload, also after the connection has been restored.
Don't treat Realtime as the source of truth. After a longer break, download the current status from the base.

supabase-realtime-reconnect-dropped-upda.title: Subabase Realtime: After losing the internet, the list does not make up for changes
supabase-realtime-reconnect-dropped-upda.description: After reconnecting WebSocket UI retains an older set of records.
supabase-realtime-reconnect-dropped-upda.intro: After reconnecting WebSocket UI retains an older set of records. The cause needs to be checked in the real environment.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check channel statuses and see if after reconnect you perform independent download of the server status.
Compare the result for the authorized and unauthorised user, project name and exact error code.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: After the connection has been played, re-fetch and use the events as a change signal, not the only copy of the state.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: After a short break, the list reflects the current contents of the database.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Change permissions and scheme first on test data with backup. Do not put service role in your browser.

supabase-realtime-subscriber-no-events.title: Subabase Realtime: subscription works, but there are no changes in the table
supabase-realtime-subscriber-no-events.description: The realtime channel shows the status of SUBSCRIBED, but INSERT and UPDATE do not refresh the list.
supabase-realtime-subscriber-no-events.intro: The realtime channel shows the status of SUBSCRIBED, but INSERT and UPDATE do not refresh the list. The channel subscription does not guarantee that the table changes are published or accessed by RLS.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Check whether the table is added to the correct Postgres changes publication and whether the client subscribes to the correct schedule and event.
Verify whether token and SELECT policies allow the user to see the changed records.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Include the required publication of changes to the correct table and limit the subscription scope to the actual required data.
2 . Add the re-download mechanism after reconnect and update the list after the record identifier.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: The changes appear in two authorized users, and the unauthorized does not get information about other people's records.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not view Realtime as a permanent queue guaranteeing the delivery of any offline event.

supabase-refresh-token-wygasl-diagnostyk.title: Supabase: refresh session not working — diagnostics with expired fresh token
supabase-refresh-token-wygasl-diagnostyk.description: Diagnostic instruction regarding the situation when token refresh (refresh token) Supabase expired or is rejected. Includes a differential list of causes, specific tests and corrective steps, and methods of post-amendment performance verification.
supabase-refresh-token-wygasl-diagnostyk.intro: This document describes in detail the case when an application using Supabase starts returning authorization errors related to refresh of the session: e.g. 401/403 when trying to use a fresh token, log-in interrupted after a short time or no refresh after rebooting the server. I do not assume one reason: I have prepared a list of possible sources of the problem (customer configuration, supabase-side expiry policy, leaks/key changes, cookie/local implementation errorsStorage, problems with proxy or CORS). For each variant I specify how to test it clearly and what to improve. The instructions are practical: you will perform them in a development and production environment without the risk of losing user data.

sections.title: How to Recognize Cause
paragraphs: See if the problem is just about fresh tokens or the whole flow auth. Use the network console in your browser or curl tool to call endpoint /auth/v1/token with grant type=refresh token and follow the answer. If the server returns 401 with an invalid token message, it is likely that the token expired or was cancelled on the Supabase side.

Verify the JWT configuration and expire policy (JWT expiri) in the Subabase panel: if the fresh token was awarded with a short TTL or the 'Enable Fresh Token Rotation' option has been changed, then there is a scenario that rotation invalidated the previous token. Also check that the service key or anon/public key has not been reset — this cancels the sessions.

Do not miss the client layer: errors in writing a fresh token to cookie (HttpOnly, path, domain, security), or overwriting localStorage/sessionStorage can cause the application to send an outdated token. For server applications, check if you do not use multiple SubbaseClient instances with different settings.

sections.title: Step by step solution
paragraphs: 1. Log in with the test account and save the access token and refresh token values from the answers /auth/v1/token. Follow POST /auth/v1/token request with grant type=refresh token using curl: curl -X POST 'https://<project>.supabase.co/auth/v1/token' -d 'grant type=refresh token&refresh token=<token>' and save the answer and the code HTTP.

2 . If the request returns 200, compare the issue time and expires in in response to what the SDK client does. Make sure SDK receives and retains both tokens — do not overwrite fresh token new access token. For SDK JS, check supabase.auth.getSession() and supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange().

3 . If the request returns 401 or 400 with the reason 'invalid grant' or 'token revoked', check in the Subabase panel: there was no key rotation (Project Settings -> API -> Keys) or manual deregistration of the session. Change the service key cancels the sessions — play the session after generating new keys.

4 . Check the refresh rotation policy: if rotation is enabled, each refresh prints a new fresh token and cancels the previous one. Test the flow sequentially: perform 2 more refreshes using the same token — the other should be rejected. If a parallel application calls refreshy, add lock/mutex to execute it sequentially.

5 . For SSR or proxy applications: check that the cookie with fresh token is not shortened by the proxy (SameSite, path, domain). In devtools check the presence of HttpOnly cookie and its value after server reboot. For Next.js/Node, make sure that the SSR reads and writes cookies from the same domain view.

6 . If you use JWT custom or external provider OAuth, make sure callbacks correctly map and save refresh token. In the case of providers (Google, GitHub) sometimes refresh token is only issued on first authorisation — test full flow OAuth and log in the received tokens.

7 . If the problem occurs irregularly, enable request/response login on refresh (only in the test environment) and compare trace-id/headers. Check that the proxy or CDN does not cache the endpoint auth — endpoints of authorization should not be cached.

sections.title: How to see if the problem is gone
paragraphs: Test 1: Manual fresh by curl should return 200 and new access token and fresh token (if rotation is enabled). Repeat the immediate re-use of the old refresh token — if rotation it works, the second call should return the error.

Test 2: Play production scenario: log out and log in again, then restart backend/SSR and try to perform an operation requiring a refreshed session. Monitor server logs: if the application sends a valid current refresh token, the operation should go without 401.

Test 3: Simulate parallel refreshs — call up several simultaneous refresh requests with the same token. If the application does not serialize a refreshy, expect only the first one to pass; after fixing all requests should benefit from one sequential refresh process.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not log or refresh token in production logs; only log status and trace-id. Token leaks allow you to take over the session.
Do not expect fresh token to last forever — check TTL and rotation policy instead of assuming inexhaustibility.
Avoiding serialization of refresh operations (parallel refreshy) is a common cause of sudden rejection of tokens at rotation — apply mux/queue.

supabase-rls-blokuje-select-pomimo-zalog.title: Subabase: SELECT returns empty results despite valid authorization — RLS diagnostic
supabase-rls-blokuje-select-pomimo-zalog.description: Analysis of the reasons why Row Level Security (RLS) in Supabase blocks SELECT queries despite the visible user session. It includes differentiation of rules, permission limits, verification of jwt and policies, and specific test steps for repair.
supabase-rls-blokuje-select-pomimo-zalog.intro: Problem: the user sees an active session in the Supabase client, token is present, but SELECT on the table returns empty results or 0 lines. The reasons are usually in the RLS configuration (no policy, incorrect expression, USING/ WITH CHECK, roles anon/auth) or in the authentication layer (token does not contain expected claims, incorrect audience/issuer, or request performed as service role). This document runs through controlled tests: role confirmation, policy inspection, SQL editor simulation of the query, JWT claim check and indicates specific corrections and minimum verification test before implementation of changes.

sections.title: How to Recognize Cause
paragraphs: Check if the table has RLS enabled: in Dashboard → Table Editor → the Policies tab is active. If RLS is enabled and there is no policy for SELECT shares, all normal roles (auth/anon) will get 0 results. Common mistake: to disable RLS instead of adding the right rules.

Verify policy content: SELECT policy can have a clause USING or expression checking e.g. auth.uid() = owner id. Error in column name, type or operator (e.g. = instead of IS NOT DISTINCT FROM) results in rejection of the line. The difference between USING (filter) and WITH CHECK (for INSERT/UPDATE) is critical.

Check the query context: the client token must be transmitted and contain a valid sub (auth.uid()) or custom claim used in the policy. If you make an inquiry from the server using service role, RLS is disabled and the results will be different from the customer. Make sure the request comes from the same token you're watching.

sections.title: Step by step solution
paragraphs: 1. Confirm authorization: in the browser console, check localStorage/sessionStorage key "supabase.auth.token" or call supabase.auth.getSession() and save returned access token; do not assume that UI presence = valid Token.

2 . Open SQL Editor in Supabase and perform SELECT using auth.uid(): SELECT auth.uid(), current setting('request.jwt.claims', true); — check whether auth.uid() returns the expected id. If NULL, token is not sent correctly.

3 . Check policies: go to Table Editor → Policies; for SELECT check USING expression. For the test, temporarily add a simple policy allow for your role: USING (true) — this will determine whether the problem is due to the rules.

4 . Test client query vs SQL Editor: compare results when you perform the same SELECT in SQL Editor (made in the context of the dashboard) and from the browser application (using access token). Differences will indicate a problem with token or with headers.

5 . Examine JWT: decode access token (base64) and compare claim 'sub' or custom claim required in policy. Make sure the issue/audience corresponds to the design configuration. If claim doesn't exist, the police won't let the lines go.

6 . Check roles used in policy: many examples use roles() = 'authenticated' or current setting('request.jwt.claims.role', true). If the policy refers to a custom role field, confirm that it is present in JWT.

7 . Restore safe policy: after diagnostics replace the temporary USING(true) with a precise rule e.g. USING (auth.uid() = owner id) and perform tests with a token containing a sub corresponding to owner id.

sections.title: How to see if the problem is gone
paragraphs: Test A: Sign in to the application as a test user, execute SELECT from the customer. Expected result: returned lines having a Owner id equal to auth.uid().
Test B: In SQL Editor, perform the same SELECT by simulating the dashboard (without the RLS change) and compare; if SQL Editor returns rows and the client does not—a problem with token or headers.
Test C: When you restore the correct policy, remove the temporary USING(true) and repeat Test A; if you fail, check the server logs and decode token at the time of request.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not leave USING(true) permanently in production — opens access to all lines.
Do not diagnose after Dashboard SQL Editor; the results there may differ from the client due to another RLS context.
Do not edit policy without backup; copy the existing definition before modification.

supabase-rls-insert-with-check.title: Subabase: new row Violates row-level security policy at INSERT
supabase-rls-insert-with-check.description: Trying to save a new record returns a row-level security policy error, although SELECT works.
supabase-rls-insert-with-check.intro: Trying to save a new record returns a row-level security policy error, although SELECT works. INSERT evaluates WITH CHECK condition for a new record, not the USING condition for reading.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Save values of owner id and auth.uid() for the user performing the insertion in a safe test environment.
Check that the table has FOR INSERT TO authenticated policy and that the client does not send an empty owner field.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Prepare WITH CHECK to force the owner's correct connection to the current identity.
2 . Set the owner id on the server or through a secure identity-based default instead of trusting any client value.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: A correct record can be added and an attempt to save it for another owner is still rejected.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not set WITH CHECK (true) just to silence a permission error.

supabase-rls-pusta-lista-po-logowaniu.title: Subabase returns an empty list after logging in — check RLS
supabase-rls-pusta-lista-po-logowaniu.description: No records on a valid query need not mean an empty table. Row Level Security policy can hide poems from a specific user. You
supabase-rls-pusta-lista-po-logowaniu.intro: No records on a valid query need not mean an empty table. Row Level Security policy can hide poems from a specific user. Disabling RLS is not a permission amendment.

sections.title: Step by step
paragraphs: 1. Check that the query uses the current session and which user ID goes to the API. Compare request logged in and not logged on test data.
2 . Open table policies and analyze SELECT. The condition should reflect the owner or membership of the organization, not the fact that he has an account.
3 . Verify the type and value of the column identifying the owner. If you compare auth.uid() to another business identifier, the policy may never fit.
4 . Also check the tables combined in the query. Lack of access to the relationship can change the result or return the error depending on the way you connect.
5 . Test two organizations and user without permission. The service role key is stored only on the server; inserting it into the frontend bypasses the security instead of fixing the policy.

sections.title: How to check whether the amendment works
paragraphs: The authorized user sees his records, and the other does not see others. The positive test without a refusal test is insufficient. Keep checking membership also in write operations.

supabase-sesja-wygasla-po-wznowieniu.title: CRM logs out after time: Supabase session expired
supabase-sesja-wygasla-po-wznowieniu.description: Ended session after resuming the phone or PWA. Fresh token, support 401 and back to login.
supabase-sesja-wygasla-po-wznowieniu.intro: After a few hours or restarting the CRM card, it requires re-logging, although it had previously worked.

sections.title: Why is this happening?
paragraphs: Access token has a limited life span, and the app must properly renew the session and respond to its lack. The problem can increase different bookmarks and incorrect customer configuration.

sections.title: Step by step solution
paragraphs: 1. Play the problem after sleeping the application and save the exact auth message, without logging in tokens.
2 . Verify whether the Supabase client uses platform-compatible refresh service.
3 . Support expire without displaying an empty list that can be confused with losing lead.
4 . After the authentication has been renewed, download the profile, role and list of eligible data.
5 . Test logout, parallel cards and change password, remembering to cancel the session.

sections.title: How do I check the score?
paragraphs: After the active session has been retrieved, the data appears normally; when the session is actually invalid, the user is logged in without revealing the data.
Do not circumvent the problem by very long tokens or keeping administrative keys in your browser.

supabase-signed-url-przestaje-dzialac.title: Supabase: signed file URL stops working — differentiation and repair
supabase-signed-url-przestaje-dzialac.description: Signed URL with Supabase Storage ceases to work abruptly — causes include the link expired, changed bucket permissions, object removal, server time errors or CDN. Below is differential diagnosis and specific corrective steps.
supabase-signed-url-przestaje-dzialac.intro: The "signed URL ceases to work" report covers many unrelated causes: the presigned links expire, the object has been removed, the RLS/bucket law has changed, or the proxy/CDN caches the answer 403 Instead of updating the state. In practice, the client sees sudden 403 or 404 on the existing links. This requires sequential diagnostics — checking the expiry parameters, the integrity of the Storage object, the role of the key used to generate the link, the public/private configuration, the CDN/Cache-Control settings, and comparison of reply headers. The following text focuses on specific tests and corrective steps repetitive in real Supabase environments without assuming access to operating masters.

sections.title: How to Recognize Cause
paragraphs: Check first if the answer is 403 (no permission) or 404 (no object). 404 means to delete or move a file; 403 — issue with authorization, token expiration or bucket policy. Use curl -I or web browser to read status and headers.

If status is 403, compare the way you generate signed URL: have you used the createSignedUrl method from the client on the server side or the unauthorized service role in the client? Check the TTL link (expiresIn) and the server system time (clock skin). CDN Reverse proxies can cache old 403 responses — check Cache-Control and X-Cache headers.

sections.title: Step by step solution
paragraphs: 1. Locate the object in the Subabase Storage panel: confirm file presence, path and metadata. If a file exists, save the exact path and size; if not, play it from backup or confirm who and when deleted.

2 . Generate a new signed URL on the server (not in the browser) using service role or server key in the short term and set TTL to a short value (e.g. 60s). Compare generated URLs and expires parameters with those that do not work.

3 . Follow curl -v "<signed url>" and note the answer: status code, body, Cache-Control headers, Age, X-Cache and Server-Timing. No body + 403 indicates authorization policy; 404 indicates no object. Register exact error messages.

4 . Check the roles and rules of the bucket: if the bucket is private, make sure you use the signed URL generated by the server. If new RLS/Policies policies are set against storage.objects, temporarily switch to a simple test policy and try again.

5 . Check the server/application clock (NTP): if the signature uses unix time, >60s can invalidate the URL. On the link generating machine, check date -u and compare with time.nist.gov; if different, configure NTP.

6 . Check CDN/Edge configuration: if Supabase or external CDN caches 403, clear cache for a given URL or header, and re-execute request with ?cachebust=timestamp parameter. Confirm if the source content has changed.

7 . View the Supabase logs (if available) and application server logs: find bugs related to the generation of URLs, exceptions when calling API storage.createSignedUrl, or references to rejection of token. Save the exact messages for analysis.

sections.title: How to see if the problem is gone
paragraphs: Test 1 — instant access: after generating the new signed URL run curl -I and curl --max-time 10 and confirm code 200 and correct Content-Type and size. If 200 — the problem was in expiration or cache.

Test 2 — Expiration test: Generate the URL from TTL 10s, access immediately (expected 200), wait 15s and call again — should return 403 or 404. This test confirms that the TTL mechanism is working properly.

Test 3 — comparison without CDN: make a direct request to the Subabase with the cleared browser cache and the cachebust parameter, and omit any CDN (if possible). No difference indicates a problem on the Storage/ACL side.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not use service role in frontend application: key leak allows you to generate any signed URL and modify data. The server key always generates links on the backend side.
Do not extend the TTL signed URL above necessary without considering the risk: a long period increases the area of the attack when the link leaks; instead, apply a short TTL and refresh mechanism.
Do not assign reasons based on the title of the report: first make the code status + headers + file presence. Assuming that a CDN without a test can lead to an unnecessary change of configuration.

supabase-storage-403-zdjecia.title: Supabase Storage 403: the file is, but the photo does not open
supabase-storage-403-zdjecia.description: Error 403 on photos and attachments of the Supabase Storage. Bucket, signed URL and access policy.
supabase-storage-403-zdjecia.intro: The file has been sent to the warehouse, but 403, 404 or no preview when you click.

sections.title: Why is this happening?
paragraphs: The rights to send and download a file may vary. Private picket requires authorized download or short-term signed URL.

sections.title: Step by step solution
paragraphs: 1. Confirm the path of the object and the exact name of the bucket, taking into account the case size.
2 . Check whether the bucket is public or private; customer documents should usually remain private.
3 . Check the storage.objects access policies and the context of the authenticated user.
4 . For private files, generate signed URL after authorization, with a reasonable expiration date.
5 . Add a message distinguishing no file from no permission and check the link renewal.

sections.title: How do I check the score?
paragraphs: The authorized user opens the file, not authorized; after the signature expires, the application can safely generate a new one.
Setting up a public bucket to make the 403 error disappear, it may reveal customer documents.

supabase-storage-413-entity-too-large-up.title: Supabase Storage 413 EntityTooLarge on photo or video upload
supabase-storage-413-entity-too-large-up.description: Supabase returns HTTP 413 at upload? Set global limit and bucket limit, check file size and upload method.
supabase-storage-413-entity-too-large-up.intro: HTTP 413 EntityTooLarge means exceeding the size limit during transmission. This is not a typical RLS permission error. Start by comparing the actual file size with project limits and a specific tray.

sections.title: How to Recognize Cause
paragraphs: Check full response code and Storage message, not only general 'upload failed'. Save file size in bytes, bucket name and upload method. The file from the phone may be much larger than the thumbnail displayed on the interface.

The Supabase allows you to set a global limit and a lower limit for individual pickets. The actual permissible size results from both configurations, and the availability of higher values depends on the design plan.

sections.title: Step by step solution
paragraphs: 1. Open Supabase → Storage Settings and check Global file size limit. Do not change it without an estimate of the cost and demand of the application.
2 . Go to the picket destination settings and verify its own size limits and the MIME types allowed.
3 . If the file is more than a reasonable limit, show a clear message in the application before sending. If necessary, apply compression or separate path for large materials.
4 . For larger files, evaluate the resumable upload mechanism based on TUS, instead of repeatedly renewing one large standard upload via unstable link.
5 . If the file is within limits, check the proxy Next.js server or proxy that can also impose your own request limit.

sections.title: How to see if the problem is gone
paragraphs: Test one file smaller than the limit and one bigger. The small should be saved and read, and the large should receive a controlled message without endless animation.
Check that the saved object has the correct size and metadata and that orphaned files have not been created after the incorrect or broken upload.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not disable RLS to repair 413 responses. Do not increase the global limit to a maximum for only one form with small attachments.

supabase-storage-bucket-not-found.title: Supabase Storage: Bucket not found after changing the environment
supabase-storage-bucket-not-found.description: The app tries to send a picture, but the bucket only exists at another instance.
supabase-storage-bucket-not-found.intro: The app tries to send a picture, but the bucket only exists at another instance. The cause needs to be checked in the real environment.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Compare the Supabase design identifier and the name of the bucket with the upload environment.
Compare the result for the authorized and unauthorised user, project name and exact error code.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Create a properly configured bucket in the target project and use the identical name in the code.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: Upload works on production without saving data in the test instance.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Change permissions and scheme first on test data with backup. Do not put service role in your browser.

supabase-storage-cdn-old-object.title: Subabase Storage: CDN shows old image after swapping
supabase-storage-cdn-old-object.description: The image under the same URL does not change immediately after saving a new version.
supabase-storage-cdn-old-object.intro: The image under the same URL does not change immediately after saving a new version. The cause needs to be checked in the real environment.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check the object cache-control and CDN reply headers for a specific address.
Compare the result for the authorized and unauthorised user, project name and exact error code.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Save a new version under a new path or control cache according to application requirements.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: The new URL shows the new file, and the old file can expire without accidentally replacing it.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Change permissions and scheme first on test data with backup. Do not put service role in your browser.

supabase-storage-file-size-limit.title: Subabase Storage: upload file size enhanced despite free space
supabase-storage-file-size-limit.description: Loading a larger attachment ends with a size limit error.
supabase-storage-file-size-limit.intro: Loading a larger attachment ends with a size limit error. The cause needs to be checked in the real environment.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check the object size limit set in the bootet and plan and the size of the actual request.
Compare the result for the authorized and unauthorised user, project name and exact error code.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Use resumable upload for large files or increase the limit according to the needs and capabilities of the plan.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: A correct larger file is saved, and indeed too large gives a predictable message.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Change permissions and scheme first on test data with backup. Do not put service role in your browser.

supabase-storage-list-shows-empty.title: Supabase Storage: list() returns an empty folder despite saved files
supabase-storage-list-shows-empty.description: The saved object can be downloaded on a known path, but the list does not show records.
supabase-storage-list-shows-empty.intro: The saved object can be downloaded on a known path, but the list does not show records. The cause needs to be checked in the real environment.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check SELECT policies on storage.objects and prefix, limit and offset submitted to list().
Compare the result for the authorized and unauthorised user, project name and exact error code.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Just give the necessary right of listing for a folder and make sure the prefix filter is correct.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: The authorized user sees his own directory, and the lack of law does not reveal other people's names.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Change permissions and scheme first on test data with backup. Do not put service role in your browser.

supabase-storage-mime-not-allowed.title: Subabase Storage: MIME type not allowed during upload
supabase-storage-mime-not-allowed.description: The HEIC or PDF attachment is rejected before saving the file.
supabase-storage-mime-not-allowed.intro: The HEIC or PDF attachment is rejected before saving the file. The cause needs to be checked in the real environment.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check the MIME limitations in the bucket configuration and the real Content-Type of the uploaded file.
Compare the result for the authorized and unauthorised user, project name and exact error code.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Add only the necessary types to allowlist or make a controlled conversion after format verification.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: The allowed file passes, and the unauthorised type is still blocked.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Change permissions and scheme first on test data with backup. Do not put service role in your browser.

supabase-storage-path-case-sensitive.title: Supabase Storage: file is, but download gives 404 by letter size
supabase-storage-path-case-sensitive.description: The user sees the file name, but the download from its own path returns Not Found.
supabase-storage-path-case-sensitive.intro: The user sees the file name, but the download from its own path returns Not Found. The cause needs to be checked in the real environment.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Compare the full storage path from the list of objects used by the frontend, including the letter size.
Compare the result for the authorized and unauthorised user, project name and exact error code.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Save and read the canonical path returned by upload instead of reconstructing it from the names displayed.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: The download works for the original file, and the non-existent path gives 404.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Change permissions and scheme first on test data with backup. Do not put service role in your browser.

supabase-storage-private-403.title: Supabase Storage: 403 when downloading a private file
supabase-storage-private-403.description: The file exists in a buget, but the public address Storage returns the refusal to access.
supabase-storage-private-403.intro: The file exists in a buget, but the public address Storage returns the refusal to access. A private Bucket requires certified access or signed URL, and Storage policy may further restrict operations.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Verify the public/private setting of the bucket and the role of the downloader.
Check the policies on storage.objects, folder path and assign the owner.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. For private files, generate signed URL with limited life time on a trusted server or download by authorized SDK.
2 . Transfer to URL only the path to the authorized file and check permissions before generating signatures.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: The authorized user downloads the file, the unaccessed person gets a refusal, and the URL expires as set.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not switch the entire customer's bucket to the public just to make the image visible.

supabase-storage-rls-folder-prefix.title: Supabase Storage: user sees files of another folder
supabase-storage-rls-folder-prefix.description: Storage policy allows you to read objects from the folder adjacent to the user folder.
supabase-storage-rls-folder-prefix.intro: Storage policy allows you to read objects from the folder adjacent to the user folder. The cause needs to be checked in the real environment.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check the policy conditions and functions of storage.foldername and the format of the ids in paths.
Compare the result for the authorized and unauthorised user, project name and exact error code.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Replace non-precision LIKE with a safe comparison of the folder segment with auth.uid() and check all operations.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: Two accounts read only their own files and the attempt to change the folder is rejected.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Change permissions and scheme first on test data with backup. Do not put service role in your browser.

supabase-storage-signed-upload-token.title: Supabase Storage: signed upload URL rejects shipment
supabase-storage-signed-upload-token.description: The client gets a signed address to upload, but the request cannot add a file.
supabase-storage-signed-upload-token.intro: The client gets a signed address to upload, but the request cannot add a file. The cause needs to be checked in the real environment.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check token time, picket and the exact path for which the signature was issued.
Compare the result for the authorized and unauthorised user, project name and exact error code.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Create an address just before shipping and transmit to the authorized user only.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: One-time transfer works for the right object, without access to other files.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Change permissions and scheme first on test data with backup. Do not put service role in your browser.

supabase-storage-transform-image-quality.title: Supabase Storage: Transform image returns error for HEIC
supabase-storage-transform-image-quality.description: The attempt to generate a miniature from the photo ends with a refusal or an empty image.
supabase-storage-transform-image-quality.intro: The attempt to generate a miniature from the photo ends with a refusal or an empty image. The cause needs to be checked in the real environment.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check the source format and list of types supported by Image Transformations.
Compare the result for the authorized and unauthorised user, project name and exact error code.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Convert the unsupported format to the approved upload and keep the original if needed.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: The miniature opens on the mobile and desktop, maintaining correct proportions.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Change permissions and scheme first on test data with backup. Do not put service role in your browser.

supabase-storage-tus-resume-fails.title: Subabase Storage: TUS resumeable upload stops after network break
supabase-storage-tus-resume-fails.description: After the shipment is discontinued, the viewer starts the file again or reports a conflict.
supabase-storage-tus-resume-fails.intro: After the shipment is discontinued, the viewer starts the file again or reports a conflict. The cause needs to be checked in the real environment.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check the upload ID, fingerprint and whether the billet/path remained the same.
Compare the result for the authorized and unauthorised user, project name and exact error code.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Implement resumption by the relevant TUS client by storing the status of the upload according to his contract.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: The file continues to ship after a temporary break without creating a damaged copy.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Change permissions and scheme first on test data with backup. Do not put service role in your browser.

supabase-storage-upload-conflict-409.title: Subabase Storage: 409 Asset Already Exists during re-upload
supabase-storage-upload-conflict-409.description: The second upload of a file under the identical path returns the conflict instead of overwriting.
supabase-storage-upload-conflict-409.intro: The second upload of a file under the identical path returns the conflict instead of overwriting. The default file creation operation behavior may not allow the existing object to be overwritten.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Save the exact name of the bucket and the path of the object, not the local file itself.
Check whether the re-send is deliberate and if the user has the right rights to INSERT and UPDATE.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. If files are to be uploaded, create unique safe paths and save a reference to the current version.
2 . If overwriting is a requirement, use consciously upsert with appropriate policies and collision control.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: Multiple file uploads retain the established version policy and other client data is not overwritten.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not set upsert=true without checking the effects on existing attachments.

supabase-update-using-with-check.title: Subabase: UPDATE ends without error, but does not change anything
supabase-update-using-with-check.description: Calling update().eq() returns an empty result, although the record exists in the database.
supabase-update-using-with-check.intro: Calling update().eq() returns an empty result, although the record exists in the database. RLS policy for UPDATE may not allow updated line; SELECT visibility and WITH CHECK condition of new values are also important.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Compare eq filters and column values, then check the role of JWT and policy for UPDATE and SELECT.
See if you can modify a column that stops meeting WITH CHECK after changing.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Match USING conditions separately for changeable rows and WITH CHECK for update result.
2 . Ask for data return or the number of changed lines and handle case zero instead of assuming success.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: Updating your own record works, and trying to change another person's record still does not pass.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not treat HTTP 204 as evidence of a change in a specific record.

supabase-upsert-conflict-unique.title: Supabase upsert does not work: ON CONFLICT and no UNIQUE
supabase-upsert-conflict-unique.description: Upsert errors in Supabase: unique key, onConflict, data conflicts and repeated webhooks.
supabase-upsert-conflict-unique.intro: Integration was supposed to update existing contact, but creates duplicate or returns conflict error.

sections.title: Why is this happening?
paragraphs: Upsert needs a clear conflict key consistent with the limitation of PRIMARY KEY or UNIQUE. The e-mail field alone does not guarantee proper behavior without an appropriate index.

sections.title: Step by step solution
paragraphs: 1. Set a stable event identifier or an external record, not just a name or phone.
2 . Add an appropriate unique index in the database, after having safely ordered existing duplicates.
3 . In the upsert query, indicate onConflict according to the index.
4 . Check for simultaneous delivery of two identical webhooks and behavior with network error.
5 . Separate the deduplication of events from combining several authentic reports from the same person.

sections.title: How do I check the score?
paragraphs: A double processing of the same event shall not create a double entry or subsequent notification.
Uniqueness after the phone number itself can glue different people or two separate applications. Design the key according to the event definition.

supabase-vault-secret-rpc-exposure.title: Supabase Vault: a secret accessible by the public RPC
supabase-vault-secret-rpc-exposure.description: SQL returns private values from Vault to a public token client.
supabase-vault-secret-rpc-exposure.intro: SQL returns private values from Vault to a public token client. The cause needs to be checked in the real environment.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check EXECUTE grants, exposure scheme and SECURITY DEFINITION of the function used.
Compare the result for the authorized and unauthorised user, project name and exact error code.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Move secret reading to trusted backend or remove public function grant.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: The anonymous client does not read the secret, and the legitimate integration works.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Change permissions and scheme first on test data with backup. Do not put service role in your browser.

supabase-view-security-invoker-rls-leak.title: Supabase: SQL view shows other people's data despite RLS enabled
supabase-view-security-invoker-rls-leak.description: The query directly to the table respects RLS policies, but the SQL view API returns other people's lines to the user.
supabase-view-security-invoker-rls-leak.intro: The query directly to the table respects RLS policies, but the SQL view API returns other people's lines to the user. PostgreSQL views standard check the permissions of the view owner; a view created by the privileged role can bypass the RLS policies of the base tables.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Check whether the endpoint reads the table or VIEW and what role the view was created. Test the same filter directly on the table.
Verify the Postgres version and the security invoker option of the view, then compare results for two independent user tokens.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. In PostgreSQL 15 or later, set security invoker=true to check the permissions of the calling role and the RLS rule.
2 . In the older PostgreSQL or with a private view limit GRANT for an anon/authenticated and keep the view in a scheme not listed by Data API.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: After the change, each user sees only allowed lines, and an anonymous query to private data does not give access to the view.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not assume that the inclusion of RLS only on the table protects all created views or functions of SECURITY DEFINITION.

tani-lead-meta-nie-odbiera-telefonu.title: Cheap leads from Meta do not answer the phone — what to check?
tani-lead-meta-nie-odbiera-telefonu.description: The low CPL may look good in the report and still not help sales. The cost of the form is assessed together with the percentage of available contacts and cases
tani-lead-meta-nie-odbiera-telefonu.intro: The low CPL may look good in the report and still not help sales. The cost of the form is assessed together with the percentage of available contacts and cases qualified for the tender.

sections.title: Step by step
paragraphs: 1. In CRM separate statuses: new, contact attempt, reachable, qualified and sales. Without this, you can't distinguish between poor quality and lack of service.
2 . Check the time between the form and the first contact attempt and the number of meaningful attempts. Set up a team procedure; do not assume that a single missed phone means false lead.
3 . Read the advertisement and form with the eyes of the recipient. He needs to know what service to sign up for, who to call and what to talk about. Avoid a promise that does not come true.

4 . Add only questions that help to qualify the case: location, extent of need or planned deadline. More questions can reduce the number of contacts; test the cost of a qualified contact, not the CPL itself.
5 . Compare results according to advertising and form for similar periods. Pass to marketing the reasons for rejection, without sharing personal data in open sheets.

sections.title: How to check whether the amendment works
paragraphs: The summary should show expenditure, number of forms, reachability and qualification. Re-energy cooperation is an example of combining advertising with CRM; it does not give a universal lead price promise to another company.

typescript-import-type-verbatim-module.title: TypeScript: import must be type-only at verbatimModuleSyntax
typescript-import-type-verbatim-module.description: The compiler rejects an interface import that was to be used only as a type.
typescript-import-type-verbatim-module.intro: The compiler rejects an interface import that was to be used only as a type. With verbatimModuleSyntax TypeScript, import values and types must be properly separated.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Check tsconfig for verbatimModuleSyntax and the files indicated by TS1484.
Determine whether the imported symbol exists in runtime or is just an alias or an interface.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Replace the corresponding import to import type {... } from '...' or mark individual names as type.
2 . Leave normal imports for values used during JavaScript operation.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: Typecheck does not report TS1484 and the result JavaScript does not contain non-existent types of imports.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not disable the TS configuration just to avoid improving several imports.

typescript-no-inputs-found-ts18003.title: TypeScript TS18003 No inputs were found in config file
typescript-no-inputs-found-ts18003.description: The tsc command reports that it did not find any input files, although repo has .ts and .tsx files.
typescript-no-inputs-found-ts18003.intro: The tsc command reports that it did not find any input files, although repo has .ts and .tsx files. Includes rules, exclusive or tsconfig indication may exclude the actual location of the code.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check which directory you run tsc and which tsconfig is actually indicated by the command. Compare include and exclusive with the location of src, app and tests directories.
Compare the message from the console with the result of the production compilation and the condition after the page has been refreshed.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Set the correct include patterns for source files; exclude only actual build output directories. For monorepo check references and tsc -p commands for a particular project, not blindly global tsconfig.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: Typecheck finds project files and reports actual bugs instead of ending with TS18003.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Do not add an accidental empty .ts file just to remove the error without validating the code.

typescript-no-overload-matches-call.title: TypeScript: No overload matches this call in event handler
typescript-no-overload-matches-call.description: The TS2769 message appears when calling a function with several signatures, despite seemingly compatible arguments.
typescript-no-overload-matches-call.intro: The TS2769 message appears when calling a function with several signatures, despite seemingly compatible arguments. None of the available overloads fit the entire set of arguments submitted simultaneously.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: In the compiler message read the error for each overload instead of just analyzing the first line.
Check the union types, optional parameters and whether the React handler receives the event instead of the expected value.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Narrow the entry type by condition or type guard before calling overloaded function.
2 . If this is your API, add the correct implementation that supports the union or common overload according to real data.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: The compilation passes without ace any, and tests include any acceptable argument type.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not use unconditional as unknown as, because it hides incompatibility and can lead to an exception runtime.

typescript-ts1259-default-import.title: TypeScript TS1259 default import without esModuleInterop
typescript-ts1259-default-import.description: The default import of CommonJS libraries ends with the TS1259 compatibility error.
typescript-ts1259-default-import.intro: The default import of CommonJS libraries ends with the TS1259 compatibility error. The selected module exports the shape incompatible with the default import declaration in the current compilation mode.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check import documentation and .d.ts declarations of a given library and module and esModuleInterop settings. Compare the transpilation result with the real Node environment or Bundler used by the application.
Compare the message from the console with the result of the production compilation and the condition after the page has been refreshed.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Apply compatible import syntax or consciously incorporate interoperability into tsconfig for the whole project. After the change, test import in runtime, especially when mixing requirements, import and NodeNext.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: The compiler and the code running read the correct export, not undefined.default.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Do not change the whole application module system blindly for one package without testing.

typescript-ts18046-error-unknown.title: TypeScript TS18046: variable error has an unknown type in catch
typescript-ts18046-error-unknown.description: Catch(error) code does not allow you to read error.message even though you see Error in the console.
typescript-ts18046-error-unknown.intro: Catch(error) code does not allow you to read error.message even though you see Error in the console. JavaScript allows you to throw any value, so TypeScript does not assume that the captured object is an instance of Error.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check all catch locations and whether external libraries return other exceptions shapes. Find out what information can enter the log and what are the customer's secrets or data.
Compare the message from the console with the result of the production compilation and the condition after the page has been refreshed.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Use if(error instanceof Error) before accessing the message and prepare a secure message for other values. For failure of the supplier, develop a separate validation of the form of the response and do not reveal the entire payoad to the user.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: Typecheck works and the message does not display confidential parts of an API error.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Don't change the global catch to any, because you lose the validation of an exception.

typescript-ts2307-cannot-find-module-typ.title: TypeScript TS2307 Cannot find module despite successful installation e.g.
typescript-ts2307-cannot-find-module-typ.description: The editor or build reports the TS2307 for a library that appears in node modules.
typescript-ts2307-cannot-find-module-typ.intro: The editor or build reports the TS2307 for a library that appears in node modules. The reason may be the wrong moduleResolution, no declaration of types or different import name.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check package.json and package version and whether the module has types in exports or declaration file. Compare tsconfig moduleResolution with real runtime ESM/CJS and framework.
Compare the message from the console with the result of the production compilation and the condition after the page has been refreshed.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Match the import path and the module ConfigurationResolution to Bundler or NodeNext according to the package. If the library does not provide types, install the correct @types package or your own minimum declaration instead of pretending to be any type.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: Pure typecheck on CI finds the module, and runtime launches the same import without error.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Do not randomly change the tsconfig option if the problem is in the export of a particular package.

typescript-ts2322-type-not-assignable.title: TypeScript TS2322: string is not assignable to number after downloading the form
typescript-ts2322-type-not-assignable.description: After reading the numeric field from HTML TypeScript does not allow to assign its value to the number.
typescript-ts2322-type-not-assignable.intro: After reading the numeric field from HTML TypeScript does not allow to assign its value to the number. Value input.value is a string regardless of type="number", and an empty entry does not represent the correct number.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check event.currentTarget.value types and expected business model type. Test empty input, comma value and normal number to determine parsing rules.
Compare the message from the console with the result of the production compilation and the condition after the page has been refreshed.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Perform a public parsing Number or valueAsNumber and NaN and no number of service in validation form. Separate the string type used to enter data from the number type saved after successful validation.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: The figures do not contain NaN and the incorrect entry displays the information instead of a silent conversion to zero.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Do not force the number type by as number on the string, because it does not convert values.

typescript-ts2532-object-possibly-undefi.title: TypeScript TS2532: Object is possible undefined in API data
typescript-ts2532-object-possibly-undefi.description: Typecheck reports the possibility undefined when reading the property of an asynchronous object.
typescript-ts2532-object-possibly-undefi.intro: Typecheck reports the possibility undefined when reading the property of an asynchronous object. The type allows no value, so unconditional reading can actually cause an error in runtime.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check the actual response type and whether the API has optional fields and the initial state null or undefined. Find out what UI should look like before you complete the fetch and for non-data responses.
Compare the message from the console with the result of the production compilation and the condition after the page has been refreshed.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Add a narrowing condition type or safe optional chaining with open information support. If required, check input data at the API border instead of using the operator wrongly !.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: Typecheck passes, and the lack of data shows the predicted empty state without exception.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Do not enter as any in every place, as this removes the need for a missing field warning.

typescript-ts2688-cannot-find-type-defin.title: TypeScript TS2688 Cannot find type definition file for Node
typescript-ts2688-cannot-find-type-defin.description: The compiler reports no Node declaration, although the JavaScript code is built through a Bundler.
typescript-ts2688-cannot-find-type-defin.intro: The compiler reports no Node declaration, although the JavaScript code is built by a bundler. tsconfig may require types: ["node"] without the installed matching @types/node in a given workspace.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Open a full message and check the list of types in tsconfig and the presence of @types/node in lockfile. Compare the runtime version and declaration package and the directory in which you run e.g.
Compare the message from the console with the result of the production compilation and the condition after the page has been refreshed.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Add the appropriate @types/node as a developer relationship to the right package if the project actually uses the Node API. If files are only frontend, configure a separate tsconfig instead of imposing global server types.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: Clean installation and tsc pass, and DOM and Node declarations do not mix external objects accidentally.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Do not copy node modules content from another computer instead of correcting the package manifest.

typescript-ts2741-missing-property.title: TypeScript TS2741: Property is missing in type when creating an object
typescript-ts2741-missing-property.description: After adding the required field to the User compiler type, the form object is rejected without this property.
typescript-ts2741-missing-property.intro: After adding the required field to the User compiler type, the form object is rejected without this property. The type model requires a field the object does not actually contain; this may reveal a lack of migration or mapping.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check the definition of the required field and all construction sites of the object of the structure. Compare the data from the form with the default values that the server should set.
Compare the message from the console with the result of the production compilation and the condition after the page has been refreshed.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Complete the required field with the correct value or manually change the model to optional if it may not be business. For API models, use separate types of CreateUser, User and UpdateUser when they have other fields required.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: The correct object undergoes compilation, and the lack of actually required field still gives an error.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Do not add an artificial empty string for the security field or owner ID.

typescript-ts7053-no-index-signature.title: TypeScript TS7053: string cannot index a defined object
typescript-ts7053-no-index-signature.description: Reading translations[key] does not go compilation when key has a string type and object only finished keys.
typescript-ts7053-no-index-signature.intro: Reading translations[key] does not go compilation when key has a string type and object only finished keys. Any string does not need to be allowed to be the map key, so TypeScript blocks unverified reading.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Compare key type and keyof typeof translations and where the key from the route parameter comes from. Check whether the set of allowed values is actually closed or to be an open dictionary.
Compare the message from the console with the result of the production compilation and the condition after the page has been refreshed.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Narrow key to keyof typeof translations after validation of the input or apply type guard to check the presence of the key. For really dynamic maps, declare Record<string,T> and predicted fallback at missing key.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: The compiler accepts reading and the unknown parameter does not lead to undefined rendering.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Do not project unverified URL to keyof just to mute the error.

typescript-tsconfig-paths-runtime.title: TypeScript: alias paths works in the editor, but Node does not find the module
typescript-tsconfig-paths-runtime.description: TS and IDE solve @/lib/config, but the running Node script reports MODULE NOT FOUND.
typescript-tsconfig-paths-runtime.intro: TS and IDE solve @/lib/config, but the running Node script reports MODULE NOT FOUND. paths in tsconfig are used to solve types and do not guarantee conversion of imports in the generated Node code.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Check the discrepancy between ts-node, Bundler, tsc and node by running the production command exactly.
Look at the generated JS files to see if the alias remained in the import specification.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Configure compatible aliases in runtime/bundler or use direct relative import.
2 . For ESM code, consider the correct package imports and a coherent package export configuration.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: The script after the construction starts without additional hacks, and the module is solved the same on CI and locally.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not assume that the basisUrl/paths itself in tsconfig changes the operation of imports in clean Node.js.

typescript-union-exhaustive-never.title: TypeScript: new value enum skips incomplete switch
typescript-union-exhaustive-never.description: After adding a new order status, one branch of UI displays an empty text, although build passes.
typescript-union-exhaustive-never.intro: After adding a new order status, one branch of UI displays an empty text, although build passes. The switch code does not fully check all variants of the union type and the new value passes unnoticed.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Browse the status union definition and all features mapping status into labels and permissions. Check the default case and see if it returns silent undefined for unknown value.
Compare the message from the console with the result of the production compilation and the condition after the page has been refreshed.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Use a comprehensive check with the Never parameter in the default branch or assertNever function. Add a test to cover all acceptable statuses and behavior with unexpected API data.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: Adding a new status requires improving mapping in typecheck, and current values give the right labels.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Do not enter the default label “OK” for unknown status because it maskes the flow error.

vercel-404-on-rewrite.title: Vercel: rewrite directs requests to 404 instead of the application
vercel-404-on-rewrite.description: After adding rewrite some routes or API shows 404 despite the existence of appropriate pages.
vercel-404-on-rewrite.intro: After adding rewrite some routes or API shows 404 despite the existence of appropriate pages. Routing rules can capture requests in the wrong order or direct them to an unexistent path.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Save the original URL and final URL of requests in response and order of rules.
Check the rewrites configuration, redirects and service of routes in the framework.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Narrow the pattern rewrite to the right prefix and direct it to the actual existing route.
2 . Add a test for regular pages, APIs, and static files so that one rule does not absorb the entire application.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: Each scheduled route returns the correct content and the others still give the expected 404.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not set the universal rewrite to the home page, because it may mask a non-existent URL.

vercel-brak-funkcji-node-na-edge.title: Application works locally, on Vercel no Node.js function at Edge Functions
vercel-brak-funkcji-node-na-edge.description: After implementation, the application works locally, but features requiring Node.js (fs, child process, net, process native APIs) do not work on Vercel — suspected to run the code as Edge Function instead of as Serverless/Node runtime.
vercel-brak-funkcji-node-na-edge.intro: Problem: The code that uses native Node.js APIs (e.g. filesystem, sockets, binary modules or progeny processes) works locally in the Node environment, but after implementation on Vercel ends with a mistake or silent lack of effects. The most common cause is the unintentional start-up of a given particle (endpoint, middleware, function) in Edge (V8 Isolates) instead of runtime Node/Serverless. Edge Functions have limits: no full Node API, no access to the file system and binary modules, and other behavioral differences. You have to distinguish: whether the/endpoint file has been marked Edge (e.g. by an explicative runtime setting or by selecting a framework/convention), whether the build/artifact has been moved to another type of function during deployu. This document describes differential diagnostics, specific checking steps, cause variants and repair test so that without guessing it is a Edge Functions limit or defloyment configuration error.

sections.title: How to Recognize Cause
paragraphs: Check whether an endpoint is actually Edge Function: in Next.js it is runtime: 'edge' (e.g. export config runtime) or middleware/edge API; in Vercel Functions, check if the file goes to the directory marked for Edge. If runtime is Edge, no native Node modules support is expected.

If there is no explicit Edge setting, examine build and output: deploya logs contain information whether a specific file was created as Edge Function or as Serverless Function. The difference in behavior may result from the automatic classification by builder (e.g. files in the pages/api directory in Next.js can be mapped differently depending on the version).

sections.title: Step by step solution
paragraphs: 1. Open the deployment logs in the Vercel panel for a specific implementation and find entries for the construction of the function; look for the 'Edge Function' or 'Serverless Function' line assigned to your endpoint.

2 . In source code, check whether the file/endpoint contains a clear runtime setting (e.g. export const config = { runtime: 'edge' } in Next.js) or whether the framework-dedicated files (middleware, edge API) have not been used mistakenly.

3 . Run a simple test point on Vercel: create the simplest file that tries to use process.version or require('fs'), implement it and analyze the answer and error logs — no or no exception will indicate limitations Environment.

4 . Compare local build: Generate production build locally (e.g. next build) and view .vercel/output or build manifest to determine how builder classifies this function before uploading to the platform.

5 . Check project settings in the Vercel dashboard: whether the selected target framework, build & output settings, or custom builders can reclassify functions on Edge. Confront builder version with documentation.

6 . If you need Node API, change the configuration so that endpoint goes to runtime Node/Serverless: Delete Edge Declaration, move the code to the appropriate directory/path accepted as Serverless Function and again implementation.

7 . When you change the implementation, watch the logs and answers, check if the native modules import is now proceeding without errors; analyze stack track errors in the deploy logs in case of problems.

sections.title: How to see if the problem is gone
paragraphs: Test 1: The endpoint test guide that returns typeof process и process.version; if you receive the Node version — endpoint runs in Node runtime, missing or undefined means Edge.
Test 2: Enterendpoint using require('fs').readdirSync('.') — if calling returns file listing, you have access to filesystem; if there is a module missing or not allowed operation, Edge works.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not assume that the lack of error in the browser means Node action — errors can be pushed; always check the deployment logs and endpoint response (status, body).
Do not try to use binary/child process modules in Edge Functions; it is not a configuration issue, it is only a runtime limitation - migration to Serverless/Node is necessary.

vercel-build-cache-stale-dependency.title: Vercel: Build Cache keeps the old result after the dependencies change

Compare SHA commit, the status of defloyment and HTTP response under the final domain, not the very status of READY.

vercel-build-node-version-mismatch.title: Vercel: build works locally, but falls through another version of Node.js
vercel-build-node-version-mismatch.description: The project is built on a computer, and the Vercel log shows a syntax error or a runtime non-compliance.
vercel-build-node-version-mismatch.intro: The project is built on a computer, and the Vercel log shows a syntax error or a runtime non-compliance. Local and production Node may have other language, modules and binary dependencies.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Save the node version --version locally and the Node version selected in the Vercel project settings.
Check the engines field in package.json and the requirements of actual dependencies.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Set up a supported Node version for the framework and unify it in package.json, CI and Vercel project.
2 . After the upgrade, perform a clean installation, e.g., and a new build, not just re-establishing the old defloyment.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: The identical Node version passes all tests and build both locally and in Vercel.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not select the latest version without checking the compatibility of native packages.
