vercel-cache-immutable-public-file.intro: After replacing the image under the permanent name, some browsers still show the old graphics. The cause needs to be checked in the real environment.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check Cache-Control and ETag for resource and CDN cache policy.
Compare SHA commit, the status of defloyment and HTTP response under the final domain, not the very status of READY.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Version the filename or query according to the cache character and update the links during deploya.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: The new version of the page refers to the new resource and cache does not spoil existing pages.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Keep the previous active defloyment until the new one is confirmed under your own domain. Avoid writing secrets in logs.

vercel-cron-endpoint-401.title: Vercel Cron Jobs: endpoint corresponds to 401 when the task starts
vercel-cron-endpoint-401.description: The cron task is visible in the panel, but calling the API route is not authorized.
vercel-cron-endpoint-401.intro: The cron task is visible in the panel, but calling the API route is not authorized. Endpoint may require an appropriate Authorization header for CRON SECRET or movement is blocked by separate middleware.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Check the logs of the single Cron Job call and endpoint response status.
Verify whether the secret token is configured in the appropriate environment and whether the route does not redirect to login.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Configure an endpoint to verify Bearer header and compare it with CRON SECRET server.
2 . Separate the automatic authorization from the user session and do not set up an open route performing expensive operations.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: The task starts with cron permission, and an unincorporated request without a secret gets 401.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not enter the cron secret into the public URL or the client code. The route performed without an important token must remain unavailable even after knowing its address.

vercel-custom-domain-dns-pending.title: Vercel: domain still Pending Verification after DNS change
vercel-custom-domain-dns-pending.description: Once the domain is subdued, the panel still needs verification or indicates an incompatible DNS record.
vercel-custom-domain-dns-pending.intro: Once the domain is subdued, the panel still needs verification or indicates an incompatible DNS record. The actual DNS records may differ from the Vercel instructions or the domain is managed by another name server.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Check the authoritative nameservers and A/CNAME/TXT records instead of just evaluating the recorder panel.
Compare the exact record host with the main domain and subdomain instructions.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Remove conflicting records for the same host and configure the required values in the appropriate DNS zone.
2 . If Vercel requires proof of ownership, add the indicated TXT record and wait for propagation without creating fictitious records.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: The domain goes to verified status and returns the correct page after HTTPS.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not assume that changing the record in an unauthorized zone affects public DNS.

vercel-deployment-not-found-404.title: Vercel DEPLOYMENT NOT FOUND (404) — what to check in turn?
vercel-deployment-not-found-404.description: The page on Vercel shows DEPLOYMENT NOT FOUND? Check the domain, defloyment, alias and production status step by step.
vercel-deployment-not-found-404.intro: Error 404 DEPLOYMENT NOT FOUND indicates that the request was sent to a defloyment address that Vercel is not finding. This is different from a simple 404 error of a specific application subpage.

sections.title: 1. Differentiate no defloyment from no side
paragraphs: If the message contains DEPLOYMENT NOT FOUND, first check the exact hostname from the address bar. The old link to the preview or the outdated defloyment address may not exist. Open the Vercel project panel and compare the address with the current, running implementation.
If the home page is running and 404 only applies to one path, it is likely that the problem is routing or configuration of the application, rather than the non-existent defloyment.

sections.title: 2 . Check implementation status and domain assignment
paragraphs: In Vercel open Project → Deployments. Find the last production defloyment and see if it has Ready status. If build has failed, open Build Logs and repair the first major error, not only the final build executed with 1.

Then go to Settings → Domains. Make sure your domain is assigned to the right design and that DNS is verified. If several projects had a similar name, also check the project identifier to avoid diagnosing an unrelated application.

sections.title: 3 . Secure Page Restoration
paragraphs: If the production implementation is not working, select the known correct defloyment and use the restore function or prepare a new implementation with the revised code. Don't turn DNS blind. Changing the domain address without understanding the cause may make availability worse.
Finally, check the website under your own domain, not only at .vercel.app, both on your computer and on your phone.

vercel-deployment-ready-old-content.title: Vercel: domain shows the previous version despite new defloyment
vercel-deployment-ready-old-content.description: The new defloyment has the status of READY, but the user still sees the old version of the site.
vercel-deployment-ready-old-content.intro: The new defloyment has the status of READY, but the user still sees the old version of the site. The project may implement the wrong branch and the CDN/viewer may hold older responses.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Compare the SHA of the current production deployment with the SHA of the new Commit in GitHuba.
Check in the assigned domain panel, production branch and cache headers for the changed route.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Verify whether the new change has entered the production branch; if not, merge it according to the CI process.
2 . For refreshed data by the ISR, analyze the revalidate and cache; do not confuse the delayed update with the incorrect defloyment.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: The new SHA is active under the target domain and the external browser sees new content.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not disable global cache without identifying the layer causing the difference.

vercel-dns-propagacja-nie-dziala.title: Domain after plug-in to Vercel does not work — DNS step by step
vercel-dns-propagacja-nie-dziala.description: How to check DNS, CNAME, A record, web conflict and setting at the domain recorder.
vercel-dns-propagacja-nie-dziala.intro: After changing DNS some see a new page and others see an old page or a connection error.

sections.title: Where's the problem coming from?
paragraphs: DNS is cached by resolver and browser. It is also possible that the wrong DNS zone has been edited because the domain uses other names servers.

sections.title: What to do step by step?
paragraphs: 1. Read the current domain name servers and establish which panel actually manages the zone.
2 . Check the main domain records, www and any subdomain needed.
3 . Compare DNS query results with several resolvers and verify TTL.
4 . Remove only conflicting records with the target configuration; leave MX, SPF, DKIM and other mail records.
5 . After the change, check HTTPS and redirect for each version of the domain.

sections.title: Correction test and important trap
paragraphs: The authoritative zone contains the correct records, and after the expiration cache various resolvers return a consistent result.
Do not change all namesservers without rewriting important postal records.

vercel-domena-404-mimo-poprawnego-deploy.title: Vercel: domain shows 404, but vercel.app address works
vercel-domena-404-mimo-poprawnego-deploy.description: The Vercel project operates at technical address, but its own domain shows 404. Diagnosis of domain assignment and DNS.
vercel-domena-404-mimo-poprawnego-deploy.intro: At *.vercel.app the page works, but its own domain does not go to the right project.

sections.title: Where's the problem coming from?
paragraphs: The domain can be assigned to another project or team, have an incorrect DNS record or wait for verification.

sections.title: What to do step by step?
paragraphs: 1. In the Domains page of the project check the exact domain name and verification status.
2 . Compare A, AAA and CNAME records with the instructions shown for a particular project.
3 . Remove conflicting records of the old hosting only after making sure they do not support mail or other services.
4 . Check the main domain and web separately, as well as the destination address of the redirection.
5 . After propagation, run a page test, HTTPS certificate and subpage paths.

sections.title: Correction test and important trap
paragraphs: The home and web domain lead to an expected version of the site without certificate errors and without unnecessary redirections.
Do not copy DNS records from the guide without checking the current values provided by Vercel.

vercel-env-production-preview-different.title: Vercel: production works, preview has no API configuration
vercel-env-production-preview-different.description: The PR preview returns the integration error and the production domain works properly.
vercel-env-production-preview-different.intro: The PR preview returns the integration error and the production domain works properly. The cause needs to be checked in the real environment.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check the Production, Preview and Development ranges of each environmental variable.
Compare SHA commit, the status of defloyment and HTTP response under the final domain, not the very status of READY.

sections.title: Repair steps

sections.title: How to Test Solution

vercel-error-500-po-publikacji.title: Next.js at Vercel: Error 500 only after implementation
vercel-error-500-po-publikacji.description: Localhost runs, Vercel runs 500. Diagnostics runtime logs, ENV, execution time and server.
vercel-error-500-po-publikacji.intro: The page works locally, but the production subpage or API returns 500 Internal Server Error.

sections.title: Where's the problem coming from?
paragraphs: The production environment has other variables, runtime limitations or access rights to services. Compilation without errors does not confirm endpoint action.

sections.title: What to do step by step?
paragraphs: 1. Open Runtime Logs for accurate implementation in Vercel panel and find a request that returned 500.
2 . Check the required ENV and the way they are read on the server side.
3 . Verify connections to the base, external API and availability of dependencies.
4 . Determine whether the error depends on one path, HTTP method or input data.
5 . Add error handling without revealing secrets and perform a test on the production environment.

sections.title: Correction test and important trap
paragraphs: The same scenario works on production, logs do not contain secrets, and incorrect data returns a controlled error code.
Do not show raw stack track or API keys to users in server responses.

vercel-function-size-limit.title: Vercel: Function size limit exceeded at defloy
vercel-function-size-limit.description: The Build bundles too much function and the defloyment is rejected.
vercel-function-size-limit.intro: The Build bundles too much function and the defloyment is rejected. The cause needs to be checked in the real environment.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check Bundle features and dependencies attached to Route Handler, especially large libraries.
Compare SHA commit, the status of defloyment and HTTP response under the final domain, not the very status of READY.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Remove unused packages or split the heavy logic into a separate service instead of wrapping everything into one function.

sections.title: How to Test Solution

sections.title: Security and restrictions

vercel-function-timeout-external-api.title: Vercel Function timed out at free external API
vercel-function-timeout-external-api.description: The server function returns the timeout when waiting for the supplier's response instead of doing business logic.
vercel-function-timeout-external-api.intro: The server function returns the timeout when waiting for the supplier's response instead of doing business logic. The waiting time for an external request may use the entire budget for the performance of the function.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: From logs read the request duration and set which integration corresponds to the slowest.
Check whether timeout is for Vercel, fetch to the supplier or connection to the base.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Add your own AbortSignal.timeout for external calls and handle the limit clearly.
2 . The longer tasks separate from the short HTTP response by queue and retra mechanism, if the process allows.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: Overshooting external time API gives a controlled error, and simple requests do not exceed the limit.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not extend one customer request without end if the operation should act asynchronously.

vercel-github-commit-nie-aktualizuje-str.title: I put a commit in GitHub, and Vercel shows the old page
vercel-github-commit-nie-aktualizuje-str.description: Commit's on GitHub, but production doesn't change. How to find branch, design, defloy and cache.
vercel-github-commit-nie-aktualizuje-str.intro: The code in the repository has been corrected and the user still sees the old version of the page.

sections.title: Where's the problem coming from?
paragraphs: The change could hit another branch, Vercel could have implemented another commit or defloy was not completed. Sometimes a browser or CDN cache occurs.

sections.title: What to do step by step?
paragraphs: 1. Compare SHA commit in GitHub with SHA visible at the production depot Vercel.
2 . Check production branches and repository attached to the project.
3 . If defloy has ERROR status, open build logs and correct the real cause.
4 . If READY, open the exact implementation URL and compare to your own domain.
5 . With the current code, check resource cache, service worker and downloaded API data.

sections.title: Correction test and important trap
paragraphs: The production deploy indicates the right SHA and in private mode shows the expected change.
Do not clean all caches blindly and do not force new defloys without checking the source commit.

vercel-logs-missing-source-maps.title: Vercel: runtime logs show a minified stack track track
vercel-logs-missing-source-maps.description: A function error is difficult to connect to a specific TypeScript source line.
vercel-logs-missing-source-maps.intro: A function error is difficult to connect to a specific TypeScript source line. The cause needs to be checked in the real environment.

sections.title: How to Test Solution

sections.title: Security and restrictions

vercel-monorepo-root-directory.title: Vercel: no package.json found in monorepo
vercel-monorepo-root-directory.description: The implementation of monorepo does not see package.json or starts building the wrong application.
vercel-monorepo-root-directory.intro: The implementation of monorepo does not see package.json or starts building the wrong application. Root Directory of the project can indicate a repository directory instead of a specific application folder.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Check the app/ structure, packages/ and the actual package.json location for the application.
Compare Root Directory and install/build commands with the directory from which they are made in Vercel.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Set Root Directory to the actual application or configure monorepo according to the workspace manager used.
2 . Make sure that the shared packages dependencies are available at build and that configuration does not cut off the needed files.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: PR preview and production build the same application, and the resulting address shows correct components.

sections.title: What to do

vercel-output-directory-wrong.title: Vercel: implementation of READY, but page shows an empty directory
vercel-output-directory-wrong.description: The building ends in success, but the domain returns 404 or an empty view after publication.
vercel-output-directory-wrong.intro: The building ends in success, but the domain returns 404 or an empty view after publication. Set Output Directory or preset framework can indicate a directory other than the actual build result.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Check framework preset, Build Command and Output Directory project.
Compare local build artifacts with the expectations of the selected framework, e.g. Next.js vs static Vite.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Remove outdated manual output setting if the framework manages it automatically.
2 . For a static generator set the actual output directory and rebuild the project.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: The production address returns the correct HTML and loads JS/CSS, not just the REDY status in the panel.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not treat a successful defloyment as a website performance test for visitors.

vercel-preview-inna-strona-niz-productio.title: Vercel Preview works, Production does not — why are the pages different?
vercel-preview-inna-strona-niz-productio.description: Why is the Vercel preview working and production not? Branch, domain, env and other environment settings.
vercel-preview-inna-strona-niz-productio.intro: The PR preview works properly, but the production domain returns an error or shows another view.

sections.title: Where's the problem coming from?
paragraphs: Vercel separates the environment and variables. Preview can use a different database, keys, domains and commit version than Production.

sections.title: What to do step by step?
paragraphs: 1. See if you compare the same commit and the same path.
2 . In the Deployment panel, check the environment and the assigned domain.
3 . Compare ENV variable names and ranges without revealing their values.
4 . Verify the connection to the base and external API separately for Preview and Production.
5 . After the amendment, perform a new deploy with correct variables and a critical path test.

sections.title: Correction test and important trap
paragraphs: Preview and production differ only consciously configured elements; the production page works with the right base.
Do not connect the preview to the production base without strict security and informed decision.

vercel-preview-protection-401.title: Vercel: PR preview returns 401 to unincorporated client
vercel-preview-protection-401.description: The preview address displays the Vercel or HTTP 401 login page instead of the content.
vercel-preview-protection-401.intro: The preview address displays the Vercel or HTTP 401 login page instead of the content. Deployment Protection may restrict access to previews for team members.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Check whether the address is a preview defloyment and what access policy it has in the project panel.
Compare access as a logged team member and incognito window.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Share the right preview link or use the right invitation mechanism. First, determine whether the customer needs a permanent demonstration environment or a one-time preview of the change.
2 . If you need to give your client a public demo, consider a separate environment with deliberately set access and no test secrets.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: The client opens the specified address, and sensitive previews are still protected.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not disable the entire team's security just to show someone one page.

vercel-redirect-308-query-lost.intro: Upon entering the URL, it loses some of the query string and analyst loses the source of the entry. The cause needs to be checked in the real environment.

vercel-ssl-certificate-pending.title: Vercel: SSL certificate remains Pending for the new domain
vercel-ssl-certificate-pending.description: The domain sometimes works after HTTP, but HTTPS shows a certificate error or panel does not finish its release.
vercel-ssl-certificate-pending.intro: The domain sometimes works after HTTP, but HTTPS shows a certificate error or panel does not finish its release. The certificate process requires proper DNS and domain verification.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Check Vercel domain status and DNS public score for all pinned hosts.
Verify that CAA records do not limit allowed certificate exhibitors.

2 . After repairing the DNS let the platform complete the automatic certification process and observe the status.

sections.title: How to check the score

vercel-subdomena-konfiguracja-dns.title: How do I connect a CRM or demo subdomain to Vercel without breaking the mail?
vercel-subdomena-konfiguracja-dns.description: Configuration of crm.domena.pl and demo.domena.pl from Vercel when the main domain and post office work separately.
vercel-subdomena-konfiguracja-dns.intro: You want to run several projects under the subdomains of one domain, but you are afraid to interrupt mail and homepage.

sections.title: Where's the problem coming from?
paragraphs: Each subdomain can have its own DNS record and design. MX, SPF, DKM records concerning mail should not be accidentally overwritten.

2 . In Vercel, add each subdomain to the corresponding project and read the recommended DNS record.
3 . Only change records of specific hosts at the recorder.
4 . Verify HTTPS, redirection and availability of login for each subdomain.
5 . After the change, test sending and receiving mail and other projects.

sections.title: Correction test and important trap
paragraphs: All specified subdomains open appropriate applications, and mail records and main domain handling have not changed.
Do not remove the entire DNS zone when adding one CNAME.

vercel-this-deployment-is-temporarily-pa.title: Vercel: This defloyment is temporally paused — what does it mean and how do we restore the site?
vercel-this-deployment-is-temporarily-pa.description: On the page you see This deposit is temporally paused? Check project status, plan limit and final implementation.
vercel-this-deployment-is-temporarily-pa.intro: The page or CRM stops opening and everyone sees the message This deposit is temporally paused. A similar case concerned the implementation of B-CRM.

sections.title: Where's the problem coming from?
paragraphs: This is a host layer message, not a standard React error. The reason must be established in the Vercel panel: project status, settlements, limits and concrete implementation.

sections.title: What to do step by step?
paragraphs: 1. Open Vercel Dashboard, select the right team and project; check the pause and settlement messages.
2 . Check the status of the last implementation, the date of the last correct publication and the current production address.
3 . Verify whether a project or team has no limit, no end to the trial or no account limitations. Don't automatically assume the code is guilty.
4 . If Vercel provides the option to resume after the cause is resolved, do it in the panel. With a vague restriction, take advantage of the support.
5 . After resuming, check your own domain, login page, API calls, and test account forms.

sections.title: Correction test and important trap
paragraphs: The own domain returns the correct page, login and key business flow are working, and the panel does not show active interruption.
The self-implement of the repository does not need to remove restrictions at account or plan level.

vercel-trial-expired-credits.title: Vercel or Railway: Trial ends — will the page be disabled?
vercel-trial-expired-credits.description: Notice of expiry of the probationary period or credits. How to test the dependence of production and plan migration.
vercel-trial-expired-credits.intro: The panel warns that the trial expires or credits run out. It is not always known which services depend on a paid plan.

sections.title: Where's the problem coming from?
paragraphs: Various platforms account for hosting, database, transfer and additional services differently. One communication does not automatically mean identical effects for all projects.

sections.title: What to do step by step?
paragraphs: 1. Check supplier name, plan, balance, forecast trial end and related resources.
2 . Make a list of services: frontend, API, database, cyclical tasks, storage and domain.
3 . Read the current rules of the plan in the supplier's documentation, not on the basis of an old guide or advertising.
4 . Prepare base export and configuration, practice restoration in the test environment.
5 . Determine whether moving to the toll plan makes sense or simpler hosting is enough; monitor the condition after changing.

sections.title: Correction test and important trap
paragraphs: You know which service is subject to a fee, which resources will remain active and you have the tested ability to restore the data.
Do not move the production base at the last minute without a copy and withdrawal plan.

vercel-zmienna-env-nie-dziala.title: The environmental variable works locally and on Vercel does not
vercel-zmienna-env-nie-dziala.description: Local env file is not automatically a production configuration. Vercel separates the environment, and some variables of Next.js go to the code already when building
vercel-zmienna-env-nie-dziala.intro: Local env file is not automatically a production configuration. Vercel distributes the environment, and some of Next.js variables go into the code as they build.

sections.title: Step by step
paragraphs: 1. Check the name of the variable in the code and the failed implementation environment: Production or Preview. Open project settings and compare assigning a variable without copying a secret to report.
2 . Determine whether the value is to be read on the server or in the browser. The NEXT PUBLIC  prefix means the public value attached to the client code; do not use it for server APIs.
3 . After changing configuration, create a new implementation with the right commit. The old build may still contain the previous public value.

4 . If an error occurs, log in the information about the existence of the configuration and not its content. Also check the spaces and characters of the new line if the provider rejects the correctly named variable.
5 . Compare your own domain with the implementation address. Make sure you test the design and environment in which the settings have just been changed.

sections.title: How to check whether the amendment works
paragraphs: The new implementation should perform the test operation without revealing the secret in the page code. If the key came to the client earlier, remove it from the code and invalidate it from the supplier.

vercel-zmienna-srodowiskowa-ustawiona-w-.title: Vercel: environmental variable set in panel, but not working in application
vercel-zmienna-srodowiskowa-ustawiona-w-.description: Step by step diagnostics for situations where the environmental variable is visible in the Vercel panel, but the application does not read it during construction or runtime — possible causes and specific repair tests.
vercel-zmienna-srodowiskowa-ustawiona-w-.intro: Problem: In the Vercel panel, you see an environment variable (Environment Variable), but the application returns no value or old value, or differences between build and runtime. Causes may be technical and procedural: different ranges (Environment, Preview, Production), no rebuild after change, the use of an incorrect reading mechanism (e.g. process.env in a client without NEXT PUBLAC  prefix), local cache or build cache Vercel, as well as typos in variable name. Diagnosis requires separate testing of the build and runtime phase and confirmation that the variable is available in this phase and for this design/branch. Framework versions (Next.js) and build-step configurations also influence: Next.js inserts values during build into static code — changing the variable after build will not change the generated static files without re-deploya. For this reason, I propose a systematic approach: (1) check the view of the variable in the Vercel panel (Environment: Production/Preview/Development), (2) make sure that you perform defloy after each change in value, (3) verify, whether you use the correct convention (e.g. NEXT PUBLC  for the values available in the browser), (4) evaluate whether the problem occurs during build or runtime — build logs and variables in server logs will help. Further steps include rebuilding a cache-cleaning project, a simple-endpoint test that returns the process.env value, and local playback of settings by vercel dev or by exporting variables to the environment It's running. In the following diagnostics, I have given options of causes, concrete steps to perform and short verification tests, which conditions eliminate potential source of error.

sections.title: How to Recognize Cause
paragraphs: Check the Vercel Panel variable range: each variable has Environment (Development, Preview, Production). If you deploy on production, but the variable is set only for Preview, the application will not see it. In the Project → Settings panel → Environment Variables check whether the entry is in the desired view and for the right design.

Distinguish build vs runtime: frames (e.g. Next.js) settle process.env at build time for client-side code. If the variable has changed after the last build, force a new defloy. In addition, cache builda can hold an old value — use redeploy/purge cache.

Check name and availability client-side: variables used in the browser must have a framework prefix (in Next.js NEXT PUBLIC ). There is also a typo or incorrect reading (e.g. using import.meta.env in a project that does not support it).

sections.title: Step by step solution
paragraphs: 1. Verify in Vercel Panel: Projects → Settings → Environment Variables — confirm name (case-sensitive), value and Environment (Production/Preview/Development). Take a drop of the name and compare exactly what the code expects.

2 . Perform manual redeploy (Deployments → Redeploy) for the environment where the problem occurs by selecting the option 'Redefloy with Clear Cache' if available. Wait until full build logs appear and analyze them for values or messages of missing variables.

3 . Add temporary endpoint or test field in the server application that returns raw process.env['NAZWA CHANGE'] during runtime. Make sure endpoint works in the same environment as the problem and does not send value to the client if it's secret.

4 . If you use the Next.js framework and need a variable on the client side, make sure that the name starts with NEXT PUPC . Changing the name requires rebuild and redeploy; it is not enough to just edit the client code.

5 . Run locally vercel dev with the same variables (export NAME=value or use .env local) and confirm that the problem is reproduced locally. If it works locally, compare build logs and the Node/Builder version used by Vercel.

6 . Check build-step files and configurations in vercel.json (if any) — some custom builders can isolate the environment and not transmit variables to the build process. Remove custom cache or add public env to build command if needed.

7 . If everything fails, copy the variable name to a simple 'console.log(process.env.NAZWA)' script running as serverless function in Vercel and check function logs — it separates the application problem from the platform.

sections.title: How to see if the problem is gone
paragraphs: Test 1 — log build: after redeploy check in the Deployments full log build tab. It should contain no errors such as 'undefined variable' and, if you put temporary console.log(process.env.NAZWA) in the code, it will be visible in build logs.

Test 2 — runtime function: implement a simple serverless function (api/test.js) returning process.env.NAZWA. Call endpoint after defloy and compare the returned value with the one in the panel; the difference will indicate the runtime vs build phase problem.

Test 3 — client vs server: in the client-side application, write the value value NEXT PUBLUC NAZWA to the browser console after loading the page. If undefined, check if the variable has a prefix and if the defloy was a rebuild — it will distinguish the problem of exposing from the scope.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not redeploy after changing values: the variables embedded in the build require full rebuild; only editing the values in the panel without redeploy will not update static artifacts.
Using secret variables on the client side without a prefix: revealing secrets to the frontend is an error; no prefix also causes the framework to not provide a variable for client-side.
The range set in the wrong environment: setting the variable only for Preview is not enough for Production — check the image compatible with the active defloy.

wordpress-cache-stale-content.intro: Editing is stored in the panel, but the unincorporated user sees an old version of the content or CSS. Cache plugins, hosting, CDN or generated CSS files may store an older version of the site.

Check the active cache mechanisms and whether the generated CSS has the current version.

sections.title: What to do step by step

sections.title: What to do

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Check PHP logs and WordPress recovery mode by identifying a specific file and stack track.

sections.title: What to do step by step

2 . Make a staging test update and remove the cause of the error before restarting.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: Frontend and panel work and the log does not contain new fatal errors for this operation.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not disable all PHP security or delete plugin data without backup.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Compare the answer /wp-json with other endpoints and check the firewall logs for code 403.
See if the problem concerns all methods, or only POST requests requiring nonce or authorization.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Restore access only to the needed public routes and preserve the protection of private endpoints.
2 . For logged operations, check the nonces and user permissions instead of unconditionally disable verification.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: The public endpoint works, and the data modification without authentication still returns the refusal.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not disable all WAF rules or all REST authorization to fix one form.

wordpress-rest-nonce-expired.title: WordPress REST API: cookie is invalid or nonce expired
wordpress-rest-nonce-expired.description: After a longer period of editing, the entry record does not work despite prior login.
wordpress-rest-nonce-expired.intro: After a longer period of editing, the entry record does not work despite prior login. The cause needs to be checked in the real environment.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check the validity of the X-WP-Nonce session and header sent by REST client.
Check the bug log, recent plugin changes and the environment version on the site test copy.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Refresh nonce in a trusted user context or request re-log in.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: The editor saves after the session has been renewed, and the request without valid nonsense is blocked.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Make a backup before you migrate or update PHP. Do not enter access data in untrusted forms.

wordpress-search-engine-visibility-noind.title: WordPress does not appear in Google by setting “Distort Search”
wordpress-search-engine-visibility-noind.description: The new site has a correct map and content, but generates a noindex directive.
wordpress-search-engine-visibility-noind.intro: The new site has a correct map and content, but generates a noindex directive. The cause needs to be checked in the real environment.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check Settings → Reading and final meta robots in HTML public pages.
Check the bug log, recent plugin changes and the environment version on the site test copy.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Disable deliberate lock after publication, keeping noindex for private staging.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: Public sites do not have noindex and staging remains excluded from indexing.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Make a backup before you migrate or update PHP. Do not enter access data in untrusted forms.

wordpress-site-health-loopback-failed.title: WordPress Site Health: loopback request failed
wordpress-site-health-loopback-failed.description: The page fitness tool cannot make a call back to its own domain.
wordpress-site-health-loopback-failed.intro: The page fitness tool cannot make a call back to its own domain. The cause needs to be checked in the real environment.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check HTTP output lock on hosting, SSL certificate and local endpoint response.
Check the bug log, recent plugin changes and the environment version on the site test copy.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Restore the allowed loopback requests for the required features while maintaining security.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: Site Health performs the test and WP-Cron tasks do not stop by blocking.

sections.title: Security and restrictions
paragraphs: Make a backup before you migrate or update PHP. Do not enter access data in untrusted forms.

wordpress-wp-cron-not-running.title: WordPress: Scheduled entries do not publish because WP-Cron does not work
wordpress-wp-cron-not-running.description: The planned publication or backup remains overdue despite the scheduled schedule.
wordpress-wp-cron-not-running.intro: The planned publication or backup remains overdue despite the scheduled schedule. WP -Cron can be based on site visits, and the movement or configuration of hosting affects its launch.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Check the list of scheduled tasks and see if DISABLE WP CRON is enabled without a replacement schedule.
Verify whether hosting does not block loopback requests or requests to wp-cron.php.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Set up the cron system task according to hosting instructions when you need movement independence.
2 . Ensure idempotence of tasks and a record of errors for notifications or publications.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: A late entry shall be published and subsequent launches shall take place without double publication.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not trigger wp-cron.php publicly without any frequency and cost control.

wordpress-wp-mail-form-no-email.title: WordPress: the form shows success, but wp mail does not deliver messages
wordpress-wp-mail-form-no-email.description: The user sees the message confirmation and there is no notification in the recipient box.
wordpress-wp-mail-form-no-email.intro: The user sees the message confirmation and there is no notification in the recipient box. Calling wp mail does not guarantee delivery of the message; the problem may be in the transport or domain authorization.

sections.title: How to determine the source of the error
paragraphs: Check if the code actually calls wp mail and whether the server or plugin records shipping errors.
Verify SPF, DKIM, From and recipient; check the spam folder and email provider logs.

sections.title: What to do step by step
paragraphs: 1. Configure a certified transport through a trusted SMTP server or a transaction provider according to the domain.
2 . Store the query in the database/CRM as a source of truth and send an email as an additional notification.

sections.title: How to check the score
paragraphs: The test form creates a record and the message reaches the target box with correct authentication.

sections.title: What to do
paragraphs: Do not show “sent message” as a delivery guarantee if the application has no confirmation.

wordpress-wp-sitemap-duplicate-seo-plugi.title: WordPress: two site maps after installing the SEO plugin
wordpress-wp-sitemap-duplicate-seo-plugi.description: The site provides both wp-sitemap.xml and separate sitemap index.xml from the plugin.
wordpress-wp-sitemap-duplicate-seo-plugi.intro: The site provides both wp-sitemap.xml and separate sitemap index.xml from the plugin. The cause needs to be checked in the real environment.

sections.title: How to identify the source of the problem
paragraphs: Check which Google addresses it actually reads and whether both maps contain the same canonical URL.
Check the bug log, recent plugin changes and the environment version on the site test copy.

sections.title: Repair steps
paragraphs: Select one managed map generator and make sure the reported address is correct.

sections.title: How to Test Solution
paragraphs: Map and sitemap index are consistent, without reports of outdated subpages.

sections.title: Security and restrictions

Check the bug log, recent plugin changes and the environment version on the site test copy.

sections.title: Repair steps

sections.title: How to Test Solution

wordpress-wpjson-404-after-rewrite.title: WordPress: /wp-json/ returns 404 despite a running blog
wordpress-wpjson-404-after-rewrite.description: REST API WordPress does not respond under standard path, although the subpages look correct.
wordpress-wpjson-404-after-rewrite.intro: REST API WordPress does not respond under standard path, although the subpages look correct. The cause needs to be checked in the real environment.
